jobs.description:
At Rock Processing, we’re passionate about development and advanced technology, and we always aim to offer the best possible experience for our customers in a sustainable way. It’s a mission that takes commitment, but as an industry leader we aim for nothing but excellence in everything we do. We offer a diverse range of opportunities through our businesses and cross-border networks, enabling you to explore your potential and thrive.

We are looking for a technically skilled and customer-focused professional with a qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field, and at least two years’ experience in the mining industry. The ideal candidate should have knowledge of vibrating screens, mining plant processes, condition monitoring, and digital monitoring tools. Experience in troubleshooting, servicing, designing, or selling screening equipment will be advantageous. Strong problem-solving, communication, and customer service skills are essential, along with proficiency in Microsoft Office, a valid driver’s licence, and the ability to travel within the EMEA region when required.



Purpose of the role:


Enhance customer relations through technical expertise and asset performance monitoring with ACS-s and SAM, while providing technical support for remote monitoring agreements and stakeholders in Sales Areas


The job responsibilities:


  • Monitoring of connected screens in SAM
  • Key contact for Sales Areas and customers for screens in EMEA
  • Preparation of monitoring reports for key customers
  • Support customers with recommended actions to improve performance and reliability of monitoring screens
  • Technical expert for ACS-s hardware and features in SAM
  • Technical trainings for ACS-s and SAM for stakeholders in the Sales Areas
  • Continuously enhance SAM features and state variables and share feedback with development teams.


EHS Responsibilities (supported by EHS department):

  • Ensure that customers are always supported with the latest EHS guidelines for screening assets
  • Promote the EHS Policy and Company Values with a focus on EHS.
  • Ensure the implementation of corrective actions based on incidents or learning
  • Promote and encourage continuous improvement, innovation and implementation of best practices


Competences:


  • Knowledge of vibrating equipment
  • Good understanding of mining site plants and process engineering
  • Sound judgement and problem-solving ability
  • Listening and logic interpretation
  • Strong customer orientation
  • Advanced communication skills
  • Digital native with comprehensive knowledge about digital applications and tools
  • Strong understanding and compliance with Health and Safety in the workplace
  • Computer Literacy & MS Office proficiency

Education:


  • Technical degree / Diploma in a mechanical or Mega Tronics
  • Candidates with highly relevant experience/references will also be considered.


Experience:

  • 2+ year minimum in the mining industry.
  • Candidates with relevant vibrating screen troubleshooting/service/sales experience are preferred.
  • Candidates with previous condition monitoring experience, especially within the mining environment are preferred.
  • Exposure in the design and/or sales of screens or other equipment in the mining industry.


Other requirements:


  • Capability to travel into the region EMEA (Europe, Middle East, Central Asia and Africa) should it be necessary.
  • Valid drivers license



What is in it for you?


We offer you an interesting role in an international business environment, extraordinary products, great colleagues, and opportunities for your professional development. At Sandvik, we believe that diversity of experience, perspective and background will lead to a better environment for our employees, our business and, thereby, our customers. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us better.


Application


Send your application as soon as possible as we will be evaluating candidates continuously, and no later than 30 October 2026. Read more about Sandvik Group and apply at home.sandvik/career,


About us:Rock Processing is a business area within the Sandvik Group and a leading supplier of equipment, tools, parts, service and solutions for processing rock and minerals in the mining and construction industries. Application areas include crushing and screening, breaking and demolition.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community Humana’s Digital Health Platform (DHP) is the engineering platform behind many of Humana’s consumer digital experiences.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana’s Digital Health Platform (DHP) is the engineering platform behind many of Humana’s consumer digital experiences. DHP Product Engineering builds the shared pieces other Humana teams build on, including a micro-frontend catalog, accessibility tooling, and API foundations, and we build them with AI coding agents at the center of how we work. We are hiring a Senior Product Engineer who wants a say in what gets built as well as the craft of building it, from accessible interfaces to the services behind them.
You will own features across the whole stack, and you decide the technical approach for the work you own. You use AI coding tools like Claude Code every day, and you help build the shared skills and tooling behind that workflow. We measure your work by the results it produces for Humana’s members and patients and for the teams who build on our platform.

The Senior Product Engineer helps decide what we build, not just how we build it. This is a senior engineering role at its foundation. You design, develop, and deploy scalable web applications end to end, and you meet a high bar for engineering craft. You also own the product: you shape what we build, influence what goes on the roadmap, and are measured by the outcomes your work produces rather than the tickets you close. You explore before you commit, propose the work as often as you receive it, and sharpen requirements rather than simply implement them.

You will build accessible user interfaces, implement robust back-end microservices, and integrate the two with GraphQL, all while exercising considerable latitude over technical approach. Strong product instinct here does not lower the engineering bar; it raises the overall one.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • 5 or more years of software engineering experience, including 3 or more years of full-stack web development
  • 2 or more years each with React, Node.js, and GraphQL, including building accessible user interfaces that meet WCAG 2.2
  • Experience owning product or technical direction, such as shaping a roadmap or turning ambiguous problems into shipped outcomes
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor in daily development, including reviewing and refining what they produce

Preferred Qualifications

  • Test-driven development with Vitest, Jest, or Playwright
  • Deploying microservices to Azure with Docker or Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines
  • Micro-frontend architecture with Module Federation, including shared modules and cross-app dependencies
  • Building React applications with TanStack Query, TanStack Router, TanStack Start, or Next.js
  • Integrating AI into production features, or writing AI agent skills


Use your skills to make an impact

How we work: Our practice is skills-driven. A skill is a set of reusable instructions that an AI agent follows for a recurring task. You will write and improve those skills as part of your regular work. The practice is still emerging, and on this team you will help establish how it works.


What helps you succeed here:

  • Working independently and making sound technical decisions with incomplete information
  • Communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, in writing and in person
  • Giving and receiving constructive feedback in code reviews and design discussions
  • Bringing structure to ambiguous problems and to processes that are still taking shape
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$106,900 - $147,000 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

jobs.title: Finance Training and Support Manager
jobs.excerpt: What We Can Achieve Together: The Training and Support Manager is a member of the Finance Resource Center (FRC) will be responsible for developing and coordinating training programs and learning solutions that build staff capacity and expertise, primarily related to Finance business processes.
jobs.description:
What We Can Achieve Together:


The Training and Support Manager is a member of the Finance Resource Center (FRC) will be responsible for developing and coordinating training programs and learning solutions that build staff capacity and expertise, primarily related to Finance business processes. The FRC is dedicated to providing the tools, information and training that Conservancy staff and trustees need to interpret and utilize our financial resources in order to support our conservation mission. The Training and Support Manager is also responsible for developing written and verbal communications on Finance business processes and responding to requests for technical accounting and analysis expertise. They will work in all areas of finance and will work with other members of the Finance BU to provide tools, resources, training, communication, and support to TNC finance staff based on TNC policies and procedures.


The Training and Support Manager will work towards meeting strategic priorities by developing and coordinating training plans, communications and support programs that build TNC staff knowledge in Finance. They will be responsible for identifying training and knowledge gaps related to Finance topics. They will coordinate the process of the design, development, and maintenance of comprehensive training curriculums delivered through a variety of methods. They will analyze factual information to achieve results, improve workflow, and solve problems. The Manager will reinforce consistency in the organization's policies and procedures and will provide support related to Finance business processes. The Manager will be knowledgeable of the systems and resources used by Finance and will apply understanding to manage organizational support and planning communications related to those systems and resources. They will manage documentation, initiate complex processes, and serve as a key team member for the enhancement of systems and tools used by the team. They will lead diverse activities, analyze situations, evaluate alternatives, project outcomes, and implement solutions to improve effectiveness.


We’re Looking for You:


Are you looking for work you can believe in? Join the Finance Resource Center (FRC), where you will support learning, process improvement, and organizational initiatives that help finance staff succeed and enable the Finance Business Unit to deliver critical services across the organization. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to strategic projects, support the evolution of Workday and related business processes, and develop learning solutions that help staff adapt to change and build new capabilities. The ideal candidate is an organized and collaborative professional with strong communication, project management, and problem-solving skills who can manage multiple initiatives, design curriculum and job aids, facilitate training, provide service-oriented support, coordinate cross-functional teams, and build effective partnerships to deliver practical solutions and positive outcomes.


What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting or Business Administration and 5 years' related experience or equivalent combination.
  • Experience with accounting principles, practices and regulations.
  • Experience leading and implementing multiple projects.
  • Experience with current technology in relevant field.
  • Experience working with teams across the organization.
  • Experience, coursework, or other training in current and evolving trends in training, curriculum design, distance learning, and web-based design.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Multi-lingual skills and/or multi-cultural experience appreciated.
  • Demonstrated ability to conceive and write creatively for various audiences and excellent presentation skills.
  • Strong finance background, with the ability to understand accounting concepts, Finance Representative needs, and Workday finance processes.
  • Learning and development experience supporting learning, training delivery, and user adoption.
  • Experience monitoring for and ensuring compliance with organizational policy, applicable law and regulation, and finance/accounting/management best practice.
  • Experience with GAAP and/or relevant regulatory framework.
  • Experience acting as a resource to others to solve problems.
  • CPA or CIA may be preferred.

Salary Information:


This position may be based in any country where TNC has an established entity, taking into consideration legal restrictions, such as non-national ratios and immigration processing times. For U.S. based applicants only, the starting pay range for this position is generally within the range of $69,275 - $103,785 for annual base salary and is based on location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA. For all other applicants, pay ranges will be in local currency, the pay range will be based on the local labor market, and not tied to the above pay range. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment and used to determine your actual pay range. Additionally, for all applicants, actual pay will fall within a range based on a variety of factors including, for example, the candidate’s qualifications, specific skills, and experience.



Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers a competitive, comprehensive benefits package including health care benefits, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) plan with an 8% employer match, parental leave, accrued paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, other life and work well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports of the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer.Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

Do you have military experience? Visit our U.S. Military Skills Translator to match your military experience with our current job openings!

TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.

Position Summary

The Senior Business Systems Analyst provides a centralized support and intake function for the Medical Stop Loss technology platform. The role triages and prioritizes support requests, production issues, defects, enhancements, and operational escalations; coordinates assignment and resolution across business, technology, and vendor teams; manages queue health and the operational backlog; and ensures stakeholders receive timely, clear communication. The analyst also supports operational readiness, project-to-BAU transitions, knowledge management, and continuous improvement by identifying recurring issues and translating them into process, training, documentation, or platform enhancements.

What will your job entail?

Job Responsibilities

  • Serves as the primary business-facing intake and support contact for users of the Medical Stop Loss technology platform, including platform questions, production issues, access concerns, defects, enhancement requests, and operational escalations.
  • Collaborates with business stakeholders to understand reported issues, workflow impacts, business needs, and desired outcomes.
  • Ensures support requests contain sufficient information, including the affected user or team, business process, transaction or example, supporting evidence, timing, impact, workaround, urgency, and requested outcome.
  • Validates reported behavior, gathers missing information, and classifies requests as user support, training needs, process gaps, data or integration issues, access needs, application defects, bugs, or enhancements.
  • Assesses severity and priority based on business impact, affected users, downstream consequences, workaround availability, recurrence, compliance considerations, and timing sensitivity.
  • Routes requests to the appropriate Ryan Specialty Benefits specialist, Technology Delivery team, Product Owner, enterprise partner team, vendor, or external support group.
  • Monitors open requests, aging, blocked items, unresolved dependencies, response commitments, ownership acceptance, and service-level risks through resolution.
  • Coordinates cross-functional issue resolution, maintains accountability for next steps, communicates status to stakeholders, and confirms resolution with the requesting business area before closure.
  • Owns and maintains the consolidated operational support, defect, bug, and enhancement backlog for assigned platform capabilities.
  • Facilitates recurring queue and backlog reviews with business stakeholders, Product Owners, Technology Delivery, QA, and vendor or partner teams.
  • Documents business value, operational impact, affected users, urgency, dependencies, supporting evidence, and acceptance criteria to support prioritization decisions.
  • Tracks backlog decisions, committed actions, vendor responses, target releases, blockers, testing requirements, and completion evidence.
  • Escalates urgent, high-impact, aging, or repeatedly stalled items through established operational and leadership escalation paths.
  • Participates in project-to-business-as-usual transitions and post-release stabilization activities, ensuring that support ownership, intake channels, escalation contacts, access, runbooks, known issues, and knowledge transfer are established.
  • Identifies operational readiness gaps and communicates associated risks, dependencies, and recommended acceptance conditions to component owners and delivery leadership.
  • Maintains standard operating procedures, onboarding and access guidance, troubleshooting materials, knowledge articles, job aids, release notes, and training content.
  • Identifies recurring questions, issues, and operational pain points and translates them into process improvements, training updates, knowledge materials, or platform enhancement candidates.
  • Provides concise, executive-ready communications regarding issue status, risks, decisions, ownership, dependencies, and next steps to business stakeholders, delivery teams, vendors, and leadership.

  • Experience assessing business impact and translating business needs into clear priorities, ownership assignments, acceptance requirements, and actionable next steps.
  • Experience supporting operational readiness, release transitions, stabilization activities, or project-to-business-as-usual handoffs.
  • Experience developing and maintaining standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, onboarding materials, or end-user training content.
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow or comparable IT service-management tools, Jira or Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and reporting or dashboard tools is preferred.

  • As part of an investigation, the investigator will need to prepare correspondence; be objective and accurate and communicate with others with tact.

The Role

    Board Intelligence's software is used by boards and leadership teams at some of the most heavily regulated organisations in the world, including major financial services firms.     We are setting up a new Platform Experience team to build the web applications and APIs that power the whole platform, rather than features for individual products or clients. As a Customer Success Manager (Cyber) you will own adoption, renewal, and growth across a portfolio of North America Private Sector accounts.

Job Title: Sr Associate Software Engineer

Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Sr Associate Software Engineer

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will contribute to the design, development, implementation, integration, and ongoing support of scalable software, data, and automation solutions that meet R&D Commercialization business needs and advance Amgen’s mission to serve patients.

Working closely with product managers, analysts, architects, engineers, and business stakeholders, the Senior Associate Software Engineer translates business and technical requirements into secure, reliable, maintainable, and scalable solutions. The role contributes throughout the software development lifecycle, including solution design, development, configuration, testing, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and production support.

The Senior Associate Software Engineer independently delivers moderately complex technical work and owns assigned applications, solutions, or workstreams from design through production support. The engineer contributes to software-engineering standards, code quality, DevOps automation, system observability, operational reliability, technical documentation, and continuous improvement. Depending on business needs, work may span application development, data engineering, APIs and system integrations, cloud and container platforms, workflow automation, low-code solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, configure, test, deploy, and support scalable enterprise software applications, platform capabilities, APIs, integrations, interfaces, reports, and automation solutions
  • Own the technical implementation of assigned user stories and workstreams in collaboration with product managers, analysts, architects, engineers, and other technical team members
  • Analyze business, functional, and technical requirements and translate them into technical designs, implementation tasks, data flows, integration patterns, and testable acceptance criteria
  • Develop production-ready applications, services, and automation solutions using Python, SQL, and other approved programming, scripting, workflow, and low-code technologies
  • Design, develop, and support data pipelines, transformations, integrations, and data-quality controls using technologies such as Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, and APIs
  • Develop and maintain APIs, web services, microservices, event-driven solutions, and enterprise application integrations
  • Contribute to front-end and back-end development using Amgen-preferred frameworks, platforms, and development tools
  • Build and deploy containerized solutions using Docker, Kubernetes platforms managed through Rafay, and applicable AWS container services such as ECR, EKS, ECS, or Fargate
  • Support DevOps and continuous-delivery practices, including source control, automated builds, CI/CD pipelines, release coordination, environment management, infrastructure automation, and deployment validation
  • Develop and maintain unit, integration, regression, and automated tests to improve solution quality and reduce recurring defects
  • Participate in peer reviews, code reviews, and technical design reviews, providing constructive feedback and ensuring adherence to established engineering standards
  • Monitor application, integration, and data-pipeline health using logging, alerting, and observability tools
  • Troubleshoot production incidents, software defects, integration failures, data issues, and performance problems; perform root-cause analysis and implement durable corrective actions
  • Manage or support application secrets, certificates, authentication, authorization, identity integrations, and other application security controls
  • Apply secure coding, access-control, data-protection, vulnerability-management, and applicable Amgen quality and compliance requirements throughout the software lifecycle
  • Rapidly develop prototypes and proofs of concept to evaluate technologies, demonstrate proposed solutions, and validate technical approaches
  • Create and maintain architecture diagrams, technical designs, API and integration specifications, configuration documentation, deployment procedures, operational runbooks, and support materials
  • Identify technical risks, delivery constraints, security concerns, and cross-system dependencies, escalating issues when broader architectural or leadership support is required
  • Participate actively in Agile or Scrum ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, estimation, demonstrations, retrospectives, and continuous-improvement activities
  • Share technical knowledge and provide guidance to team members on assigned technologies, applications, and engineering practices
  • Responsibly use approved AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, testing, documentation, and code quality
  • Identify opportunities to incorporate AI-enabled capabilities into business applications, automation solutions, and internal developer tools while complying with security, privacy, and quality requirements

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a person with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications and Experience:

  • Master’s degree and 3 years of Information Systems experience
    OR Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of Information Systems experience
    OR Associate’s degree and 6 years of Information Systems experience
    OR High school diploma / GED and 8 years of Information Systems experience
  • Demonstrated experience developing, integrating, deploying, or supporting enterprise software or data solutions
  • Proficient in Python and SQL
  • Experience working with cloud, data, automation, or enterprise application platforms
  • Ability to independently deliver moderately complex technical assignments while collaborating effectively within a cross-functional team
  • Ability to quickly learn unfamiliar technologies, platforms, and business processes
  • Interest in Amgen-preferred platforms/tools such as Databricks, AWS, and others
  • Eagerness to learn and grow in a software development environment

Functional Skills:

Must-Have Skills

  • Strong understanding of software architecture, modular development, design patterns, and maintainable application design
  • Proficiency in developing production-ready applications, services, data solutions, or automation using Python
  • Proficiency in SQL, relational data concepts, data transformations, and troubleshooting data-related issues
  • Strong ability to debug, investigate, and resolve software, integration, infrastructure, and data problems
  • Experience developing automation solutions using Python and one or more scripting, workflow automation, or low-code technologies such as PowerShell, Bash, Power Automate, Power Apps, or n8n
  • Experience developing or integrating APIs, web services, microservices, event-driven solutions, or enterprise application interfaces
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, automated builds, automated deployment, application monitoring, logging, and operational support
  • Working knowledge of source-control and release-management practices using tools such as Git and GitLab
  • Experience troubleshooting production issues and participating in incident response, root-cause analysis, and remediation
  • Working knowledge of application security concepts, including secrets management, certificates, authentication, authorization, and access controls
  • Experience working within Agile or Scrum delivery methodologies
  • Ability to create clear technical documentation, including designs, diagrams, configuration instructions, and operational support procedures
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders and collaborate across global, virtual, and cross-functional teams

Good-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience delivering enterprise-grade software to production within a global, highly regulated, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology environment
  • Experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, or related data-engineering technologies
  • Experience supporting applications or business stakeholders using integrations with technologies such as Salesforce, Tableau, Power BI, Databricks, AWS, or GitLab
  • Experience building and deploying containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, Rafay, AWS ECR, AWS EKS, AWS ECS, or Fargate
  • Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, or infrastructure-as-code technologies
  • Experience integrating AI services, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, or intelligent automation into business applications and internal developer tools
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools while maintaining appropriate controls for code quality, intellectual property, privacy, and cybersecurity
  • Experience with application monitoring, observability, alerting, and performance-management technologies
  • Familiarity with secure software-development practices, vulnerability remediation, identity integration, and cloud security controls
  • Working understanding of business operations in one or more of the following Drug Development Life Cycle areas: Research and Development, Commercialization, Operations, Process Development, Commercial, or Marketing
  • Experience working with geographically distributed development teams, vendors, business stakeholders, or managed-service providers
  • Relevant certifications in cloud technologies, software development, data engineering, DevOps, cybersecurity, Agile, or enterprise platforms

Soft Skills:

  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and structured problem-solving skills
  • High degree of initiative, accountability, and self-motivation
  • Ability to independently organize and complete assigned work while appropriately seeking guidance and escalating risks
  • Ability to work effectively with global, virtual, cross-functional, and multidisciplinary teams
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to software quality, security, documentation, and operational reliability

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts

  • Stock-based long-term incentives

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. What do we need?

As Manager, Professional Services, North America, you will lead a team of technical and scientific Professional Services consultants delivering complex solutions to our enterprise R&D customers.

This role has a particular focus on Lab Orchestration. You will bring experience of laboratory automation, instrument integration and scientific workflows, helping Dotmatics develop and scale its Lab Orchestration services capability while ensuring successful delivery for our customers.

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of technical and scientific Professional Services professionals across North America.
  • Build capability within the team through coaching, career development, skills planning and recruitment.
  • Provide leadership and subject-matter guidance for Lab Orchestration and laboratory automation engagements, including instrument integration, scientific data flows and laboratory workflow transformation.
  • Support the development of Dotmatics' Lab Orchestration delivery methodology, implementation patterns, best practices and reusable knowledge.
  • Provide oversight and governance for complex and strategic customer programmes, particularly where multiple technologies, workstreams or delivery teams are involved.
  • Lead or support strategic customer engagements from discovery and proof of concept through implementation and production adoption.
  • Act as a senior consultant to customers, helping translate scientific and laboratory workflows into practical technical and service solutions.
  • Work closely with Sales and Solutions teams during pre-contract and solution-definition activities to ensure proposed solutions are achievable, appropriately scoped and commercially viable.

  • Review Statements of Work and Services agreements in partnership with Sales and Legal, providing Services, delivery and contractual input where appropriate.

  • Manage subcontractors and delivery partners where appropriate, ensuring quality and accountability remain consistent with Dotmatics standards.
  • Conduct solution and delivery peer reviews on strategically important or high-risk engagements.
  • Identify operational improvements that increase quality, repeatability, efficiency and scalability across Professional Services.
  • Communicate and collaborate effectively within a multinational, cross-functional organisation including Project Management, Solutions Architects, Application Scientists, Developers, Sales, Engineering, Customer Success and Product.

We are looking for people who have significant experience within Professional Services, consulting or enterprise technology delivery, combined with demonstrated people leadership experience.

The ideal candidate will have worked within scientific software, laboratory informatics, laboratory automation or a related enterprise SaaS environment, and will understand both the commercial realities of Professional Services and the complexities of delivering technology into scientific R&D organisations.

The key skills we are looking for

  • Leading, coaching and developing technical or scientific Professional Services teams.
  • Laboratory automation, Lab Orchestration, scientific instrument integration or closely related laboratory technologies.

  • Identifying opportunities to use automation and emerging technologies, including AI, to improve the efficiency and scalability of Professional Services delivery.
  • Managing multiple concurrent customer engagements and identifying delivery, technical and commercial risk.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description The CompanyWe’re Tallwave, a growth partner that helps organizations turn disconnected growth efforts into connected growth systems.
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Company

We’re Tallwave, a growth partner that helps organizations turn disconnected growth efforts into connected growth systems. We’re a curious, ambitious team of strategic thinkers and creative problem solvers who understand our clients’ worlds deeply, challenge assumptions, and work across disciplines to solve the constraints holding growth back. We move with speed and discipline, embrace innovation, and hold ourselves accountable for meaningful outcomes. Our ambitions are too big to leave room for individual egos, so we value ownership, humility, selflessness, and the belief that our greatest success comes from what we can accomplish together.

The Person

Tallwave seeks out individuals who are a cut above. Their exceptional skill, diverse perspectives, obsession for winning together, and relentless pursuit of continuous self-improvement, both professionally and personally, give them an innate ability to lead, innovate, and inspire. They have well-honed philosophies and points of view in their areas of expertise, they think unconventionally, and their endless curiosity pushes them to constantly explore, learn, improve, and try new things.

The Job

We’re looking for a Marketing Strategist who can turn complex business and marketing problems into clear strategies that help teams execute.. You’ll help our clients understand where growth is constrained, who they need to reach, what they need to believe or do differently, and which marketing, experience, and channel decisions will have the greatest impact.

You’ll work across different growth models, from consumer brands sold through retail to subscription businesses to B2B companies selling through a buying committee. You’ll learn to recognize the economics and customer journey of each model before recommending what to do.

You’ll connect business strategy to marketing execution across positioning, messaging, audience, content, demand generation, digital experience, conversion, and measurement. You’ll work closely with strategists, designers, marketing engineers, and client teams to turn recommendations into action—and you’ll use data and research to continuously improve the plan.

This is a hands-on strategy role. We’re not looking for someone who wants to create decks and hand them off. You’ll participate in the research, analysis, workshops, planning, briefs, recommendations, and measurement that make the strategy real.

You will report to the Head of Delivery for now who runs the delivery practice, while working closely with practitioners across strategy, product design, and marketing and AI visibility. This role is an opportunity to help shape how Tallwave delivers modern, AI-enabled marketing strategy across our clients.

The Skills

The successful candidate will:

  • Diagnose the real growth constraint before accepting the clients brief, using the right business and marketing signals to understand where growth is being limited
  • Develop positioning, messaging hierarchy, and audience strategy and frameworks, grounded in competitive, customer and market researchConduct and synthesize buyer and customer research, including interviews, win/loss, review,sales-call mining, surveys, and behavioral data
  • Translate research and data into clear audience segments, customer needs, jobs-to-be-done, and actionable marketing opportunities.
  • Map the customer journey using available behavioral, CRM, web, commerce and marketing data and identify moments that influence awareness, consideration, conversion and retention.
  • Identify opportunities to improve conversion and customer experience, partnering with product designers and marketing engineers to turn strategic recommendations into better digital experiences.
  • Translate positioning and strategy into an integrated message and content architecture across owned, earned, retailer, paid, and sales-enablement surfaces, with briefs the content team and marketing engineer can execute
  • Develop integrated marketing plans that connect brand, demand generation, content, paid media, SEO/AI visibility, conversion, and customer experience around a common business objective.
  • Build business cases and prioritize marketing investments using practical financial and performance metrics appropriate to the client’s business model
  • Develop t channel recommendations across consumer platforms such as Meta, Google, YouTube, CTV, retail media, and B2B platforms such as LinkedIn, ABM, review sites and other relevant channels
  • Understand the role of AI-powered discovery in the modern customer journey and incorporate AI search visibility, generative AI, and AI-assisted research into strategy where appropriate.
  • Develop the measurement plans that connect marketing activity to meaningful business outcomes and use available data to evaluate performance, identify learning and recommend optimization.
  • Build clear strategic recommendations and present them confidently to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Contribute to engagement delivery from strategy through execution, partnering with the PM on workplans, resourcing, timelines, budgets, and quality.
  • Facilitate working sessions that help clients align across marketing, sales, product, creative, digital, and other agency partners.
  • Work closely with the Marketing Engineer to identify opportunities for automation, AI Visibility, experimentation, analytics, and technical implementation.
  • Use AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to accelerate research, synthesis, analysis, ideation, and strategic development while applying sound judgment to the outputs.
  • Identify the next problem worth solving before the client asks

The Requirements

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 3–5 years of experience in marketing strategy, growth marketing, digital strategy, integrated marketing, agency strategy, or a related discipline.
  • Experience developing marketing strategies that move beyond a single channel and connect audience, positioning, messaging, channels, content, experience, and measurement.
  • Demonstrated work across more than one growth model (consumer and B2B, or direct and retail), with a clear view of what works and what does not
  • Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business problems into structured hypotheses, research questions, recommendations, and actionable plans.
  • Experience developing positioning, messaging, campaign strategy, customer journeys, or integrated marketing plans.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data from tools such as GA4, CRM platforms, marketing automation platforms, research tools, or other business intelligence sources.
  • Working knowledge of paid media, SEO, content, CRM/lifecycle marketing, conversion optimization, and other major marketing channels—you do not need to be a channel specialist, but you need to understand how the pieces work together.
  • Strong understanding of how modern buyers discover, evaluate, and choose brands across search, social, AI assistants, marketplaces, websites, and other digital experiences.
  • Experience collaborating with designers, developers, marketers, account/project managers, and client stakeholders to move strategy into execution.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills, with the ability to turn complex information into a clear story and recommendation. Nice to haves include:
  • Familiarity with AI search visibility and how positioning affects what assistants recommend
  • Daily working use of Claude or similar tools for research synthesis and analysis

The Culture and Perks of Being a Tallwaver:

  • We embrace a maverick attitude. We’re willing to challenge convention and think beyond the ask.
  • We are committed to relentless pursuit. We’re curious with a focus on personal growth.
  • We value selfless teamwork, demonstrating strong leadership qualities with a knack for collaboration.
  • We are thoughtfully rigorous, with a strong work ethic and strong attention to detail.
  • We foster an environment of empathy and compassion for each other and our clients.
  • We are a diverse (and competitive, and hilarious, and sometimes a little crazy) group of coworkers. You know, the kind you actually want to grab a drink with after work.
  • We offer career growth and opportunity. We grow leaders here.
  • We recognize the contributions of individuals and teams throughout Tallwave and we stop to celebrate along the way.
  • We are surrounded by badass talent and clients -- our work has been featured in TechCrunch, Forbes, Wired, Product Hunt, and more.
  • We’ve been featured on the INC Best Workplaces List, the Phoenix Business Journal Best Places to Work List, and the AZCentral Top Places to Work List.

Benefits

  • We offer comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and 401(k) plans.
  • We provide employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability plans and life insurance.
  • We’re more concerned about how we work than where we work. We offer remote work and office hours flexibility as needed.
  • We trust our team and have a generous PTO policy.

Why You’ll Love Working with Us

Free to be you each and every day! We celebrate diversity and empower you to bring your authentic self to work, always. We know that diversity, equity, and inclusion is not about checking a box. It’s more than words; it is a pledge and a promise that Tallwave is passionate about pursuing. We recognize having an all-encompassing culture will help us learn and grow collectively and will continue to foster our mission of making everyone we work with wildly successful.

Physical Demand:

This job may require sitting for long periods of time, and minimal (if any) lifting. Some travel may be required.

Working Conditions

All employees are expected to operate in a professional home office environment and routinely use standard office equipment like computers, telephones, and teleconferencing equipment.

Position Applicants, please note the following:

At this time, this position is only open to applicants who are legally authorized to work in the United States and who are living in the United States. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship of any kind, so please do not apply if:

  • You are not legally authorized to work in the United States, or
  • You are not living in the 48 contiguous U.S. states, Alaska, or Hawai'i, or
  • You will require any kind of visa sponsorship.

Tallwave is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.


Artificial Intelligence Team

The Artificial Intelligence Team exists to amplify human potential through intelligent technology. We're building an AI-powered ecosystem that transforms how Vantage creates value, freeing our people from routine work so they can focus on innovation and strategic thinking that truly differentiates us in the market. Through responsible AI implementation across operations, engineering, and business functions, we're not just automating processes; we're reimagining what's possible when human creativity partners with artificial intelligence. Our approach centers on measurable business outcomes, ethical governance, and creating capabilities that make every team member more effective while positioning Vantage at the forefront of the intelligent infrastructure revolution.

Position Overview

The Director, AI Platforms leads Vantage’s AI platform strategy and operations, owning the Halo platform roadmap and Vantage’s AI FinOps practice while managing go-to-market packaging, program governance, and cross-team coordination for the entire AI organization. The Director translates the AI strategy set by the Head of AI into the Halo roadmap and delivers it, making Halo, Vantage’s secure, governed AI platform, easy for employees and business builders to access and use, and giving Vantage clear visibility into what its AI consumption costs and where that spend goes. This role owns three interconnected mandates: ensuring platform reliability and continuous improvement, driving enterprise-wide adoption through compelling value narratives, and providing the operational backbone that enables the Navigators and Accelerators teams to execute effectively. The Director builds and leads a team spanning platform engineering, product management, and program operations, creating the infrastructure and governance frameworks that transform individual AI experiments into sustainable enterprise capabilities. Success requires balancing technical platform excellence with business storytelling, operational discipline with innovation agility, and centralized governance with distributed execution. This is the role that ensures Vantage’s AI investments compound rather than fragment, creating shared foundations that accelerate every team’s impact.


Essential Job Functions

  • Build and lead the AI Platforms team spanning Halo platform and roadmap ownership, AI FinOps, go-to-market leadership, and program operations, developing capabilities that balance technical depth with business value communication.
  • Own the Halo platform roadmap at the director level and drive the health, performance, and continuous improvement of Halo, establishing reliability standards, monitoring frameworks, and an onboarding experience that make the platform easy to access and use while ensuring stability and enabling innovation.
  • Run Halo platform management, including support intake, bug triage, documentation and runbooks, and tiered support for the Halo platform and the AI applications built on it, including solutions delivered by the Accelerators team, as well as backlog prioritization, release and change management, and platform health reporting, along with builder onboarding that gets Business-Led Development teams the access, credentials, and development environment they need to start building.
  • Build and lead Vantage’s AI FinOps practice, delivering visibility into metered AI consumption, including Copilot credits, development and operational tokens, and Azure spend, by user, department, and business unit, and partnering with Finance, FP&A, and IT on forecasting, budgeting, optimization, and the showback and chargeback model that prepares business units to own their AI costs in FY28.
  • Drive enterprise-wide platform adoption through compelling value narratives, measurement frameworks, and user engagement strategies that demonstrate ROI and build organizational enthusiasm for AI-powered workflows.
  • Establish and maintain the governance frameworks, reporting structures, and coordination mechanisms that enable the Navigators and Accelerators teams to operate effectively while maintaining organizational alignment.
  • Partner with the Director, Navigators, Global to ensure platform capabilities are well-understood across functional areas, enabling Navigators to identify opportunities that leverage existing infrastructure rather than requiring net-new development.
  • Partner with the Director, AI Delivery, Global to ensure platforms provide stable foundations for rapid prototyping, with clear integration patterns and development standards that accelerate solution delivery.
  • Develop go-to-market strategies for AI capabilities that translate technical features into business value propositions, ensuring every AI solution ships with a clear narrative about why it matters to the organization.
  • Oversee cross-cutting program operations including executive reporting, inter-team coordination, portfolio health tracking, and governance compliance that provide the Head of AI with decision-quality visibility into organizational performance.

Duties

  • Recruit, onboard, and develop platform owners, adoption specialists, GTM leads, and program operations professionals, creating career pathways that retain high performers while building organizational capability.
  • Establish platform health metrics, SLAs, and monitoring dashboards for Halo, ensuring reliability standards are met while identifying opportunities for performance optimization and feature enhancement.
  • Design adoption measurement frameworks that go beyond usage counts to capture meaningful engagement, business impact, and user satisfaction metrics that demonstrate platform value to executive stakeholders.
  • Create go-to-market playbooks that package AI capabilities with compelling narratives, training materials, and support resources that drive organic adoption across the enterprise.
  • Build and maintain the program governance framework including portfolio tracking, resource allocation processes, decision gates, and executive reporting cadences that provide organizational transparency.
  • Facilitate cross-team coordination between Navigators, Platforms, and Accelerators, ensuring information flows smoothly and dependencies are managed without creating bureaucratic overhead.
  • Develop executive reporting packages that synthesize platform health, adoption metrics, delivery velocity, and business value realization into narratives that inform strategic decision-making.
  • Architect platform evolution roadmaps that balance stability with innovation, incorporating feedback from platform users, Navigator discovery insights, and emerging technology capabilities.
  • Improve the Halo builder experience by reducing time to first build, providing self-service access provisioning, and publishing golden paths and templates that remove common blockers such as permissions, credentials, and development toolchain setup.
  • Lead the migration of existing applications into Halo, partnering with application owners and IT to plan, sequence, and support each migration.
  • Build and maintain AI FinOps reporting dashboards and consumption guardrails, including per-user and per-department token and spend telemetry, budget alerts, and forecasts that flag overruns early and provide the reporting evidence required before any consumption reserve is drawn.
  • Establish data governance, security, and compliance standards for platform operations that meet enterprise requirements while enabling the agility needed for rapid experimentation and prototyping.
  • Partner with IT and Security on platform infrastructure, ensuring AI systems meet enterprise architecture standards, cybersecurity requirements, and operational resilience expectations.
  • Monitor competitive landscape and industry trends in enterprise AI platforms, evaluating build versus buy decisions and identifying strategic partnership opportunities that extend platform capabilities.
  • Design and facilitate platform community events, user groups, and feedback channels that build organizational engagement while surfacing improvement opportunities and feature requests.
  • Manage vendor relationships for platform components, negotiating terms that preserve flexibility while ensuring support levels meet enterprise operational requirements.
  • Contribute to AI strategy development by providing platform perspective on organizational capabilities, adoption readiness, and infrastructure investment priorities.
  • Handle additional duties as assigned by Leadership.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications highly desirable.
  • Extensive experience leading platform or product teams in enterprise technology environments, with proven track record building and scaling technology platforms that achieved broad organizational adoption.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise AI and cloud platforms, including Microsoft Azure and large language model (LLM) platforms, with hands-on experience managing platform health and evolution.
  • Experience with FinOps or cloud cost management for consumption-based services, including usage telemetry, forecasting, budgeting, and showback or chargeback models; FinOps Foundation certification a plus.
  • Experience running platform product management practices, including backlog management, bug triage, SLAs, release management, and developer experience for internal builders.
  • Strong product management or go-to-market experience with ability to translate technical capabilities into compelling value propositions that resonate with non-technical business audiences.
  • Demonstrated success building and leading diverse teams spanning technical platform ownership, analytics, product management, and program operations functions.
  • Experience establishing governance frameworks, program management structures, and reporting cadences that provide organizational transparency without creating bureaucratic overhead.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management capabilities with track record building trusted relationships across technical and business leadership in complex matrix organizations.
  • Strong analytical orientation with experience designing metrics frameworks, adoption dashboards, and business value quantification approaches for technology platforms.
  • Understanding of data center operations, infrastructure technology, or related industry contexts that enables credible engagement with business stakeholders about operational challenges.
  • Experience with enterprise AI governance, responsible AI principles, and compliance requirements for AI platform deployment in regulated or mission-critical environments.
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to present to executive leadership, facilitate cross-team coordination, and create compelling narratives about technology platform value.
  • Track record of operating successfully in fast-paced environments where multiple priorities compete for attention and organizational structures evolve continuously.
  • Collaborative leadership style with ability to influence across organizational boundaries, partner with peer directors, and maintain alignment without creating bottlenecks.
  • Travel required is expected to be 15-25% for stakeholder engagement, platform community building, and cross-team coordination.

Physical Demands and Special Requirements

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

  • This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits.
  • Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

About the role:

A Sr. Principal Analyst uses research and analytical skills to create thought-leading insights that help Sourcing, Procurement and Vendor Management and other IT leaders navigate software and cloud pricing and contracting. As a Gartner analyst, you will meet daily with senior-level clients to help them achieve their most critical priorities, driving performance and business outcomes. To support and build off these conversations, you will research markets, practices and trends as well as publish content and deliver live presentations.

Candidates must have current knowledge of Microsoft’s commercial programs, contracting models, pricing, and discounting approaches as well as a vision for how Microsoft licensing, and overall contracting and negotiations with large vendors, will evolve globally and regionally.

What you’ll do:

  • Provide clients and prospects with compelling, actionable advice regarding their Microsoft pricing and contracting needs, including negotiation strategies and ongoing vendor management, via virtual or face-to-face interactions.
  • Develop and publish innovative, high-impact insights on software pricing and contracting, especially Microsoft, via research articles, webinars, events, and client briefings.
  • Research, analyze, and forecast trends in software, SaaS, and cloud licensing to deliver forward-looking guidance.
  • Lead or participate in ideation and research discussions, collaborating across the BTI community.
  • Conduct in-depth analysis to diagnose client challenges, reframe their strategies, and drive business outcomes.
  • Be client-centric while also encouraging clients to engage regularly with Gartner.
  • Proactively work with the wider sales organization and deliver outstanding sales support to retain and grow the business.
  • Provide high quality and timely peer review and feedback. Drive team success by mentoring and supporting team members.
  • Represent Gartner’s insights and methodologies with credibility in client engagements and media interactions.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that drive team success.

What you’ll need:

Gartner analysts are viewed as the experts. This means you need to know your markets, vendors, trends, management practices, etc. and be able to see the forest and the trees. You should have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred.
  • 8+ years’ experience with a minimum of 5 years work experience in SaaS/software contract negotiations, technology procurement, category management, vendor management or software asset management within a buying organization, outsourcer, consulting firm, or reseller.
  • Extensive, recent, hands-on experience negotiating with Microsoft (within last 12 months).
  • Subject matter expertise in Microsoft licensing with understanding of the negotiation process, software and cloud services market trends, the global landscape, and reseller ecosystem.
  • Experience with software license compliance risk assessment, management, and/or mitigation in a software audit context, particularly with Microsoft, is desired.
  • Experience with other major vendors (e.g., AWS, Google, Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, or ServiceNow) is desired.
  • Executive presence with the ability to quickly establish credibility with senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills, with comfort delivering engaging presentations to diverse audiences. Able to clearly and concisely articular complex concepts, engage clients and respond effectively to questions.
  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data. Can effectively identify and apply patterns, concepts, and frameworks while defending from client challenges.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to produce high-quality deliverables under tight deadlines.
  • Self-motivated, collaborative, quick-learning, and comfortable working in a multicultural, matrixed environment.
  • Able to conduct occasional travel (usually no more than 25%), regionally and globally.

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Job Summary

The Customs Brokerage Representative III is responsible for performing advanced customs brokerage functions to facilitate the timely and compliant clearance of imported shipments. This position reviews and audits import documentation, classifies merchandise using the Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS), supports Participating Government Agency (PGA) requirements, and ensures compliance with U.S. Customs and other government regulations. The role requires strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills to resolve documentation discrepancies, support customers, and maintain operational excellence throughout the customs clearance process.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and submit customs entries accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Monitor and follow up on the customs clearance process for all assigned entries.
  • Review, audit, and validate commercial documentation to ensure compliance with customs regulations and customer requirements.
  • Classify merchandise using the Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) to support accurate duty assessment and regulatory compliance.
  • Coordinate freight movement and delivery to designated locations.
  • Communicate documentation discrepancies and clearance issues to customers, supervisors, carriers, and other stakeholders.
  • Interface with international and domestic carriers, overseas offices, importers, and government agencies to facilitate shipment processing.
  • Resolve finance, billing, and accounting reconciliation issues related to customs transactions.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and scan records into company imaging systems while meeting established deadlines.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, and analyses using various software applications and databases.
  • Research, troubleshoot, and resolve entry processing and documentation issues.
  • Communicate effectively with customers and foreign origins through verbal and written correspondence.
  • Establish and maintain positive customer relationships while providing a high level of service.
  • Conduct internal audits and provide findings and recommendations to management.
  • Support weekend and holiday coverage on a rotational basis as required by operational and account needs.
  • Perform general customs brokerage, administrative, and data entry functions as assigned.

Qualifications

Required

  • High school diploma, GED, or international equivalent.
  • Knowledge of customs operations, customs laws and regulations, and government agency requirements.
  • Basic understanding of the Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) classification system.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams.
  • Accurate and efficient data entry skills.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet time-sensitive deadlines.
  • Must be located within 50 miles of Dallas, TX.

Preferred

  • 1+ years of experience working for a Customs Broker or within a customs import brokerage environment.
  • U.S. Customs Broker License (LCB).
  • Experience working with customs brokerage software and import documentation systems.
  • Experience reviewing commercial invoices, packing lists, and other import documentation.
