About the game

Hopetown is a new narrative-first RPG inspired by Disco Elysium, being built by some of the team that worked on Disco Elysium, including Martin Luiga (founder of the ZA/UM Cultural Movement, writer of several characters on Disco Elysium, writer of the first short story in the Disco Elysium world), Lenval Brown (narrator of Disco Elysium) and Piotr Sobolewski (former CEO of Knights of U, which completed all the tech for Disco Elysium).

We are currently moving into early production, building out the foundational systems, characters, and mechanics that will define the experience. With your help, we can transform Hopetown from a great cRPG into an unforgettable one — a living, breathing universe of stories, surprises, and challenges.

About us

Longdue is a studio founded to create rich, emotional, story-first games that challenge players’ expectations. We’re a remote team of writers, artists, designers, and engineers, bringing together talent from across the industry to push the boundaries of narrative-driven RPGs.

We are still early in production, meaning new team members will have a real, tangible impact on the world we are building. We believe that extraordinary games can come from small, focused teams that value creativity, openness, and care over convention.

About the role

We’re looking for a Lead Narrative Designer with both creative and production instincts — someone who can shape Hopetown’s story while helping to build the systems and structures that make great narrative work possible.
You’ll lead a small team of writers through the early stages of development, balancing storytelling vision with clear planning, coordination, and delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with design, production, and tech to align narrative goals with development milestones and to ensure the narrative team’s output fits smoothly into the broader pipeline.
This role sits at the intersection of creativity and operations — ideal for someone who loves story but also thrives on clarity, structure, and collaboration.

Add to What You’ll Be Doing:

  • We’re looking for a Narrative Lead with both creative and production instincts, someone who can shepherd Hopetown’s story while helping us refine systems and structures that make great narrative work possible.
  • You’ll lead a small team of writers, balancing storytelling vision with clear planning, coordination, and delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with design, production, and tech to align narrative goals with development milestones and to ensure the narrative team’s output fits smoothly into the broader pipeline.
  • This role sits at the intersection of creativity and operations, ideal for someone who loves story but also thrives on clarity, structure, and collaboration.

Requirements

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years of experience leading and/or managing a narrative team on a narrative-first game, ideally in the RPG space.
  • Proven ability to plan, organise, and deliver narrative work within production milestones, experience coordinating pipelines, tracking progress, and aligning with design or production teams
  • Proven experience writing emotionally resonant, character-driven stories
  • Experience overseeing multiple writers’ work and overseeing edits to ensure cohesion in both tone and style
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Basic understanding of other disciplines and how their work integrates with narrative and design.
  • Familiarity with production and project management tools (e.g. Basecamp, YouTrack, or similar)

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience shipping or contributing to a narrative-driven RPG title, especially within a small or startup-style team
  • Strong familiarity with Disco Elysium-like, dialogue-heavy storytelling structures
  • A creative and adaptable mindset suited to an early-stage, highly collaborative studio environment
  • A love for narrative experimentation, psychology, and surreal or philosophical themes

Benefits

WHY JOIN US

Creative Freedom: We foster an environment where your unique voice and vision can shape a groundbreaking RPG.

Thought-Provoking Project: Help create a game that challenges conventions, offers a deep philosophical experience, and invites players to explore not only a mysterious world but also the depths of the human psyche.

Flexible Working: We are a remote-first studio, offering you the freedom to work from wherever inspiration strikes.

About us

At Longdue, we’re dedicated to crafting narrative-first, psychologically deep, RPGs.

We focus on creating games with real depth—whether in our characters, environments or the stories we tell. We’re here to challenge your choices, your morality—everything you think you know. We’re here to make games where decisions matter and have consequences. We want to build on the legacy of classic story-driven RPGs while reviving the genre meaningfully.

Our goal is simple: to become a trusted name in the greater RPG canon.

With talent from the original Disco Elysium team and veterans from the wider industry, including Bungie and Rockstar, we’re creating something new—a project that resonates, challenges, and leaves a lasting mark.

We’re Longdue, and we’re finally here.

The role

We are seeking a talented Writer to help craft an immersive, multi-layered RPG experience for our computer RPG in its early stages. The gameplay will focus on dialogue choices, character interactions, and a branching story where every decision has consequences. You’ll be responsible for creating narrative content that combines psychological depth, philosophical musings, and a richly evocative world that brings player choices to life.

Responsibilities

  • Write compelling dialogue and narrative events that deepen the connection between characters and the world.
  • Develop a rich story that explores the interplay between the physical environment and the protagonist’s mental journey.
  • Contribute to building a universe awash in contrasts, where environments from two interconnected worlds reflect each other in direct and mysterious ways.
  • Collaborate with designers, artists, programmers, and your colleagues in narrative to ensure the story is deeply integrated with gameplay, emphasising role-play and skill-based checks inspired by TTRPG mechanics.

Requirements

Must-have

  • Proven experience in writing for video games, especially RPGs or interactive fiction. Creative writing or screenwriting experience is also highly valued.
  • Ability to craft a story that explores themes of psychogeography, human psychology, and the dark corners of society. We want characters and dialogue that are multifaceted, flawed, and profoundly human.
  • Ability to develop environments that reflect the character’s internal state, exploring connections between space, mood, and psychology.
  • An interest in delving into cosmic mysteries, existential questions, and philosophical ideas about society, power, and individual purpose.
  • Capable of working within a creative team, taking feedback constructively, and contributing to the shared vision of the project.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with narrative-heavy RPGs.
  • Experience in crafting non-combat gameplay loops that revolve around storytelling, exploration, and character development.
  • Knowledge of TTRPG-inspired mechanics such as dialogue reels, dice-based checks, or psychological skill systems.
  • Experience writing in media other than video games.

Benefits

Creative freedom: We foster an environment where your unique voice and vision can shape a groundbreaking RPG.

Thought-provoking project: Help create a game that challenges conventions, offers a deep philosophical experience, and invites players to explore not only a mysterious world but also the depths of the human psyche.

Flexible working: We are a remote-first studio, offering you the freedom to work from wherever inspiration strikes.

Join Us: We’re here to make narrative-first, psychologically deep RPGs. If you’re passionate about storytelling, design, and pushing the boundaries of what games can be, Longdue is the place for you.

jobs.description:
Location: North America or Europe (inc. UK) | Timezones: UTC-05, UTC+0, UTC+1, UTC+2

Hunter is looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our fully remote team. This role is about using email, social, channel, and paid to help users reach their a-ha moment in the product, increase usage, and generate revenue.

You’ll be the go-to person for all things lifecycle, owning the strategy and execution of this critical area.

You’ll report to the Head of Marketing, and work alongside a cross-departmental team: Ana (Account Manager), Antonio, Chris (Design), Gio (Head of Customer Success), Istvan (Design), Jeanro, Matt (CEO), Rui (Product Manager), and Ziemek.

Requirements

At Hunter, Marketing is a corepart of how we generate brand affinity and revenue.

Hunter sits in a highly-competitive category with increasing noise, but thanks to its lineage as a first mover in 2015, it is an established, trusted brand.

In this role, you'll cut through that noise, joining a team of enthusiastic, highly-skilled marketers who take pride in their role as a caretaker of the brand. The touch points that we have with our users, as a trusted voice in a sea-of-sameness, are critical to growing the loyalty that millions of users have with Hunter.

Your goal is to own the entire lifecycle of our users so that more eyeballs see Hunter, more users find, verify, and send emails using the platform, API, and MCP server, and our brand continues to be the trusted voice in this category.

How marketing works at Hunter

Hunter's marketing has grown from SEO foundations. Over the last two years, more activity in research, content, email marketing, paid media, and affiliates have contributed to incredible growth.

Your task is to work on the onboarding and nurture engine that engages our users to promote our content, convert free users to paid plans, and increase the lifetime value of our users.

In this role, you need deep knowledge of this category, user empathy, and the stakeholder & project management skills to work with the Head of Marketing, Head of Customer Success, Product Manager, and our marketing team to deliver growth measured in free>paid conversion rate, lifetime value, and retention.

You'll walk into an established onboarding and nurture engine, dozens of campaigns, and co-marketing opportunities, and immediately hit the ground running, firstly by reviewing and creating rapid improvements to onboarding and nurturing, before turning your attention to planning and executing critical Q1 campaigns.

Ownership areas include:

  • Email marketing (onboarding, nurturing, retention, win-back, newsletters, and promotional)
  • Cold email marketing
  • Co-marketing with partners
  • Affiliate marketing campaigns
  • Social media
  • Written and video content creation (inc. blogs and webinars)
  • Reporting and insights

What you’ll do:

  • Own the user journey: You'll work cross-department to own the full user journey - from search and account creation, through to converting to a paid plan, increasing usage, and limiting churn - leveraging the full channel mix to engage, educate, and nurture users.
  • Increase free-to-paid conversions: Your core measurement is the ability to convert free user to a paid plan.
  • Establish and improve the nurture engine: You'll build a nurture engine that leverages user-behavior and persona signals to deliver personalized communications that builds brand affinity.
  • Promote content, research, and playbooks: You'll distribute highly-valuable content to help our users be more effective in their outreach, promoting webinars, guides, playbooks, the Outfoxed podcast, and monthly research.
  • Sales enablement: You'll identify users who might need help getting started, maximizing their plan, or with multiple users from their account and proactively engage them to support sales pipeline generation.
  • Channel marketing: You'll manage communications with our affiliate program and support co-marketing activities to engage new partners.
  • Agentic marketing support: You'll proactively develop, own, and continuously improve the use of AI in your workflow using Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini.

About you:

  • You have at least 5 years experience with a lifecycle marketing role, with proven success in building onboarding and nurturing that contributes to sales pipeline, won revenue, and retention in a PLG model.
  • You have deep empathy of our users and not only understand, but plan around the B2B buying cycle, creating timely, helpful, and motivating communication to our users as they go through their year and all it brings.
  • You take full ownership of the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of lifecycle marketing across the full channel mix, including email, cold email, ads, social, affiliates, and partners.
  • You are highly proficient at managing different projects, processes, and stakeholders (internal and external) to maintain control, communication, and success.
  • You have a curiosity to learn about, and connect challenges to messaging that engages, educates, and motivates increased product usage and brand affinity.
  • You are tech-savvy and a self-starter. we’ll train you on our system and tools, but you should generally be comfortable with technology, including customer.io, a CMS (like Wordpress), Canva, Claude, Planable, Posthog, Linear, and Notion.
  • You are data-driven (quantitative and qualitatively) and use an analytical mind to plan, execute, and experiment on campaigns and conversion rate optimization, employing small-bets to identify growth loops to invest further.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills, and integrate these skills into AI workflows.
  • You’re experienced in remote work and feel comfortable working independently, primarily through async communication.
  • Bonus points if you’ve worked with tools like hunter.io, understand this category, and have worked within it or in a related category (e.g. email marketing).

Time zone & work hours

This is a remote position, and we’re hiring someone based in North America orEurope (inc. UK) only.

Hiring process

Successful candidates from the application form will follow this steps:

  • Application review + written screening questions;
  • First interview with our Head of Marketing
  • Second interview with our Head of Marketing based on lifecycle marketing experience
  • Third interview with our Head of Marketing and CEO to present a campaign plan
  • Final interview with our team for cultural fit
  • Offer call for the selected candidate.

Learn more:

  • How We Hire

About Hunter

Founders, Salespeople, marketers, and recruiters use Hunter to reach out to the people that matter to their business. We index B2B data from millions of public web pages and make it convenient to explore with simple but powerful tools.

Hunter is the most popular solution for finding professional email addresses. It is used by 6.5M+ million people and leading companies such as Google, Cursor, Adobe, Microsoft, and IBM.

Hunter was founded in 2015 and is a self-funded company. We're a team of 25 people working remotely from Europe, North America, and Asia.

Twice a year, the team meets in a company retreat in Europe - those weeks are invaluable to improving collaboration and getting to know better the people you're working with. You'll need enough flexibility to join us in Europe for those company retreats.

Learn more:

  • How We Hire
  • About Us

---

ℹ️ A note on AI and how to apply

We’re genuinely interested in your personal experience, communication style, and problem-solving skills.

For that reason, we ask that you do not use AI-generated content in your application (CV, cover letter, or written responses). We’re looking to understand you - not ChatGPT or Claude. Any identification of AI being used to generate content at any stage in your application will disqualify you from the process.

Benefits

Being part of Hunter will also get you:

  • A yearly gross compensation ranging between $84,000-97,000, depending on experience
  • An automatic yearly raise of 5%

While design teams are aligned to individual product lines, this position connects that work through shared standards, design systems, and AI-enabled practices. You will influence quality across dozens of web and mobile experiences, partner with the branding team, and coach designers rather than own a single product’s roadmap.


If you hold strong opinions about craft, have an instinct for what customers feel but do not say, and can encode that judgment so other people—and agents—apply it at scale, this is the role for you.

What You’ll Do:

  • Set Experience Standards & Taste: Define what “good” looks like across the portfolio and encode it as standards, patterns, and reference examples that any designer or agent can apply without you in the room.
  • Make Coherence Scalable: Build a system in which experiences feel recognizably WEX in brand, tone, voice, and interaction regardless of which team or agent produced them.
  • Lead Portfolio-Level Critique: Lead critique and calibration that builds judgment in other designers and raises craft rather than policing it.
  • Anticipate Emerging Modalities: Bring a point of view on voice, conversational, and multimodal interaction so standards anticipate how customers will work rather than how they have worked.
  • Own the Design OS for the Agentic Lifecycle: Own the reusable components, skills, standards, and machine-readable context that agents invoke to generate consistent UI in ADLC Foundations Hub and Discovery & Delivery Systems.
  • Translate Design Intent into Build-Ready Artifacts: Partner with the design system engineer to create tokens, patterns, schemas, and documentation that both humans and agents can consume.
  • Make Quality the Default: Make the standard the path of least resistance, so generated experiences inherit accessibility, usability, and brand quality by default rather than by review.
  • Use AI-Assisted Coding and Prototyping: Use modern AI-assisted coding and prototyping tools to explore concepts, test interactions, and operationalize repeatable design guidance. Tools discussed for this role include Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex.
  • Define Experience Quality Measurement: Establish an enterprise experience quality rubric with dimensions, criteria, and severity scales for usability, accessibility, brand and voice coherence, language clarity, and end-to-end journey quality.
  • Build Agentic Evaluation at Scale: Develop evaluation capabilities that allow agents to navigate live customer portals, mobile apps, and internal tools across full journeys and return evidence-backed findings.
  • Make Quality Visible to Leadership: Produce a portfolio-level experience quality index and heat map showing strengths, weaknesses, and specific quality dimensions across lines of business.
  • Connect Quality to Business Outcomes: Correlate experience quality with NPS, CSAT, and customer trust measures, and use those signals to direct standards, coaching, and investment toward experiences where customer risk is highest.
  • Partner and Influence Across Teams: Work with product designers, engineering, and the branding team to unify experiences across WEX’s digital portfolio and raise the quality and polish of web and mobile products.
  • Coach Without Direct People Management: Coach and mentor designers across product teams, bringing exceptional visual/UI design taste and attention to detail while maintaining a collaborative, outcome-focused approach.

What You Bring:

  • Design Experience: Approximately 8–10 years of product, system, web, or related design experience across multiple products or portfolios.
  • Exceptional Visual/UI Craft: Demonstrated visual design taste, artistic judgment, strong attention to detail, and a high bar for polish and aesthetics across digital experiences.
  • Standards and Systems Thinking: Ability to define, document, and scale design standards, patterns, and systems that improve consistency and quality across teams and products.
  • AI-Native Design Practice: Strong fluency with AI coding and prototyping tools, including tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex, and the ability to use them practically in design workflows.
  • Machine-Readable Design Guidance: Understanding of how to express design standards and context in reusable, structured formats such as Design MD/design.md so people and AI agents can apply them consistently.
  • Customer-Centered Judgment: Deep customer empathy and the ability to translate customer needs, brand identity, tone, voice, and interaction principles into cohesive end-to-end experiences.
  • Collaboration and Influence: Low-ego, collaborative, and outcome-focused approach with the ability to influence designers and cross-functional partners without relying on direct authority.

Nice to Have:

  • Background in graphic design, web design, human factors, or another related artistic or design discipline.
  • Experience coaching or mentoring designers across multiple product teams or portfolios.
  • Familiarity with general-purpose AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini; this is useful but does not replace practical fluency with AI coding and prototyping tools.
  • UX boot camp experience.

Why This Role Matters:

WEX is working to unify the quality of digital experiences across business lines while expanding the use of AI in how those experiences are designed and built. This role will help shape the standards, systems, and evaluation practices that make high-quality, accessible, recognizable WEX experiences repeatable across dozens of web and mobile products. By turning design judgment into reusable guidance for both people and agents, the role helps WEX scale experience quality without relying on manual review alone.

Transportation Technology & Visibility

jobs.description:
Please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate introductions, referrals, or resumes from external recruiters or staffing agencies.

Location: Remote (U.S. based; must be available to work PST/MST hours)

Background Check Requirement

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

About Frontline Wildfire Defense

Founded in 2017 by landscape ecologist and fire mitigation expert Harry Statter, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME’s Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for “Most Innovative Housing Concept” and the Best of IBS Award for “Best Home Technology.”

As wildfires grow hotter and more frequent, our vision is to give people the tools and strategies to live safely with fire. We’re building a mission-driven team creating real-world solutions in wildfire safety and climate tech.

About This Opportunity

As a Senior Accountant at Frontline, you will be the person who keeps the general ledger in order - not as a task-completer, but as someone who cares about the integrity of what the numbers say. Frontline runs three revenue models simultaneously: milestone-based construction installations, bill-and-hold hardware product sales, and recurring software subscriptions. Underneath that, we have multi-entity operations, complex balance sheet activity, and a business that's scaling fast. The work is detailed, intellectually demanding, and consequential.

Reporting to the Controller, you will own bank and credit card reconciliations, balance sheet reconciliations, intercompany reconciliations, and the day-to-day accuracy of our general ledger. This is a role for someone who is not just comfortable with that level of precision - but who finds genuine satisfaction in it. If you like to solve puzzles, enjoy the feeling of every account tying out cleanly, and take pride in a ledger that's airtight, this is your seat.

Key Responsibilities

General Ledger & Reconciliations

  • Own bank and credit card reconciliations across all company accounts, ensuring every transaction is accurately recorded, categorized, and resolved in a timely manner.
  • Prepare and review monthly balance sheet reconciliations - accounts payable, accounts receivable, accruals, prepaids, intercompany, and other balance sheet accounts - with full supporting documentation.
  • Maintain the general ledger with a high degree of accuracy, posting journal entries and ensuring the ledger reflects the true financial position of the company at all times.
  • Investigate and resolve reconciling items promptly; track open items and follow through to resolution rather than leaving discrepancies unaddressed.

Month-End Close

  • Execute assigned close tasks within the month-end close schedule, including journal entries, account tie-outs, and flux analysis on key balance sheet and P&L accounts.
  • Prepare clear, organized work papers and reconciliation packages that can withstand audit scrutiny.
  • Partner with the Controller to identify opportunities to tighten the close timeline without sacrificing accuracy.

Accounts Payable & Receivable Support

  • Support AP and AR functions as needed, including vendor coding, payment processing, customer invoicing, and collections activity.
  • Ensure transactions are coded to the correct entity, department, and account, particularly as the company expands across multiple states and operating entities.

Compliance & Audit Readiness

  • Maintain documentation and internal controls that support audit readiness at all times.
  • Support external auditors and tax advisors by preparing schedules, reconciliations, and requested documentation.
  • Assist with multi-state sales and use tax compliance and payroll tax filings in coordination with the Controller.

Process Improvement

  • Identify inefficiencies in reconciliation and close workflows and propose improvements that increase accuracy and reduce manual effort.
  • Support the evaluation and adoption of accounting tools and automation that streamline transactional accounting functions.

Qualifications

Must-Have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 4+ years of accounting experience, with a strong foundation in general ledger accounting
  • Extensive, hands-on experience with bank reconciliations, credit card reconciliations, and balance sheet reconciliations - this is the core of the role
  • Deep familiarity with the general ledger: how it works, how entries flow, and how to identify and resolve errors
  • Detail-oriented and precise - someone who notices discrepancies, digs into them, and doesn't move on until accounts are clean
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online and Excel/Google Sheets
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, remote environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Nice-to-Have

  • CPA license or active CPA candidacy
  • Experience in a startup, high-growth, or multi-entity environment
  • Familiarity with construction accounting, including job costing and WIP schedules
  • Experience with accounting tools such as QuickBooks Payroll, Avalara, LiveFlow, or Sage Intacct
  • Exposure to ERP systems such as NetSuite, Acumatica, or Intacct
  • Experience supporting an external audit or preparing audit schedules
  • Background in climate tech, construction, hardware, or SaaS business models

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary: $95,000 - $115,000 DOE
  • Company-provided cell phone and laptop
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Flexible time off + 14 paid holidays (yes, your birthday is one of them!)
  • Work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup
  • Remote-first work environment, fostering work-life balance and autonomy
  • Company-provided equipment
  • Join a high-performing, mission-driven team doing work that truly matters
  • And much more!

Join Our Mission!

If you're excited about building technology that protects homes and families from wildfire disasters, we want to hear from you! Apply today and become part of a fast-growing team with purpose and innovation at its core.

Diversity and inclusion are essential values at Frontline. We know we'll do our best and most impactful work when we feel represented, and we belong. We encourage talented people from a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

About Cleerly

We’re Cleerly – a healthcare company that’s revolutionizing how heart disease is diagnosed, treated, and tracked. We were founded in 2017 by one of the world’s leading cardiologists and are a growing team. Most of our teams work remotely and have access to our offices in Denver, Colorado, New, York, New York, Dallas, Texas, and Lisbon, Portugal with some roles requiring you to be on-site in a location.

Cleerly has created a new standard of care for heart disease through value-based, AI-driven precision diagnostic solutions with the goal of helping prevent heart attacks. Our technology goes beyond traditional measures of heart disease by enabling comprehensive quantification and characterization of atherosclerosis, or plaque buildup, in each of the heart arteries. Cleerly’s solutions are supported by more than a decade of performing some of the world’s largest clinical trials to identify important findings beyond symptoms that increase a person’s risk of heart attacks.

At Cleerly, we collaborate digitally and use a wide variety of systems. Our people use Google Workspace (GMail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides), Slack, Confluence/Jira, and Zoom Video, prior experience in these areas is a plus. Role or department specific technology needs may vary and will be listed as requirements in the job description.

While we are mostly a remote company, travel is required for some team meetings and cross function projects typically once per month or once per quarter, for some roles like sales or external facing roles travel could be up to 90% of the time.
Cleerly is committed to providing safe and effective medical software that meets customer needs and our intended use. The adherence to all applicable regulatory and statutory requirements establishes a clear framework for setting measurable quality objectives. Our commitment to continually improving our products and processes proactively manages risks, ensuring ongoing compliance throughout the entire software lifecycle. Understanding this role's relevance and importance is critical to achieving Cleerly's quality objectives.

About the Opportunity

As a Senior Product Designer, you will employ your mature kit of human centered design methods to facilitate alignment of stakeholders to solutions that meet real user needs. While you might do some wireframing and interaction design, you are just as much of a user researcher, an insights synthesizer, a problem framer, a sensemaker, a journey mapper, an information architect, and a usability engineer. You are someone who takes initiative, drives your design process, and doesn't wait for internal Product Management or Engineering partners to tell you what is needed. In this role, you act as an alignment facilitator, leveraging a unique set of tools and skills to guide the team toward delivering user-centered solutions aligned with our mission to transform the standard of cardiac care and eliminate heart attacks worldwide.

About the Team

Cleerly's leadership in cardiovascular care innovation offers significant opportunities for passionate and mission-driven individuals. You will join a high-performing Product Design function that is valued and supported by executive leadership. We are committed to driving measurable impact across our products with a focus on improving customer delight, increasing adoption, and ensuring scalability.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Product Design: Lead the entire design lifecycle, driving projects from discovery through launch, managing deadlines, and facilitating stakeholder alignment.
  • Outcome-Driven Accountability: Directly drive a quantifiable reduction in operational friction by designing highly efficient, scalable, and error-minimized workflow solutions.
  • Design Craft & System Stewardship: Apply superior information architecture, interaction, and visual design craft to all deliverables. Actively contribute to and leverage Cleerly’s design system to accelerate product realization and elevate the quality baseline.
  • Feasible Design Delivery: Serve as a core partner to Engineering and QA, understanding technical constraints and ensuring that delivered designs are viable for efficient implementation.
  • Strategic Influence & Thought Leadership: Serve as thought partner to Product Management, Engineering, and Clinical teams, actively providing informed design perspectives and driving strategic cross-functional decisions.
  • Evidence-Based Optimization: Conduct deep discovery-type user research, defining audiences and mapping workflows, to identify friction points and opportunities for improvements within complex multi-user workflows.
  • Risk-Based Design: Perform regulatory-compliant human factors engineering activities such as task analysis, use-related risk analysis, risk-based formative usability evaluations, and actively contribute to the cross-functional risk management efforts.
  • Design Advocacy & Communication: Employ outstanding communication and storytelling skills to distill complex workflow issues into clear, engaging narratives, actively amplifying the voice and business impact of design company-wide.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 8+ years of professional experience in Product Design with a strong portfolio and case studies demonstrating expertise in complex B2B, analytics, and dashboarding solutions.
  • Comfortable working in afast-paced, innovative startup environment where changes are frequent, maintaining a positive attitude toward ambiguity.
  • Proven ability totackle complex products from start to finish with high autonomy, demonstrating a track record of driving and measuring quantifiable improvements in business and user outcomes.

Additional Requirements

  • Expert proficiency with Figma’s advanced features and familiarity with AI-powered user research tools for qualitative (e.g. Dovetail) and quantitative research.
  • Experience with rapid prototyping leveraging design systems and AI (Figma Make, Figma MCP Server, Lovable, 3Cursor, etc).
  • Experience in the HealthTech, SaMD, or other domains with complex data and specialized workflows.
  • Experience designing applications involving medical imaging or large-scale scientific data.

The base salary range for this role varies by location and is aligned to market benchmarks.

  • Candidates located in higher-cost labor markets, including California, Washington, New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Massachusetts, and Washington, DC represent the middle to high end of the range, while candidates located in all other U.S. locations represent the low to middle end of the range.
  • Final compensation is determined based on location, experience, skills, and internal equity.

DecisionPoint seeks a Front End Developer with strong Oracle Application Express (APEX) expertise to support the design, development, enhancement, and maintenance of web-based applications within a large federal and DoD-aligned mission environment. Leidos is seeking a Senior Proposal Managerto lead and manage the development of winning proposals for the US Navy SMIT contract. A successful candidate must thrive in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment while maintaining attention to detail and driving organization and structure throughout cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate will be interested in cross-training to be able to understand and support all aspects of proposal development including researching past performance, writing proposal sections, and supporting oral presentations.

This position supports telework.

Primary responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Lead and manage the overall proposal development process from Pre-Proposal through Post Proposal (negotiations) and award or cancellation.
  • Interpret technical and management requirements of SMIT solicitations (e.g., RFPs, RTEPs, RFIs) and contract modifications.
  • Support a variety of proposal types based on Federal Acquisition Rules for Cost Plus, Fixed Price, and Time and Material, as well as a variety of requirement types from staff support, NON-IT, to Complex IT/Network/Cyber.
  • In collaboration with Contracts and Program Managers support contract Task Order Modifications.
  • Maintain and log activity in for each assigned proposal in SalesForce, providing twice weekly updates including at least one on Friday.
  • In collaboration with SMIT Program Managers, create and oversee schedules, outlines, compliance matrices, proposal kickoffs, pricing strategies, Gate reviews and technical solution sessions.
  • Plan for and arrange resources such as proposal review teams, editing, graphics support, and desktop publishing.
  • As required - develop the business model for invoices and grouping of work elements.
  • As required - review and if necessary develop basis of estimate documentation to support proposals.
  • Facilitate proposal reviews (e.g., Initial Draft, Red Team) and oversee adjudication and tracking of reviewer comments.
  • Coordinate with management teams, functional units, Business Development personnel, stakeholders, partners, and subject matter experts to provide leadership, support, and guide overall direction of proposal development.
  • As required, edit proposals to ensure clarity of proposal solution and presentation.
  • Support and ensure all documentation supporting the development, production, approval (e.g., Gate review), and submission are completed for each proposal.
  • Support the initial stand-up new proposals in SMIT SharePoint directory and related support documentation is maintained in the appropriate file directories.
  • Support other operation activities such as managing content databases (Sales Force.COM) and SharePoint libraries in between live bids.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree with at least 8 years of relevant experience or over 15 years of direction experience such as federal government proposal management, volume lead, book boss, and/or proposal writing.
  • Excellent writing, organizational, and communication skills
  • Ability to work as needed to meet deadlines (nights, weekends, and holidays at times)
  • Ability to manage geographically disparate teams.
  • Experience with high volume task order IDIQ contracts.
  • Experience in leading multi-disciplinary business and technical teams to develop a winning and clear proposals (including clin definitions, work descriptions, assumptions, and basis of estimates).
  • Fluency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and SharePoint, and Salesforce.COM.
  • Candidates must be US citizens able to obtain and/or maintain a Department of Defense Secret security clearance as a condition of employment

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Working knowledge of Federal proposal processes and standards
  • Experience bidding on DON RFPs, especially modifications to existing contracts
  • Experience with Program/Project Management principles and concepts (WBS, PWS, IMS, RACI, Risk Management)
  • Prior experience with Navy programs
  • Ability to remain upbeat, positive, and constructive within a dynamic environment operating under high-pressure deadlines
  • Master’s degree with at least 6 years of relevant experience such as federal government proposal management, volume lead, book boss, and/or proposal writing.

Job Description

Candidates who reside in South Floridaare strongly preferred.


The role is accountable for performance and compliance for assigned protocols and sites in a country. Under the oversight of the CRA-Manager or CRD, the person ensures compliance of study conduct with ICH/GCP and country regulations, our company policies and procedures, quality standards and adverse event reporting requirements internally and externally. Acts as primary site contact and site manager throughout all phases of a clinical research study, taking overall responsibility of allocated sites. Actively develops and expands the territory for clinical research, finding and developing new sites. Participates in internal meetings and workstreams as SME for monitoring processes and systems.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Develops strong site relationships and ensures continuity of site relationships through all phases of the trial.
  • Performs clinical study site management/monitoring activities in compliance with ICH-GCP, Sponsor SOPs, Local Laws & Regulations, Protocol, Site Monitoring Plan and associated documents.
  • Gains an in-depth understanding of the study protocol and related procedures.
  • Coordinates & manages various tasks in collaboration with other sponsor roles to achieve Site Ready.
  • Participates & provides inputs on site selection and validation activities.
  • Performs remote and on-site monitoring & oversight activities using various tools to ensure:
    • Data generated at site are complete, accurate and unbiased.
    • Subjects’ right, safety and well-being are protected.

  • Conducts site visits including but not limited to validation visits, initiation visits, monitoring visits, close-out visits and records clear, comprehensive and accurate visit & non-visit contact reports appropriately in a timely manner.
  • Collects, reviews, and monitors required regulatory documentation for study start-up, study maintenance and study close-out.
  • Communicates with Investigators and site staff on issues related to protocol conduct,
  • recruitment, retention, protocol deviations, regulatory documentation, site audits/inspections and overall site performance.
  • Identifies, assesses and resolves site performance, quality or compliance problems and escalates per defined CRA Escalation Pathway as appropriate in collaboration with CRA-Manager, CRM, TA Head and CRD as needed.
  • Works in partnership internally with GCTO country operations, finance, regulatory affairs, pharmacovigilance, legal and regional operations, HQ functional areas and externally with vendors and IRB/IECs and Regulatory Authorities in support of assigned sites.
  • Manages and maintains information and documentation in CTMS, eTMF and various other systems as appropriate and per timelines.
  • Contributes strongly to CRA team knowledge by acting as process Subject Matter Expert (SME), sharing best practices, making recommendations for continuous improvement and providing training as appropriate/required.
  • Supports and/or leads audit/inspection activities as needed.
  • Following the country strategy defined by CRD and CRA-Manager, contributes to the identification of new potential sites and works closely with them to develop strong clinical research capabilities.
  • Mentors / buddies junior CRAs on process/study requirements and performs co-monitoring visits where appropriate.
  • Could perform Quality control visits if delegated by other roles and trained appropriately.

Extent of Travel:

  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 65%-75% of working time.
  • Expected travelling ~2-3 days/week.
  • Current driver’s license required.

CORE Competency Expectations:

  • Fluent in Local Languages and English (verbal and written) and excellent communication skills, including the ability to understand and present technical information effectively.
  • Excellent understanding and working knowledge of clinical research, phases of clinical trials, current GCP/ICH & country clinical research law & guidelines.
  • Excellent understanding of Global, Country/Regional Clinical Research Guidelines and ability to work within these guidelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor/lead.
  • Hands on knowledge of Good Documentation Practices.
  • Proven Skills in Site Management including independent management of site performance and patient recruitment.
  • Demonstrated high level of monitoring skill with independent professional judgment.
  • Good IT skills (Use of MS office, use of various clinical IT applications on computer, tablet and mobile devices) and ability to adapt to new IT applications on various devices.
  • Ability to understand and analyze data/metrics and act appropriately, also in a virtual environment.
  • Experience with conducting site motivational visit designed to boost site enrollment.
  • Capable of managing complex issues, works in a solution-oriented manner.
  • Performs root cause analysis and implements preventative and corrective action.
  • Capable of mentoring junior CRAs on process/study requirements and is able to perform co-monitoring visits where appropriate.

Behavioral Competency Expectations:

  • Effective time management, organizational and interpersonal skills, conflict management, problem solving skills.
  • Able to work highly independently across multiple protocols, sites and therapy areas.
  • High sense of accountability / urgency. Ability to set priorities and handle multiple tasks simultaneously in a changing environment.
  • Works effectively in a matrix multicultural environment. Ability to establish and maintain culturally sensitive working relationships.
  • Demonstrates commitment to Customer focus.
  • Works with high quality and compliance mind-set.
  • Positive mindset, growth mindset, capable of working independently and being self-driven.
  • Demonstrates and projects professional demeanor and communication consistent with organizational policies and practices.

Experience and Educational Requirements:

  • Fluent Spanish speaking skills required.
  • Associate’s degree, certificate or equivalent in a scientific / healthcare discipline together with at least 7 years of relevant experience in the healthcare field, including at least 4 years of direct site management (monitoring) experience in bio / pharma / CRO.

Senior Client Advocacy and References Manager


Intapp serves professional firms across highly regulated industries, and client relationships are among our most valuable assets. As Senior Client Advocacy and References Manager, you will build brand authority and drive pipeline by creating, maintaining, and scaling the advocacy infrastructure that lets Intapp engage those relationships consistently, serving both the client and the business.

You will own the enterprise client reference program and the broader advocacy program that sustains it. The reference program is the core: a structured, operational capability that gives sales, marketing, and other teams access to the right client voices at the right time, without overburdening individual advocates. The advocacy program is the infrastructure behind it, including the operating model, advocate population, participation standards, platform, and reporting that allow the broader organization to participate effectively.

What you will do

As a Senior Client Advocacy and References Manager, you can expect to:


  • Own and maintain the operating model for Intapp's enterprise client advocacy program, including intake processes, participation criteria, and program governance.
  • Establish and enforce standards for how client advocates are identified, onboarded, engaged, and recognized across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary coordination point for advocacy across the business, and drive internal adoption of program processes so the broader organization participates effectively.
  • Lead the rollout and ongoing management of the advocacy platform that will serve as the system of record for reference fulfillment and advocate engagement, including configuration, user enablement, and adoption.
  • Create and oversee processes that enable reference fulfillment for sales, analyst relations, and other teams requiring client validation, matching requests to the right advocates efficiently and without overburdening individual clients.
  • Develop and grow the advocate population by creating automations to identify advocates and working with client success and account teams, using signals such as NPS and CSAT data, to find clients who are positioned and willing to participate. Monitor participation levels and engagement patterns to identify gaps and keep the advocate pool healthy, balanced, and representative of Intapp's client base.
  • Partner cross-functionally with the events, marketing, and sales teams to identify and feature client speakers and voice at Intapp-hosted events and industry conferences.
  • Own program reporting, including advocate pipeline, coverage gaps, reference activity, fulfillment rates, and client participation metrics. Track program health indicators over time and give leadership a clear, honest view of program performance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the program, including process efficiency, advocate experience, and organizational enablement, and drive those improvements to completion.

What you will need

Intapp is looking for intellectually curious, self-motivated professionals who like to get hands-on to contribute to the overall success of the business and their team. To apply for this Senior Client Advocacy and References Manager role, you will ideally have:


  • 5-7 years of experience, including a demonstrated ability to build and manage program infrastructure: intake processes, reference tracking systems, participation frameworks, and reporting cadences.
  • Experience working across go-to-market functions (sales, customer success, and marketing) and coordinating shared workflows in a matrixed organization, plus familiarity with reference management platforms or CRM-based tracking tools.
  • Strong program management instincts: you can see where a process is breaking down, design a fix, and get others to adopt it.
  • A collaborative approach that builds trust with client-facing teams and influences without direct authority, with the ability to work across all levels of the organization, including senior leadership, and exercise influence diplomatically to drive alignment.
  • Clear written and verbal communication: you can explain program value to a skeptical sales rep and to a senior leader in the same week.
  • An organized, systematic approach: you track what matters, follow through reliably, and don't let details fall through the cracks.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to build structure in an environment that doesn't yet have it.
  • Experience in highly regulated industries or professional services markets is a plus.

How we will measure success


  • Advocate pipeline health: a growing, balanced population of client advocates that represents the breadth of Intapp's enterprise client base.
  • Reference fulfillment: on-time, well-matched reference delivery for sales and other internal stakeholders, with low cycle times and minimal advocate fatigue.
  • Internal adoption: measurable participation from customer success, sales, and other functions in program processes, rather than a bottleneck owned by one person.
  • Program reporting: a clear, consistent reporting cadence that gives leadership visibility into program activity, participation trends, impact, and outcomes.

What you will gain

At Intapp, you'll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You'll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that's connected yet flexible and where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities. We'll collaborate and grow together, supporting each other in a positive, open atmosphere that fosters creativity, innovation, and teamwork.

Here, you will have the opportunity to:


  • Expand Your Skills: Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career.
  • Enjoy Where You Work: Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energized throughout the day.
  • Support What Matters Most: Our comprehensive wellness and flexible time off programs and our benefits are designed to care for you and your family. Our family-formation benefits and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. We believe in giving back and supporting our communities with paid volunteer time off and a donation matching program for the causes you care about.

Join us and be a part of a collaborative and welcoming culture where your contributions are valued, and your professional growth is a priority. Together, we are building a company of long-term value that we can all be proud of.

what we offer

  • Bei uns wird Teamarbeit großgeschrieben! Neben Gesundheitszuschüssen bieten wir dir auch Team-interne Wertschätzungstools, um deine Leistungen zu würdigen. Zudem erwarten dich spannende Veranstaltungen wie unsere Internationale Co-Working Week, Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier und Team-Co Workings.

Company

About Us

Navitus - Putting People First in Pharmacy - Navitus was founded as an alternative to traditional pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) models. We are committed to removing cost from the drug supply chain to make medications more affordable for the people who need them. At Navitus, our team members work in an environment that celebrates diversity, fosters creativity and encourages growth. We welcome new ideas and share a passion for excellent service to our customers and each other.. Current associates must use SSO login option at to be considered for internal opportunities. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees and comply with all applicable nondiscrimination regulations, including those related to protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or handicap.

Pay Range

USD $96,594.00 - USD $118,400.00 /Yr.

STAR Bonus % (At Risk Maximum)

13.50 - Manager, Clinical Mgr, Pharm Supvr, CAE, Sr CAE I

Work Schedule Description (e.g. M-F 8am to 5pm)

M-F 8am to 5pm

Remote Work Notification

ATTENTION: Navitus is only able to offer remote work to residents of Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Washington DC, Wisconsin.

Overview

Due to growth, we are adding a Manager, Procurement to our team!

The Manager, Procurement is responsible for leading and overseeing vendor acquisition, financial evaluation, and contract support activities across Navitus. This role partners closely with business relationship owners, Legal, Compliance, Vendor Risk, and Finance to ensure vendor relationships are established, managed, and transitioned in a manner that supports business objectives, regulatory requirements, and financial stewardship. The Manager conducts market research, evaluates vendor capabilities, and leads procurement activities including requests for information (RFI), requests for proposal (RFP), return on investment (ROI) analyses, and negotiation support inclusive of service level agreements (SLAs).

This role also provides leadership and oversight to a team supporting procurement activities, with accountability for setting priorities, assigning work, and ensuring consistent execution of procurement processes and documentation. The Manager coaches and develops team members, reinforces standard methodologies, and establishes quality controls to ensure compliance with enterprise governance standards. The Manager will also supports the assessment and ongoing evaluation of existing vendor contracts, identifies opportunities for consolidation and renegotiation, and provides reporting on financial and operational impact. As part of the vendor lifecycle, the Manager supports onboarding and transition activities by coaching business relationship owners on effective vendor management practices and ensuring appropriate documentation, service level expectations, and financial controls are in place.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Partner with vendor and business relationship owners and subject matter experts (SMEs) to understand business requirements and translate them into procurement and contracting needs.
  • Conduct vendor research and competitive analyses to support vendor selection, budget allocation, and sourcing strategies.
  • Lead or support RFI and RFP processes, including evaluation of vendor responses and financial proposals.
  • Review and validate business cases, budgets, proofs of concept, and ROI analyses prepared by business stakeholders.
  • Jointly present vendor recommendations, financial analyses, and proposed terms to leadership for approval.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, and Vendor Risk Management teams on vendor risk assessments, FDR criteria, statements of work (SOW), and contract development.
  • Support the development of service level agreements (SLAs) aligned to business needs, in coordination with Vendor Relationship Management and other stakeholders.
  • Ensure financial obligations and performance expectations are clearly documented in contractual materials (e.g., MNDA, BAA, SOW).
  • Support vendor onboarding activities.
  • Analyze existing vendor contracts for financial viability, performance, and opportunities for consolidation or renegotiation.
  • Maintain procurement documentation, vendor inventories, and related tools, templates, and reporting artifacts.
  • Prepare and deliver reports and analyses on vendor performance, spend, and financial impact.
  • Identify and support process improvements, cost reduction initiatives, and opportunities for automation within procurement activities.
  • Assist with audits and other vendor related reviews as needed.
  • Provides leadership and oversight to the procurement team by setting priorities, assigning work, coaching performance, and ensuring consistent execution of vendor acquisition, evaluation, and contract management processes aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

  • Bachelor’s degree in business with a concentration in Accounting or Finance or similar field of study or equivalent work experience required.
  • Professional designations related to vendor procurement such as project management or other similar certification (i.e. Next Level Purchasing Association or the Universal Public Procurement Certification Council) required, or the ability to obtain with one year of hire.
  • 5+ years of experience in vendor procurement, financial analysis, or sourcing, preferably within healthcare, pharmacy benefits management, or information technology, required.
  • 3+ years of experience coaching, mentoring, or providing work direction to others, with demonstrated ability to support team performance, development, and consistent execution of processes required.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex vendor relationships and cross functional stakeholders required.
  • Participate in, adhere to, and support compliance program objectives.
  • The ability to consistently interact cooperatively and respectfully with other employees.

What can you expect from Navitus?

  • Top of the industry benefits for Health, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • 20 days paid time off
  • 4 weeks paid parental leave
  • 9 paid holidays
  • 401K company match of up to 5% - No vesting requirement
  • Adoption Assistance Program
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Educational Assistance Plan and Professional Membership assistance
  • Referral Bonus Program – up to $750!

jobs.description:
Global Revenue Manager, Remote (United States)

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and highly analytical Global Revenue Manager to lead revenue accounting and financial reporting across a complex, multi-entity global organization. This role will oversee a diverse revenue portfolio spanning SaaS subscriptions, hardware, professional services, and other recurring and one-time revenue streams across multiple business verticals and geographies.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in ASC 606 and IFRS 15, strong technical and operational accounting capabilities, and hands-on experience managing revenue processes within a global, high-growth environment. This individual will play a critical role in ensuring revenue is recognized accurately, timely, and in compliance with applicable accounting standards while continuously improving processes, controls, systems, and scalability.

This is a high-visibility individual contributor role requiring strong cross-functional partnership with Sales, FP&A, Operations, and other key stakeholders.

The Global Revenue Manager will serve as a subject matter expert on complex revenue arrangements, provide insight into revenue performance, and help strengthen the processes and systems that support the company’s continued growth. The role reports directly to the VP of Global Accounting, with a dotted-line relationship to the CFO.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Accounting & Compliance

  • Own global revenue recognition processes in accordance with ASC 606 and applicable international accounting standards (IFRS 15 where applicable).
  • Analyze and document accounting treatment for:
    • SaaS and subscription arrangements
    • Hardware and product sales
    • Professional services and implementation revenue
    • Multi-element and bundled arrangements
    • Channel partner and reseller agreements
    • Usage-based, milestone, and variable consideration models
  • Review customer contracts to determine appropriate revenue recognition treatment
  • Prepare and maintain technical accounting memos and revenue policy documentation
  • Ensure consistent application of accounting policies across multiple legal entities and business units

Close & Reporting

  • Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual global revenue close activities
  • Prepare and review journal entries, reconciliations, deferred revenue, roll forwards, and related schedules
  • Support consolidated financial reporting and revenue disclosures
  • Partner with colleagues to support audits, and statutory reporting requirements
  • Coordinate with regional accounting teams to ensure timely and accurate reporting across global operations

Systems, Processes & Controls

  • Maintain and improve revenue accounting processes, internal controls, and automation initiatives
  • Optimization of revenue systems in NetSuite
  • Identify process improvement opportunities to increase scalability and reduce manual effort
  • Ensure seamless billing from Salesforce to NetSuite
  • Analyze gross margin by product cost of sale evaluation

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Collaborate with:
    • Sales Operations on deal structuring, contract language and non-standard terms
    • FP&A on forecasting and revenue analytics
    • Tax on intercompany and global entity considerations
    • External auditors during quarterly and annual audits
  • Provide guidance to business stakeholders regarding revenue implications of commercial arrangements

Technical & Strategic Support

  • Monitor emerging accounting guidance and assess impacts to the business.
  • Assist with acquisitions, integrations, and new market expansion initiatives.
  • Support special projects related to revenue operations, compliance, and organizational growth.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance
  • CPAor equivalent certification strongly preferred
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting experience with significant focus on revenue accounting.
  • Strong expertise in ASC 606
  • Strong NetSuite experience, including Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) and Salesforce-to-NetSuite integrationssupporting customer invoicing, billing, and revenue recognition
  • Experience managing revenue accounting across a global, multi-entity organization with diverse revenue streams, multiple currencies, and foreign exchange considerations
  • Experience supporting SaaS/subscription-based business models alongside non-recurring revenue streamssuch as hardware and professional services.
  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management (ARM), including revenue arrangements, revenue recognition, and related reporting
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Deferred revenue
    • Gross Margin
    • ARM
    • SSP analysis
    • Contract modifications
    • Variable consideration
    • Multi-performance obligation arrangements
  • Experience with ERP and revenue automation systems
  • Advanced Excel and financial analysis skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • All other duties as assigned

What We Offer

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance Plan options.
  • 401k Plan with Employer Match
  • Paid Time Off Programs including vacation, sick leave, volunteer time off and parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Employee Referral Bonus Program
  • Career development and potential for advancement opportunities.
  • Performance bonuses
  • Employee Recognition Rewards Program

Uniguest is the global leader in providing highly secure, fully managed customer-facing technology solutions on an outsourced basis to the hospitality, senior living, specialty retail, education, and corporate sectors. Our suite of turnkey consumer-facing technology solutions includes hardware and software solution packages, system implementation, and 24/7/365 multi-lingual support for public space kiosks, purpose-built kiosks (PC, iMac, tablet), digital signage, Interactive TV, tablets, remote printing, and more – all designed to deliver a consistent and safe experience to our clients’ customers.

Corp Counsel III (Privacy, Digital Risk, and Cybersecurity)

What you will be doing:

Working as part of Premier's Privacy Office, the Corporate Counsel III (Privacy, Digital Risk, and Cybersecurity) advises Premier on compliance with applicable privacy, cybersecurity, and digital laws, regulations, and industry frameworks, including U.S. state privacy laws, HIPAA and HITECH, PCI DSS, and NIST.

This position will serve as the team’s principal legal specialist for cybersecurity regulatory compliance, while partnering with the Corporate Counsel III (Privacy, Digital & AI) on privacy compliance and digital risk oversight. The attorney will provide practical, risk-based guidance to Premier’s business teams, AI & Data Analytics organization, and Legal team.

This role will partner cross-functionally to continuously improve, operationalize, and evolve Premier’s privacy, cybersecurity, and digital governance programs. The attorney will work closely with the Security and Technology teams to translate applicable regulatory requirements into practical, scalable processes and controls supporting supplier privacy and vendor cybersecurity assessments, privacy impact assessments, privacy-related cybersecurity audit requirements, online privacy and digital compliance, and specialized privacy and cybersecurity contract negotiations. The attorney will also monitor evolving privacy, cybersecurity, and digital legal requirements and advise relevant stakeholders on their impact.

The ideal candidate is a highly proactive, business-minded attorney who enjoys building and evolving governance programs and processes, works well independently and collaboratively, and provides clear, decisive recommendations. The candidate should thrive in a fast-paced, complex environment and collaborate effectively with senior management, IT and cybersecurity teams, business teams, vendors, customers, and outside counsel.

Key Responsibilities


Responsibility #1– 100%

  • Support Premier’s regulatory compliance with applicable privacy and cybersecurity laws, and related industry frameworks, including proactively monitoring and interpreting developing laws and frameworks.
  • Provide legal oversight and guidance regarding Premier’s digital compliance risks, including website and application terms & conditions, online tracking technologies, digital accessibility requirements, digital asset disclosures, and employee data access policies.
  • Support enterprise innovation and growth by incorporating privacy, cybersecurity, and digital compliance-by-design principles from the outset of those initiatives.
  • Conduct enterprise legal risk reviews across privacy, cybersecurity, and digital matters, including privacy impact assessments, data subject rights requests, supplier privacy reviews, and vendor cybersecurity assessments, and support AI impact assessments involving privacy, cybersecurity, or digital compliance issues.
  • Contribute to continued modernization and development of Premier’s Digital & Data Legal and Governance organization, digital & data policies and procedures, and overall risk governance framework across privacy, cybersecurity, and digital.
  • Provide legal counsel for security and privacy incident investigations, mitigations, response, and regulatory reporting, partnering with internal stakeholders and external parties as needed.
  • Serve the AI & Data Analytics Office and Legal as a primary legal specialist across privacy, cybersecurity, and digital regulatory compliance and risk. Maintain related policies and contract templates, and draft and negotiate specialized or complex contract terms related to those areas.

​Required Qualifications

  • Experience operationalizing privacy, AI, and digital risk programs and related processes.
  • Familiarity with OneTrust, Transcend, or similar privacy or AI governance platforms.

Experience:

  • At least 5 years of relevant legal experience, preferably 5 to 7 or more years, advising on privacy, cybersecurity, digital compliance, technology, or related regulatory matters in a law firm, in-house legal department, government agency, or comparable environment.
  • Substantive knowledge of U.S. privacy and data protection laws, including HIPAA and HITECH, state comprehensive privacy laws, state consumer health data laws, data breach notification laws, and other requirements governing the collection, use, disclosure, retention, and protection of personal information.
  • Demonstrated experience interpreting cybersecurity laws, regulations, and recognized cybersecurity frameworks, including the ability to identify legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements arising under authorities and frameworks such as FISMA, NIST, and PCI DSS and translate those requirements into practical guidance for Cybersecurity, IT, compliance, and business teams.
  • Hands-on experience conducting or providing legal oversight for privacy and digital risk assessments, including privacy impact assessments, records of processing activities, data subject request workflows, supplier privacy reviews, vendor cybersecurity assessments, and assessments of new products, technologies, data uses, or business initiatives.
  • Experience advising on digital compliance matters, including website and application privacy disclosures, online tracking technologies, cookies and consent requirements, digital terms and conditions, consumer-facing data practices, and accessibility-related legal requirements.
  • Experience supporting privacy and cybersecurity incident response, including conducting legal assessments, coordinating investigation and mitigation activities, determining contractual and regulatory notification obligations, preparing, or reviewing notifications, and working with affected business partners, customers, regulators, forensic providers, notification vendors, and outside counsel.
  • Experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating privacy, cybersecurity, and data protection provisions in commercial agreements, including data processing agreements, business associate agreements, cybersecurity addenda, incident notification provisions, international data transfer terms, and privacy and cybersecurity requirements in customer and supplier contracts.

jobs.description:
Covetrus is a global animal-health technology and services leader dedicated to empowering veterinary practice partners to drive improved health and financial outcomes. We bring together products, services, and technology into a single platform that connects our customers to the solutions and insights they need to work best. Our passion for the well-being of animals and those who care for them drives us to advance the world of veterinary medicine.

Commercial Excellence Expert

Über die Position

Wir suchen einen Experten für Commercial Excellence, der unser Commercial Excellence-Team verstärkt und dazu beiträgt, die kommerzielle Leistungsfähigkeit unserer Vertriebs- und Markengeschäfte in verschiedenen Ländern zu steigern. Die Position kann von unserem Standort in der Nähe von Darmstadt (Deutschland) aus ausgeübt werden. Zudem ist Remote-Arbeit möglich (bzw. ein hybrides Modell, falls Sie in der Nähe eines Standorts wohnen).


Es handelt sich um eine international ausgerichtete Schlüsselposition mit hoher Sichtbarkeit. Sie arbeiten eng mit den lokalen Führungskräften im Vertriebs- und Geschäftsbereich zusammen, um Wachstumschancen zu identifizieren, kommerzielle Kompetenzen zu stärken, Best Practices zu vereinheitlichen und nachhaltige Verbesserungen in den Bereichen Vertrieb, Kundenmanagement, Marketing, Kategorie- und Portfoliomanagement, Preisgestaltung, Umsetzung kommerzieller Strategien sowie operativer Abläufe voranzutreiben.


Sie verbinden strategisches Denken mit praktischer Umsetzung. Dabei nutzen Sie Daten, Erkenntnisse und Ihre Fähigkeit zur Einflussnahme auf Stakeholder, um lokale Teams bei der Leistungssteigerung, der Margenverbesserung und dem Aufbau skalierbarer Commercial-Excellence-Strukturen über verschiedene Märkte hinweg zu unterstützen.

Ihre Aufgaben

In dieser Rolle sind Sie länderübergreifend tätig und arbeiten eng mit dem lokalen Management, den Vertriebs- und Marketingteams sowie den Bereichen Operations, Finanzen und Shared Services zusammen, um die Vertriebsleistung, die Marketingeffektivität und das Kategoriemanagement zu optimieren.
