jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you’ll be responsible for:

Circle is looking for an experienced transactional attorney to join the Transactions team within Circle’s Legal department. This role will focus primarily on two connected areas: Corporate Development and Ventures, including mergers and acquisitions, strategic transactions, and venture investments; and Financial Partnerships, including agreements with banks and other financial institutions that support Circle’s reserve, treasury, and payments operations. As needs arise, the role may also support select commercial transactions involving Circle’s products and services for banks and other financial institutions.

Under the direction of the Deputy Assistant General Counsel, Transactions, you will work as a senior individual contributor and trusted advisor to Circle’s Corporate Development and Ventures, Treasury, and Financial Partnerships teams, and will partner with Business Development, Product, and other teams on select matters as needed. You will independently lead transactions from inception through negotiation, signing, closing, and, where relevant, implementation or integration. This role requires rigorous legal execution, practical business judgment, and a solutions-oriented approach in a fast-moving digital asset and payments environment.

What you'll work on:

  • Supporting mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, asset purchases, and other strategic transactions, including structuring, conducting due diligence, drafting definitive agreements, and coordinating signing, closing, and integration matters.
  • Advising on joint ventures, minority and venture investments, strategic partnerships with an equity component, and other non-ordinary-course transactions, including term sheets, investment agreements, side letters, and ancillary agreements.
  • Structuring, drafting, and negotiating agreements with banks and financial institutions supporting Circle’s reserve, treasury, and payments operations, including deposit, custody and safeguarding, account control, and cash management arrangements.
  • Serving as a trusted partner to Circle’s Corporate Development and Ventures, Treasury, and Financial Partnerships teams, leading transactions that involve Legal, Regulatory, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Corporate Governance, Product, and other stakeholders, and coordinating with outside counsel where appropriate.
  • As needs arise, supporting select commercial transactions in which Circle provides products, services, or technology to banks and other financial institutions, partnering with Business Development, Product, and Legal subject matter experts to translate business objectives into practical contractual terms.
  • Developing and expanding transaction templates, playbooks, diligence tools, processes, and metrics that increase speed, consistency, and effectiveness across recurring transaction types.
  • Helping design and lead the adoption of AI-enabled workflows across the Transactions team, rethinking how transactional legal work is structured and delivered, and using AI and other technology to improve diligence, contract review, issues lists, drafting, deal tracking, and other recurring workflows. Experimenting with new approaches, developing scalable processes and playbooks, and taking responsibility for reviewing and validating AI-assisted work product for accuracy, confidentiality, privilege, and risk.

How this role uses AI:

This role will use AI as a core part of day-to-day transactional work and will help shape how the Transactions team operates in an AI-enabled environment. We are looking for someone who is interested not only in using new tools, but also in rethinking how legal work gets done—identifying which parts of the transactional process can be redesigned, streamlined, or automated while preserving high standards of legal judgment and client service.

In practice, that means using AI tools to accelerate due diligence, review counterparty drafts against Circle’s playbooks and prior positions, prepare first drafts of issues lists, term sheets, and ancillary documents, and keep deal trackers and precedent current. The role will also identify recurring workflows where AI can improve speed and consistency, design and test new approaches, build and refine prompts, templates, and playbooks for AI-enabled work, and help other attorneys, interns, and business partners adopt effective practices.

The attorney remains fully responsible for the work. They will review and validate AI-assisted outputs for accuracy and legal judgment, protect privilege, confidentiality, and material non-public information, and follow Circle’s AI, security, and data policies. We are looking for someone who is curious, experimental, and excited to help rethink how a modern transactions practice operates, while using AI to augment—not replace—independent legal judgment.


What you’ll bring to Circle:

Core Requirements:

  • J.D. or foreign equivalent and active membership in good standing of at least one U.S. State Bar.
  • 7+ years of transactional legal experience at a leading law firm, an in-house legal department, or a combination of both.
  • Substantial experience with M&A and other corporate transactions, financial services transactions, or both, including structuring transactions, drafting first-turn agreements, leading negotiations and diligence, and independently driving complex matters through signing and closing.
  • Strong working knowledge of corporate and commercial law, sound business judgment, and the ability to coordinate legal, regulatory, tax, accounting, securities, and operational considerations while balancing legal risk, commercial objectives, and Circle’s strategic goals.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong ownership and organization, and the ability to manage multiple matters simultaneously in a fast-moving environment that is prone to rapid change.
  • Demonstrated familiarity with and practical use of generative AI in legal or other professional workflows, with sound judgment about when and how to use AI, validate outputs, and protect privileged, confidential, and material non-public information in a public company environment.
  • Passion for Circle’s mission and values, financial technology, and the potential of stablecoins, digital assets, and blockchain technology.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience with banking, deposit, custody, safeguarding, treasury, or other financial services agreements and/or seller-side technology or financial services transactions involving regulated financial institutions, digital assets, stablecoins, payments, cross-border transactions, or other fintech businesses.
  • Experience building, implementing, or scaling AI-enabled workflows, prompts, templates, playbooks, or tools for a legal team.

  • Adjust designs based on feedback from stakeholders or from broader technical challenges, constraints, or limitations that may arise during the production process.
  • Feedback on other proposed designs and requirements within the team, particularly in cases where it may affect the dependencies and connected interaction design.
  • You will be playtesting your games like crazy: prepare to mark your own homework and ensure that all the details in your direction have been (a) implemented according to your vision and (b) play as well as you thought they would. You need to make sure that all the visuals, graphics, animations, micro-animations, flow, music, and SFX click together in a way that will resonate with the player.
Strategic Responsibilities
  • Define and evolve our game direction to weave consistence and game familiarity throughout our universe of titles (where you are involved) while still giving us enough flexibility to try new things.
  • Discover how to incorporate elements of our branding into games or how our game direction style can become an intrinsic element of our corporate branding strategy.
  • Thoughtfully consider how games fit into the broader design language of the business and how an individual game’s direction may extend to sequels or series, particularly premier titles.
  • Develop creative concepts that meet the business objectives of the organization and that advance our brand and proposition strategy.
  • Understand what our competitors are doing differently and to help us identify elements that we may want to incorporate.
  • Work to streamline our game production pipeline to reliably deliver high-quality, fully polished games at pace.
  • Evaluate technologies that can help augment our game direction pipelines.
  • Keep an eye on broader design trends and tools, especially within the gaming and entertainment spaces, to ensure that we are keeping up with best design practices and exceeding customer expectations.
  • Provide thoughtful, considered feedback on the overall roadmap and design strategy.

ROLE REQUIREMENTS
Education, Qualifications, and Background
  • You must have worked in a game direction capacity for designing real money gaming slots. The more projects you can demonstrate, the better.
  • You must have led game projects that have shipped outstanding products for one or more major AAA land-based or digital slot manufacturers. Be prepared to discuss your roles in those projects and how you set the vision and shaped the final product.
Key Experience Areas
  • You must have a clear understanding and respect for our players, ideally knowing what they like, what they’re looking for, and how to give them more of the things they love. This should come from experience having developed a substantial body of work.
  • You need to polish every detail by weaving static artwork, animations & micro-animations, and music & sfx in a way that is compelling and immersive for the player.
  • You must be able to direct hands-on. Although this is a leadership role that will be working with orchestrating different teams, you will also need to produce clear specifications and guidelines directly illustrate your vision and expected execution for products. Be prepared to storyboard like a pro to communicate your vision.
  • You must be extremely comfortable working with game designers and mathematicians to visually develop conceptual mechanics and present them to players in a way that’s simple and easy to grasp. You must also understand mechanics and mathematics well enough to be able to find creative ways of display symbols, animations, and other complex concepts in a way that’s fun and intuitive to players.
  • You must be familiar with hierarchical game structures (read: symbol hierarchy) and communicating excitement, anticipation, and relative value in a way that is easily understood by the player.
  • You must be able to work with a wide variety of art styles, even if they are not your personal design style or preference. This is particularly important when working with valuable existing intellectual property that needs to stay true to the original.
  • You must understand technical constraints and creatively work around them when necessary. Although our approach is to design the dream and figure out how to deliver it, there may be practical considerations that you should intrinsically understand.
  • Having the ability to delve into graphic design, motion graphics, animation, or video outside of product and UI design is a plus.
  • Ideally you will have some technical background or knowledge. Understanding how developers build the interfaces and the challenges they face is tremendously valuable when designing games.
If you’re ready to set the vision, challenge the status quo, and create games that players genuinely remember, we want to meet you.

Job Position: Paid & Performance Marketing Lead

Company: Pro Coffee Gear

Location: Remote (Anywhere)

Type: Full-time

Reports to: VP of Product & Growth

About Us:Pro Coffee Gear is a fast-growing ecommerce and wholesale distributor of commercial and home espresso equipment. We serve cafés, roasters, restaurants, and serious home baristas with new and refurbished espresso machines, grinders, and accessories from the most respected brands in coffee. We’re building a disciplined, data-driven growth engine — and paid media is a critical part of that foundation.

The Role: We’re hiring a Paid & Performance Marketing Lead to own the strategy, performance, and evolution of paid acquisition at PCG. This role will manage and lead our existing Google and Meta ad agencies, while also setting the roadmap to progressively bring paid media in-house as the business scales.

You will be the single owner of paid performance — accountable for results, agency direction, channel expansion, and long-term capability building.

What You'll Own:

1. Paid Media Ownership & Agency Leadership

  • Own overall paid media strategy and performance across Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube) and Meta (Facebook & Instagram)
  • Act as the primary owner and point of accountability for external paid media agencies, channel-level strategy and prioritization, and budget allocation and pacing
  • Set clear goals, KPIs, and expectations for agencies
  • Review performance, challenge assumptions, and approve strategy
  • Ensure agency work aligns with PCG business goals, merchandising priorities, and creative and brand standards
  • You are not a passive agency manager — you own the outcome

2. Transition from Agency-Led to In-House Execution

  • Assess what should remain agency-managed vs brought in-house
  • Build a roadmap to reduce agency dependency over time and increase internal ownership of strategy and execution
  • Personally execute and optimize campaigns where appropriate
  • Define tooling, processes, and documentation required to scale in-house
  • Hire or develop additional paid media support as needed

3. Google Ads (Primary Revenue Channel)

  • Own Google Ads performance end-to-end, whether executed by agency or in-house: brand, non-brand, and SKU-level search; shopping and feed optimization; Performance Max (with strict controls); YouTube for upper-funnel education
  • Partner with merchandising to prioritize SKUs, manage inventory constraints, and support launches, refurbished inventory, and clearance
  • Ensure strong alignment between search intent, landing pages, and conversion tracking

4. Meta Ads (Demand Creation + Retargeting)

  • Own Meta strategy across prospecting (education-driven, high-intent audiences), retargeting (site, CRM, engagement-based), and product launches and promotional bursts
  • Direct creative strategy in partnership with internal creative teams
  • Review and approve creative testing plans and results
  • Ensure Meta is used to create demand, support high-AOV consideration cycles, and feed lifecycle marketing

5. Channel Expansion & Experimentation

  • Own testing and expansion into additional paid channels: Reddit, LinkedIn (wholesale, restaurant operators), affiliate and partner marketing, and influencer whitelisting/paid creator ads
  • Decide when experiments are agency-led vs in-house
  • Define clear hypotheses, success metrics, and scale/kill decisions

6. Measurement, Reporting & Forecasting

  • Own performance reporting across all paid channels and agencies
  • Track and optimize toward blended MER, contribution margin, paid revenue vs plan, and lead revenue conversion (30/60/120 days)
  • Build clear weekly and monthly reporting for leadership
  • Ensure attribution, tracking, and data integrity are solid and improving

7. Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with merchandising (inventory, pricing, promotions), lifecycle marketing (email/SMS, lead nurturing), creative (ads, landing pages, messaging), and sales/wholesale (lead quality, follow-up loops)
  • Translate company goals into actionable paid media strategy
  • Represent paid media in planning, launches, and retrospectives

What Success Looks Like:

First 3–6 months

  • Clear ownership and accountability over agency performance
  • Strong visibility into spend, performance, and ROI
  • Improved alignment between paid media, merch, and creative

6–12 months

  • More paid execution owned internally
  • Reduced agency dependency without performance loss
  • At least one new paid channel successfully tested
  • Paid media viewed as a predictable, scalable growth engine

Who You Are:

Required

  • 5–8+ years in paid/performance marketing
  • Deep experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads
  • Proven experience managing and scaling agency relationships
  • Strong analytical and financial mindset
  • Comfortable owning revenue and efficiency metrics

Bonus

  • Experience bringing paid media in-house from agencies
  • High-AOV ecommerce or B2B-adjacent experience
  • Shopify-based ecommerce experience
  • Experience in coffee, hospitality, or equipment-based businesses

Why This Role Is Compelling:

  • True ownership over a critical growth lever
  • Authority to challenge agencies and set direction
  • Opportunity to build a best-in-class in-house paid function
  • High-impact role with visibility across the business
  • Work on meaningful, long-consideration products

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule with opportunities for growth
  • Work remotely from the comfort of your own home
  • Join a dynamic and passionate international team in the exciting world of coffee

How to Apply:If you're ready to join our team and play a key role in shaping our talented workforce, please submit your resume in English (resumes in other languages will be immediately disqualified). We look forward to hearing from you!

Pro Coffee Gear is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
As a global medtech company, we are driven by our Vision of changing the trajectory of lives for a new day and our Mission to create ingenious solutions that ignite patient turnarounds. Our relentless commitment to patients and strong legacy of innovation in healthcare are the foundation of our future. If you're looking for a new chance, a new beginning, a new trajectory, LivaNova is where your talent can truly thrive. Join our talented team members worldwide to become a pioneer of tomorrow—because at LivaNova, we don’t just treat conditions — we aspire to alter the course of lives.

Talent Acquisition Partner


Helping LivaNova build the talent needed to accelerate growth. In this role, you will lead end-to-end recruiting for commercial and other business-critical positions that enable new product launches, market entry, product adoption, and rapid growth across LivaNova. You will partner closely with leaders to build the talent required to commercialize innovative therapies and scale the business successfully.

You will thrive in this role if you can anticipate talent needs, build pipelines before hiring demand peaks, and advise leaders on how to compete for specialized commercial talent in the medical device and healthcare markets.


What You'll Deliver

Commercial Talent Acquisition & Growth Hiring

  • Lead end-to-end recruiting for select sales, marketing, clinical, market access, and commercial leadership roles tied to product launches and market expansion
  • Translate commercialization plans, launch timelines, and growth targets into practical workforce and recruiting strategies
  • Build talent pipelines ahead of demand for specialized and hard-to-fill positions
  • Map and engage passive talent across medical device, MedTech, life sciences, and healthcare markets
  • Deliver high-quality candidate slates at the pace required for launch readiness and commercial scale-up

Business Partnership & Talent Strategy

  • Partner with business leaders to define the capabilities, experience, and timing needed to support commercialization
  • Provide market intelligence on talent availability, competitor hiring, location strategy, and compensation considerations
  • Use data and external insight to challenge assumptions, shape role requirements, and improve hiring decisions
  • Create a strong, high-touch experience for candidates and hiring leaders throughout the process

Operational Excellence

  • Manage a broad portfolio of searches with clear priorities, disciplined follow-through, and strong attention to launch timelines
  • Track and share recruiting progress, pipeline health, risks, and hiring outcomes to support fast, informed decisions
  • Develop creative sourcing approaches and adjust quickly when market conditions or business needs change

Experience & Background

  • 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment
  • Demonstrated success recruiting commercial talent for product launches, market entry, or rapid scale-up in medical device, MedTech, life sciences, healthcare, or a related industry
  • Strong understanding of the talent required to build and expand sales, marketing, clinical, market access, and commercial leadership teams
  • Advanced direct sourcing, talent mapping, and passive-candidate engagement capabilities
  • Credibility with senior leaders and the ability to influence role design, hiring strategy, and selection decisions
  • Experience with Workday or a comparable applicant tracking system
  • Bachelor's degree preferred

Valuing different backgrounds:

LivaNova values equality and diversity. We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment process is fair, transparent and free from unlawful discrimination. Our selection process is driven by the key demands/requirements for the role rather than bias or discrimination on the basis of a candidate’s sex, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, non-job-related disability/handicap or medical condition, family status, sexual orientation, religion, color, ethnicity, race or any other legally protected classification.


Notice to third party agencies:

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Recruitment Services Agreement, we will not consider, or agree to, payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event that a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without a previously signed agreement, we explicitly reserve the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency.


Beware of Job Scams:

Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons posing as LivaNova recruiters or employees. The scammers may attempt to solicit confidential, personal information, such as a social security number, or your financial information. LivaNova will never ask for fees prior/during/after the application process, nor will we ask for banking details or personal financial information in return for the assurance of employment. If you are concerned that an offer of employment might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for “See Open Jobs” on , and check that all recruitment emails come from an @livanova.com email address.

jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community The Senior Strategic and Operational Intelligence Analyst delivers proactive, forward-looking analysis of the cyber threat landscape and translates that analysis into direction and action for Humana's information security organization.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Strategic and Operational Intelligence Analyst delivers proactive, forward-looking analysis of the cyber threat landscape and translates that analysis into direction and action for Humana's information security organization. You will set the strategic threat picture that guides CTI collection, processing, and analysis while supporting the development of proactive countermeasures that reduce Humana's exposure before threats materialize. Working with operational analysts, the analyst ensures strategic analysis translates into operational outcomes by shaping what CTI tracks, what partners act on, and where Humana strengthens its preparedness. The analyst applies AI, automation, and disciplined analysis to identify what matters most, anticipate changes in the threat landscape, and lead action on priority cyber threats. The analyst is comfortable working directly with threat and security data, exploring patterns, testing hypotheses, and combining quantitative evidence with qualitative intelligence to produce defensible assessments and practical recommendations.

Main Responsibilities

Threat Prioritization

  • Own the actor and threat prioritization framework that guides CTI's operational focus, collection posture, and countermeasure development
  • Identify priority threats and actors relevant to Enterprise Information Protection, Technology, Business, and Enterprise partners; ensure prioritization reflects sector-specific and Humana-specific risk
  • Continuously update the prioritization frameworks as the threat landscape shifts, using AI and automation to help build and maintain them at scale, and ensure they are embedded in how the CTI team and its stakeholders make decisions

Threat Analysis and Reporting

  • Produce recurring and ad-hoc assessments of the current and projected threat landscape, framed for Humana-specific relevance and decision-making
  • Analyze internal and external threat, vulnerability, and security data to identify patterns, assess relevance to Humana, and distinguish meaningful changes from noise
  • Clearly articulate priority current and emerging threats and their implications in both written products and verbal briefings to internal and external stakeholders, including leadership stakeholders
  • Spearhead strategic threat perspectives in support of CTI's engagement with Humana’s strategic initiatives, ensuring policies and planning are proactively informed by the threat landscape
  • Generate industry-leading analysis from concept to delivery with limited direction, sometimes on tight deadlines

Countermeasures Development

  • Contribute to the development of proactive countermeasure packages that translate threat analysis into specific, prioritized actions for Detection Engineering, SOC, Threat and Vulnerability Management, and other consuming teams
  • Work closely with CTI peers and control owners to ensure recommendations are actionable, appropriately scoped, feasible, and tied to current threats

Program Maturation and Tradecraft

  • Influence the maturation and efficacy of the CTI program through continual improvement of analytic practices, tools, and services
  • Review and edit CTI finished intelligence prior to dissemination, ensuring adherence to industry-leading analytic tradecraft standards and reinforcing rigorous analytic thinking across the team
  • Apply AI and automation tools to enhance analysis, improve speed to insight, and deliver higher-impact intelligence outcomes; contribute to how the CTI team adopts and integrates AI into analytic workflows
  • Experiment with data sources, analytic methods, and tools to answer emerging intelligence questions; refine approaches based on what the evidence shows

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of intelligence experience, with meaningful time in all-source cyber threat analysis and demonstrated experience contributing to operational intelligence workflows
  • Demonstrated curiosity and hands-on problem-solving: comfortable exploring unfamiliar data, testing approaches, and adjusting an analysis
  • Experience with the cyber threat landscape, including prominent actors, TTPs, and sector-specific threat trends
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI tools and their application to intelligence analysis, including using AI to accelerate research, structure analysis, and maintain analytic products at scale
  • Experience analyzing structured or semi-structured data to answer intelligence questions, identify trends or anomalies, and communicate the limitations of the data and the confidence of resulting judgments
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to communicate complex subjects concisely
  • Experience conducting analysis of the cyber threat landscape and translating that analysis into direction and action
  • Working knowledge of security controls, enterprise technologies, telemetry, and defensive workflows, with experience partnering with detection, hunting, response, or vulnerability
  • Experience producing strategic intelligence products for senior leadership, including executive briefings
  • Demonstrated ability to influence program strategy and improve of practices, tools, and services
  • Ability to work independently, determine methods and priorities, and deliver under tight deadlines
  • Familiarity with structured analytic techniques, MITRE ATT&CK, and standard CTI analytic frameworks

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience partnering with detection engineering, SOC, or vulnerability management teams to translate intelligence into action
  • Experience integrating AI or automation into intelligence workflows, including collection, analysis, or reporting
  • Experience with ISAC engagement and information sharing across peer organizations
  • Relevant security certification

jobs.description:
What you’ll be part of

Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.

The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.

Who we want:

This is a role for someone who wants to work on a hard problem, deliver real impact and be pushed to be the best version of themselves. As a Provider Sales Director, you’ll be embedded in Provider Partnerships and report directly to the SVP of Provider.

You will own a critical component of Garner's provider segment as a quota-carrying seller, selling our solutions into hospitals, health systems, ACOs and clinically integrated networks, physician groups, and digital health companies. You will run the full cycle from prospecting through close, using Garner's own data as the centerpiece of the pitch rather than a supporting slide. This is a builder's seat: the segment playbook is still being written, and the person in this role will help write it.

What you will do:

  • Own and advance a provider-segment pipeline end to end, from segmentation and prospecting through close, carrying an individual quota against your assigned budget.
  • Build and deepen senior relationships across hospitals and health systems, ACOs and clinically integrated networks, physician groups, digital health companies, and healthcare consultants.
  • Run a data-driven sales motion: use Garner's own data and insights to shape strategy conversations with sophisticated buyers.
  • Partner with Product, Sales leadership, and Account Management, feeding market signal back into the roadmap and handing off closed accounts cleanly.
  • Contribute to a repeatable playbook for the segment: messaging, target-account strategy, and objection handling grounded in healthcare economics and provider risk.
  • Build working fluency across Garner's full product suite and match the right product angle to each buyer.

What we are looking for:

  • 5 or more years in fast paced selling environment carrying and consistently exceeding individual quote
  • Experience as a builder, helping design the selling motion as you go
  • Experience selling into into hospitals, health systems, or other healthcare provider organizations is preferred; if not, experience selling in other complex B2B SaaS environments
  • Executive presence: an articulate, compelling presenter who earns trust with senior buyers and sells with data rather than relationship alone.
  • Demonstrated quota attainment you can name: percentage attainment, President's Club, or marquee logos closed.
  • Intellectual curiosity and data fluency: you ask probing questions and ramp fast into a new data methodology.
  • Creativity when a deal stalls: you generate new paths to momentum rather than waiting on the funnel.
  • Comfort selling while product, pricing, and positioning are still evolving.
  • The instinct to pull in the right internal partners at the right moment, and to route market signal back to the people who can act on it.
  • A desire to do work that matters: and to be held to a high standard while doing it. You're energized by a mission with measurable outcomes, not just good intentions. You engage with AI tools as part of how you do your best work, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes that matter beyond your team’s metrics.

What you’ll get here

You’ll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.

At Garner, you’ll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It’s demanding by design. You’ll be challenged to stretch beyond what you thought possible and receive consistent coaching to help you grow and do the best work of your career. This isn't the right fit for everyone, and that's intentional. The people here are driven by what's at stake for real people, and that's what gives our intensity its purpose.

Compensation Transparency:

The target total compensation range (inclusive of base + commission) for this position is $230,000 - $250,000. Individual compensation for this role will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, and applicable laws. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive plan and benefits package, including: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k) with company match, flexible spending accounts, Teladoc Health, and more.

Few roles offer this combination: work that is genuinely hard, a mission that is genuinely important, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. If that’s what you’re looking for, we’d love to meet you.

Join Us in Redefining Care

At Advocate Health, we're committed to helping people live well by delivering exceptional care with compassion, innovation, and expertise. We're seeking an accomplished consumer insights leader to serve as our AVP, Head of Consumer Insights & Intelligence, helping shape how we understand consumers and translate that understanding into meaningful business, brand, product, and experience decisions.

In this highly strategic leadership role, you'll build and lead an enterprise Consumer Insights & Intelligence capability that moves beyond traditional research to proactively identify emerging consumer needs, behaviors, opportunities, and risks. You'll partner with senior leaders and teams across the organization to ensure the voice of the consumer is embedded in decision-making from the very beginning.


About This Opportunity

This is an opportunity to transform consumer insights into a proactive, enterprise-wide strategic capability at Advocate Health.

You'll define the strategy, operating model, and roadmap for Consumer Insights & Intelligence, connecting research, behavioral data, market intelligence, consumer listening, and foresight to create a deeper understanding of the people and communities we serve.

You'll also build a high-performing insights organization known for strategic thinking, compelling storytelling, strong consulting partnerships, and an ability to turn complex information into clear choices and action.


What You'll Do

  • Define and execute Advocate Health's enterprise Consumer Insights & Intelligence strategy, operating model, and capability roadmap.
  • Transform the function into a proactive strategic partner that anticipates emerging consumer needs, opportunities, and risks.
  • Embed consumer insights into strategic planning, marketing briefs, product development, experience design, and major business initiatives.
  • Develop strategic insights that uncover unmet needs, motivations, behaviors, barriers, attitudes, and emerging consumer trends.
  • Establish an enterprise Voice of Consumer and Experience Intelligence capability that connects consumer, prospective-patient, and patient listening across critical journeys.
  • Lead brand health and consumer perception measurement, including awareness, consideration, preference, trust, differentiation, competitive positioning, and market intelligence.
  • Build a foresight capability that identifies shifts in consumer expectations, culture, technology, healthcare, and competition and translates those signals into strategic choices.
  • Create knowledge-management and insights-activation capabilities that make consumer knowledge easier to discover, synthesize, share, and reuse.
  • Lead the research partner ecosystem and establish rigorous standards for qualitative and quantitative research, segmentation, concept and message testing, journey research, and other methodologies.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing insights organization with strong capabilities in synthesis, storytelling, strategic consulting, influence, and proactive point-of-view development.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Market Research, Behavioral Science, Psychology, Sociology, Economics, Business, Statistics, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in consumer insights, market research, customer intelligence, or related disciplines.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience, including experience advising senior leaders.
  • Deep expertise in consumer insights, market research, and strategic intelligence within complex, consumer-oriented organizations.
  • Expert knowledge of qualitative and quantitative research methodologies and the ability to select the right approach for different business questions.
  • Significant experience with brand health, consumer perception measurement, and competitive and market intelligence.
  • Experience designing or leading Voice of Customer/Voice of Consumer programs, journey-based measurement, and experience intelligence.
  • Ability to synthesize research, behavioral data, market intelligence, and other information into clear insights, implications, and recommendations.
  • Strong understanding of consumer segmentation, innovation and concept testing, communications research, journey research, and experience measurement.
  • Ability to identify emerging signals and apply foresight approaches to anticipate changes in consumer expectations, healthcare, and adjacent markets.
  • Exceptional executive communication, storytelling, consulting, and stakeholder-influence skills.
  • Strong strategic and commercial orientation with the ability to connect consumer understanding to growth, brand, product, and experience decisions.
  • Demonstrated success building, transforming, and developing high-performing research and insights teams.

Preferred

  • Master's degree or other advanced degree in behavioral science, research, business, analytics, or another relevant discipline.
  • Experience transforming a research organization from a reactive function into a proactive, enterprise-wide strategic insights capability.
  • Healthcare experience, or experience within another complex, high-consideration consumer industry.
  • Experience establishing enterprise brand tracking, Voice of Consumer, and knowledge-management programs.
  • Experience developing consumer foresight, trends, or emerging-consumer intelligence capabilities.
  • Familiarity with modern research, social listening, consumer intelligence, and knowledge-management platforms.
  • Understanding of how AI can enhance research, synthesis, knowledge discovery, and insight activation.
  • Relevant research, customer experience, or insights certifications are preferred but not required.

DISCLAIMER

All responsibilities and requirements are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities.

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only responsibilities to be performed by an employee occupying this job or position. Employees must follow any other job-related instructions and perform any other job-related duties requested by their leaders.

Our Commitment to You:

Advocate Health offers a comprehensive suite of Total Rewards: benefits and well-being programs, competitive compensation, generous retirement offerings, programs that invest in your career development and so much more – so you can live fully at and away from work, including:

Compensation

  • Base compensation listed within the listed pay range based on factors such as qualifications, skills, relevant experience, and/or training

  • Premium pay such as shift, on call, and more based on a teammate's job

  • Incentive pay for select positions

  • Opportunity for annual increases based on performance

Benefits and more

  • Paid Time Off programs

  • Health and welfare benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life, and Short- and Long-Term Disability

  • Flexible Spending Accounts for eligible health care and dependent care expenses

  • Family benefits such as adoption assistance and paid parental leave

  • Defined contribution retirement plans with employer match and other financial wellness programs

  • Educational Assistance Program

Note: Eligibility for programs listed above may depend on your FTE or status (e.g., full-time, part-time, per diem, temporary, etc.); please ask a Recruiter for more information during an interview.

About Advocate Health

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. It is nationally recognized for its expertise in cardiology, neurosciences, oncology, pediatrics and rehabilitation, as well as organ transplants, burn treatments and specialized musculoskeletal programs. Advocate Health employs 155,000 teammates across 69 hospitals and over 1,000 care locations, and offers one of the nation’s largest graduate medical education programs with over 2,000 residents and fellows across more than 200 programs. Committed to providing equitable care for all, Advocate Health provides more than $6 billion in annual community benefits.

About the role of Sr. Clinical Pharmacist, Trend Management Strategies and Programs

Premera is seeking a Senior Clinical Pharmacist to lead trend management, affordability strategy, and clinical program development for high-impact medications. This critical role supports pharmacy savings, member affordability, and cross-functional product development.

The Sr. Clinical Pharmacist researches, develops, implements, and communicates to internal and external stakeholders, and manages pharmacy initiatives, programs and services that ensure clinically appropriate and cost-effective use of medication aligns with, and supports Premera's clinical and financial goals. The ideal candidate has the ability to work effectively across the company with multiple stakeholders and can perform all the responsibilities of the clinical pharmacist with a greater emphasis on broader leadership, management and strategic deployment.

What you’ll do:

  • Develop clinical programs and products to manage cost and utilization trends of high impact medications.

jobs.description:
Join the ASI Partners family as a legacy person you can come back to or refer others to as a government career source and interview for a direct-hire REMOTE opportunity with a major subcontractor on a long-term contract (potential to 2029) serving a massive IT modernization effort at the Internal Revenue Service (IRS).

We are looking for a fully-certified Salesforce Solutions Architect with 5 years+ in architecture, ideally some time with PD2, and experience working on Salesforce/Mulesoft, Agile CI/CD, Security model, Apex, LWC, etc.

Having a Public Trust clearance, a SECRET level government clearance, or having a higher-level clearance would expedite your start date on the contract, but we will also consider strong candidates interested in government service that can stay in place for 4-8 weeks while the clearance process finalizes. WE CAN ONLY ACCEPT U.S. CITIZENS and will verify personal information after the initial interview was successful to move forward.

So, what is the major modernization effort?

Older modernization roadmaps lacked long-term retirement strategies for core mainframes so IRS leadership rolled out a new technical framework stretching through 2029 with heavy emphasis on building a Unified API Layer to unlock legacy data. The IRS plans to wrap up its move toward a single, unified Enterprise Case Management (ECM) system. This platform will consolidate siloed databases and allow employees to support taxpayers from a single interface.

Fiscal Year 2028 Target: This is the projected completion window for updating the critical Individual Master File (IMF). The IMF has processed individual taxpayer data since 1970 using outdated COBOL and Assembly Language Code. The IRS aims to fully convert this core code into modern, developer-friendly Java.

By establishing a solid data structure and robust DevOps pipeline (using tools like SFDX and Git), the subcontractor we are hiring for helps create the stable infrastructure required for the IRS Office of Chief Counsel, the Taxpayer Advocate Service, and the Office of Appeals to safely adopt these modern AI systems.

Tech contests and other perks in addition to great HR benefits

Among great benefits like three weeks PTO, parental leave, and top of the line options for medical/dental/vision benefits and 401K, our subcontractor holds AI application contests that can land you an additional $10K for a good concept, and sets KPI metrics which awards up to $20K additional for meeting those metrics. They will certify you for free including also Agentforce certification. There are other great perks such as optional trips for people interested in cross-project management and discount programs. The company is stable, growing, and has been around for 20 years.

They are looking for a number of people, including the below position, so if you do not meet the criteria for this one, ASI Partners will interview you and we can offer other options if you meet the qualifications for those. Please read the below for the job requirements and qualifications needed for this exciting multi-year project for the IRS and apply immediately if you are interested. We will be choosing our team in the next 20 days already so go ahead and apply now with a solid resume if interested.

Salesforce Solution Architect

A Salesforce Solution Architect leads complex programmatic engineering using advanced Apex, LWC, and legacy integration orchestration (REST/SOAP, CDC, Platform Events) in FedRAMP-compliant hybrid environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Solution Design and Architecture: Develops high-performance, reusable, and reliable Salesforce solutions, including data models, integration architecture, and automation logic .
  • Business Process Analysis: Identify opportunities to improve business processes through Salesforce implementation .
  • Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with project managers, clients, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure cohesive project strategies and effective collaboration .
  • Governance and Quality Assurance: Review developer work, participate in code reviews, and ensure adherence to Salesforce best practices .
  • System Administration Support: Provide support for internal and customer-facing Salesforce environments .
  • Mentorship and Leadership: Advise and mentor teams on technical and functional delivery, guiding best practices and solution implementation.
  • Project Lifecycle Management: Oversee full-lifecycle projects from requirements gathering to solution design, development, testing, and deployment.

Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Proven experience as a Salesforce Solution Architect or similar role.
  • 6+ years of Salesforce development; Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II (PD2) and AI Specialist required; demonstrated legacy integration and DevOps leadership experience
  • Strong Salesforce customization and configuration expertise, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Developer Cloud .
  • Experience with enterprise-level Salesforce projects using both agile and waterfall methodologies .
  • Current Salesforce certifications such as Certified Platform Developer I & II .

Position Title

Commercial Loan Operations Insurance Manager

Location

Hicksville, NY 11801

Job Summary

The Commercial Loan Operations Insurance Manager is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the commercial loan insurance function, spanning the full loan lifecycle from pre-closing insurance review through post-close maintenance, force placement, and insurance proceeds management. This role ensures that all insurance activities are performed in accordance with bank policy, regulatory requirements, and applicable flood regulations. The manager leads a team of insurance associates, serves as a subject matter expert and resource for internal business partners, and is accountable for the accuracy of insurance records across all relevant systems. This role drives operational excellence, team performance, vendor oversight, and continuous improvement within the insurance operations function.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Supervises a team of insurance associates responsible for pre-closing and post-closing insurance functions, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant processing and responses.

  • Oversees pre-closing insurance review for commercial loan transactions, ensuring all insurance documentation meets bank policy and standards prior to loan closing.

  • Manages flood zone determinations and flood insurance review and approval in accordance with applicable flood regulations.

  • Directs post-close insurance maintenance activities, including ongoing review and coordination with the insurance tracking vendor to ensure continuous and adequate coverage across the loan portfolio.

  • Manages the force placement process, including additional outreach efforts to obtain renewal certificates from borrowers and the placement of force placement charges to client accounts in accordance with bank policy.

  • Reviews and approves general ledger entries associated with force placement activity and insurance proceeds, ensuring accuracy, proper coding, and timely reconciliation.

  • Provides expert guidance and consultation to business partners, including relationship managers, credit, legal, and compliance teams, on insurance-related matters, requirements, and bank standards.

  • Assists with insurance proceeds and loss-related activities as applicable, including coordination with borrowers, insurers, and internal stakeholders to ensure proper handling and application of proceeds.

  • Ensures alignment across all relevant systems to maintain accurate and up-to-date insurance records throughout the loan lifecycle.

  • Monitors work queues, documentation, volumes, service levels, KPIs, and exception reports to ensure operational standards and SLAs are met.

  • Ensures compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, flood regulations, and audit standards.

  • Collaborates with credit, legal, compliance, servicing, technology, and vendor management teams to support insurance operations across the commercial loan portfolio.

  • Identifies and implements process improvements, system enhancements, and automation opportunities within the insurance operations function.

  • Supports internal and external audits, regulatory exams, and quality reviews by ensuring proper documentation and timely responses.

  • Provides coaching, training, and development to staff while fostering a collaborative and performance-driven culture.

  • Assists in operational readiness for new products, systems, and process changes impacting insurance operations.

ADDITIONAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Performs special projects, and additional duties and responsibilities as required.

  • Consistently adheres to regulatory and compliance policies and standards linked to the job as listed and complete required compliance trainings. Accountable to maintain compliance with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Required Qualifications:

  • Education level required: High School Diploma, GED of Foreign Equivalent

  • Minimum experience required: 4+ Years supervisory experience in a large commercial bank or related financial institution, with direct experience in commercial loan insurance operations or a related function.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate Degree (4 years or equivalent) ; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Experience with commercial loan insurance review, force placement, and insurance tracking vendor management.

  • Working knowledge of flood insurance regulations.

  • Familiarity with general ledger review, reconciliation, and insurance proceeds processing.

  • Working knowledge of regulatory requirements (e.g., FDIC, OCC) and internal controls as they relate to insurance compliance.

  • Familiarity with vendor oversight.

  • Process improvement mindset; Lean Six Sigma or similar certification a plus.

Job Competencies:

  • Thorough knowledge of commercial loan insurance operations, including pre-closing insurance review, flood compliance, force placement, post-close maintenance, and insurance proceeds management.

  • Strong understanding of flood insurance regulations and requirements, including NFIP standards and flood zone determination processes.

  • Familiarity with insurance tracking systems, vendor management platforms, and core loan servicing systems (e.g., ACBS, AFSVision, nCino, or equivalent).

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Word.

  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills.

  • Proven ability to manage operational teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  • Demonstrates a strong ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders by communicating clearly, engaging in proactive collaboration, and leveraging cross-functional insights. Aligns relationship building efforts with enterprise goals to accelerate performance and drive strategic results.

jobs.description:
About Backblaze

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $136M ARR and is the leading specialized storage cloud, managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We’re seeking a Red Team Security Engineer to join our team!

About the Role

The Red Team Security Engineer continuously validates whether vulnerabilities, configurations, identities, applications, infrastructure, and AI-enabled systems can be exploited by realistic adversaries. The role combines traditional offensive security with AI-assisted and agentic adversary emulation to validate exposure and continuously improve defensive controls.

Key Responsibilities

  • Emulate external attackers, malicious insiders, compromised identities, and autonomous adversarial agents.
  • Validate whether vulnerabilities and configuration weaknesses identified are reachable and practically exploitable.
  • Develop and execute realistic attack paths across web applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, identity systems, endpoints, and other enterprise services.
  • Use AI-assisted and agentic techniques for reconnaissance, vulnerability analysis, attack-path discovery, and controlled offensive testing.
  • Test AI applications and agents for prompt injection, tool abuse, excessive privilege, identity compromise, and other emerging attack classes.
  • Validate compensating controls and mitigations before or after deployment.
  • Conduct purple-team exercises with Security Analytics and Security Operations to validate telemetry, detection, and response effectiveness.
  • Translate offensive findings into actionable improvements to architecture, configuration, detections, and response capabilities.

Qualifications

  • Experience in red teaming, penetration testing, adversary emulation, or offensive security engineering.
  • Strong web, API, cloud, identity, operating-system, and network security fundamentals.
  • Experience validating practical exploitability and developing realistic attack paths.
  • Strong understanding of MITRE ATT&CK and modern adversary techniques.
  • Familiarity with OWASP Top 10 for LLM, OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, and MITRE ATLAS.
  • Scripting or software-development experience.
  • Experience safely using automation or AI-assisted techniques in offensive-security workflows.
  • Experience assessing cloud-native or AI-enabled systems, conducting purple-team exercises, or simulating autonomous adversaries is preferred.

Make an Impact as a Clinical Trial Associate at Worldwide

As a Clinical Trial Associate, you’ll play a vital role in supporting the successful delivery of clinical trials by providing essential administrative and project coordination support to global project teams. Your work will help ensure critical study activities stay on track, documentation remains accurate, and project information is maintained to the highest quality standards.

Working closely with Project Managers, Clinical Research Associates, and other study team members, you’ll contribute to the smooth execution of clinical trial projects through effective coordination, organization, and attention to detail. This is an opportunity to be a key partner to cross-functional teams, helping ensure that important clinical trial processes are completed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with applicable requirements.

Where You'll Work

This is a REMOTE role open to candidates based in Australia. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.

Travel requirements will be based on recruiter input.

  • Maintain project portals and perform quality checks to ensure documentation is current and accurate.
  • Support the preparation, distribution, and shipment of clinical trial documentation, including Investigator Site Files.
  • Manage document version control and submit project documentation to the Trial Master File.
  • Track and maintain project-related information, including site medical question and answer logs.
  • Prepare and distribute meeting minutes for sponsor, project, and internal management meetings.
  • Maintain accurate records of participating sites and study personnel.
  • Coordinate and track project-specific training assignments and completion across study teams.
  • Contribute to additional project and administrative activities as needed to support project delivery.

What You'll Bring

  • Degree-level qualification or equivalent experience, plus a minimum of one year of experience in a related role.
  • Proficiency in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently while also contributing as an effective team member.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and multitasking skills in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Working knowledge and understanding of ICH, GCP, and applicable FDA or EU regulatory requirements.

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

Utilization Review Specialist – Behavioral Health (Remote)

PHP/IOP | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM ET | $24–$26/hour

About the Role

Principles Recovery Center (PRC) are hiring a Utilization Review (UR) Specialist to manage insurance authorizations for adolescent and adult mental health, substance use, and co-occurring treatment.

Required: 2+ years of behavioral health UR/authorization experience supporting Partial Hospitalization Programs (PHP) and Intensive Outpatient Programs (IOP).

Responsibilities

  • Verify insurance benefits, eligibility, and coverage requirements.
  • Complete prior authorizations, pre-certifications, concurrent reviews, and continued-stay reviews.
  • Support medical necessity using ASAM, LOCUS, and CALOCUS criteria.
  • Obtain Single Case Agreements (SCAs) with out-of-network payers.

  • Track authorized units, coverage dates, and payer deadlines.
  • Collaborate with clinical and admissions teams to support continuity of care.

  • 2+ years of PHP/IOP utilization review, utilization management, or insurance authorization experience in a behavioral health facility.
  • Knowledge of ASAM, LOCUS, CALOCUS, and medical necessity standards.
  • Experience communicating with insurance payers and managed care organizations.
  • Strong case tracking, documentation, organization, and payer advocacy skills.
  • Proficiency with EMR/EHR platforms and authorization software.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Eligibility for DCF and AHCA Level 2 background screening.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Kipu EMR experience.
  • Multi-payer SCA, appeals, and denial management experience.
  • Familiarity with CPT, ICD-10, and DSM-5.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish.

Our Mission

AWA and PRC provide behavioral health PHP/IOP treatment across South Florida. Your work helps clients and families access care and stay connected to treatment.

Learn More: Principles Recovery Center

Salary: $24 – $28 / hour

Job Description:

The Facilities Program Specialist (FPS) provides essential monitoring and program analysis support to federal staff responsible for ensuring provider facilities operate in compliance with applicable safety, emergency preparedness, physical security, environmental, and regulatory requirements. The FPS assists with the coordination, documentation, and review of facility inspections and assessments, supports the evaluation of inspection records and technical materials for alignment with building and safety standards, and documents corrective actions identified during oversight activities. Following the completion of monitoring activities, the FPS prepares clear technical summaries, monitoring reports, and supports trend analyses that highlight risks, recurring compliance issues, and opportunities for improvement.


Position Duties:


  • Coordinate, schedule, and document facility inspections and assessments; maintain organized records of inspection artifacts and communications.
  • Review inspection documentation, reports, and supporting materials for consistency with applicable building codes, life safety codes, licensing standards, and other relevant industry requirements; documenting and summarizing key findings.
  • Assist federal staff in tracking, monitoring, and documenting corrective actions arising from inspections or on-site reviews; ensure timely updates and closure evidence are captured.
  • Prepare technical summaries, monitoring reports, and briefing materials that synthesize observations, data, and documentation. Ensure reports align with applicable statutes, regulations, and program policies and are submitted for review/approval within established reporting deadlines.
  • Analyze monitoring outputs to identify trends, recurring compliance issues, and operational risks across facilities; proposing data-informed recommendations for improvement to federal staff as appropriate.
  • Maintain complete and organized records of notes, tools, trackers, communications, and artifacts generated during monitoring activities in designated repositories (e.g., program SharePoint).
  • Provide technical guidance and compliance support related to care provider facilities, safety, and physical plant operations.

Qualifications:


  • Requires BS/BA degree in Facilities Management, Public Administration, or a related field plus 4 years of related work experience.
  • Proven experience evaluating condition of physical facilities and building systems (mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, etc.) against applicable federal, state, and local requirements, as well as legal codes.
  • Previous facilities management or building inspection experience and familiarity with permits, inspection reports, compliance assessments, and service and maintenance records.
  • Prior life safety standards or emergency preparedness experience a plus.
  • Excellent communications skills, both written and verbal.High attention to detail.

Responsibilities

Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA’s Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton helps deliver the systems and services that keep our nation’s skies safe and connected.

We’re looking for innovative professionals who thrive in mission-critical environments and are passionate about shaping the future of air traffic management. This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world’s most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.

At Peraton, you won’t just support the mission — you’ll define it.

Regional Logistics Manager – Radar System Replacement (RSR)

Position Summary

The Regional Logistics Manager coordinates logistics support for RSR sites within an assigned region, helping ensure equipment, services, and materials are available when needed to support radar removal, installation, testing, and return to service. The manager works closely with FAA personnel, Peraton regional managers and site representatives, radar vendors, subcontractors, and local service providers to maintain site readiness and resolve logistics issues.

This position also coordinates with radar vendors to track equipment movement, confirm delivery schedules, and identify transportation or material delays that could affect site execution.

Position Location:Remote (Some travel to RSR sites may be required)

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate site logistics and readiness. Identify each site’s logistics requirements before work begins and maintain a checklist of required services, equipment, delivery dates, and responsible parties.
  • Help sites acquire equipment and services. Arrange dumpsters, portable toilets, forklifts, cranes, material-handling equipment, temporary storage, and other items needed for site preparation, removal, installation, and cleanup.
  • Coordinate purchasing and funding approvals. Obtain quotes, prepare purchase or rental requests, and work with authorized procurement and program personnel to secure approvals. Track commitments against approved site budgets.
  • Track vendor equipment movement. Work with vendors and transportation providers to monitor radar equipment, installation materials, replacement components, and spare parts from shipment through site receipt. Maintain visibility into shipment status, expected arrival dates, delivery changes, and receiving requirements.
  • Coordinate deliveries and receiving. Confirm site access, delivery windows, unloading arrangements, storage space, and availability of personnel and equipment to receive shipments. Verify delivery documentation and coordinate resolution of shortages, damage, or incorrect shipments.
  • Support equipment removal and disposition. Coordinate packaging, loading, transportation, temporary storage, and approved disposition of removed equipment and materials in accordance with FAA direction and contractual requirements.
  • Manage rental and service schedules. Coordinate delivery, servicing, extensions, pickup, and closeout of rented equipment and temporary site services to support the installation schedule and control costs.
  • Maintain logistics records and accountability. Track rental equipment, shipments, receipts, service orders, costs, and outstanding requirements. Clearly identify ownership and responsibility for government, vendor, and Peraton equipment.
  • Resolve and escalate logistics issues. Address missed deliveries, equipment shortages, transportation constraints, and service-provider problems. Elevate issues that threaten site readiness or schedule milestones and recommend recovery actions.
  • Report regional logistics status. Provide routine updates on site readiness, equipment movement, upcoming deliveries, costs, and unresolved issues. Coordinate logistics activities with the Integrated Master Schedule and daily site reporting.
  • Support safe site operations. Coordinate appropriate equipment capacity, qualified operators, and required access arrangements with responsible site personnel. Ensure logistics plans account for site conditions and applicable safety requirements.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain/maintain required Public Trust clearance.
  • A minimum of 8 years of experience with a Bachelor's degree; 6 years with a Master's; a total of 12 years without a degree.
  • Experience coordinating logistics, transportation, procurement support, or field operations for geographically dispersed projects.
  • Experience arranging equipment rentals, temporary site services, freight deliveries, and material handling.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple sites and competing priorities while maintaining accurate schedules and records.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and tools used to track shipments, costs, inventory, and schedules.
  • Ability to work effectively with government personnel, vendors, subcontractors, and local service providers.
  • Ability to travel within the assigned region and meet applicable FAA facility access requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting radar, aviation, telecommunications, construction, or other technical infrastructure deployments.
  • Familiarity with FAA field operations, remote-site logistics, and government property accountability.
  • Experience supporting equipment removal, disposition, and installation activities.
  • Familiarity with integrated schedules, site-readiness reviews, and logistics risk management.

Measures of Success

  • Required site services and equipment are available before scheduled work begins.
  • Vendor shipments and equipment movements are accurately tracked and communicated.
  • Logistics issues are identified early and resolved before they affect critical milestones.
  • Site expenditures remain within approved funding, and rentals are closed promptly.
  • Delivery, receipt, and disposition records are complete and accurate.

#BNATCS

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.
