jobs.description:
About Us

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. 

Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!

As Business Development Manager, SaaS Solutions, you are responsible for driving new software revenue and opening new market segments across assigned accounts and territories, working alongside Copeland account-aligned Sales Managers. You will generate and win net-new SaaS business by unlocking software opportunity inside the existing customer base, by proactively opening accounts where we have no relationship today, and by identifying and developing new markets and verticals where our SaaS solutions can deliver value. Beyond pipeline generation, you will build the commercial case for adoption, create demand where no software budget currently exists, own the enterprise proposal and RFP/RFT process for complex opportunities, and develop the sales organization's capability to sell software alongside equipment. The role operates as a domain specialist and market-maker across accounts: it does not hold account ownership, and it holds direct accountability for SaaS pipeline generation, market development, attach rate, and recurring revenue outcomes.

As A Business Development Manager, SaaS Solutions, You Will:


Business Development & Pipeline Growth

  • Own SaaS pipeline generation, qualification and forecast accuracy across assigned accounts, territories and target market segments, with the majority of pipeline self-sourced.
  • Prospect proactively into new and underdeveloped accounts, including outbound and cold outreach to stakeholders with whom we hold no existing commercial relationship.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from initial engagement through to contract execution, aligning customer business needs with product capabilities and value proposition.
  • Work jointly with account-aligned Sales Managers to identify, prioritize and pursue software opportunity within their portfolios, and to agree upon shared attach targets on named accounts.

Commercial Development & Consultative Selling

  • Build quantified ROI and total cost of ownership cases covering energy savings, refrigerant loss avoidance, product loss and shrink reduction, maintenance efficiency, and emissions or compliance outcomes.
  • Structure commercial proposals that fit how customers actually fund SaaS operational expenses.
  • Consult customers on the digital journey through connectivity and remote visibility, energy management, fault detection and diagnostics, then full optimization and design of the land-and-expand path from first site to full fleet.
  • Identify and develop internal champions, and navigate IT, data and cyber security reviews in partnership with technical teams.

Sales Enablement & Proposal Management

  • Own the end-to-end RFP, RFT and proposal process for enterprise SaaS opportunities, coordinating with internal subject matter experts to develop high-quality tender submissions and commercial proposals.
  • Support account-aligned Sales Managers on large enterprise opportunities through stakeholder mapping, proposal coordination and sales support activities.
  • Drive continuous improvement and standardization of sales processes, proposal documentation and tender response practices across the SaaS business.
  • Maintain disciplined use of CRM tools and a consistent qualification standard to manage pipeline visibility, forecasting and account activity.

Market Development & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Organize and participate in industry events, trade shows and conferences to promote Copeland's SaaS and digital solutions.
  • Monitor and analyze market trends, competitive landscape and regulatory environments, feeding structured market and competitive intelligence into the product roadmap.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, technical sales, marketing, SaaS operations and customer success partners.
  • Build and sustain strong relationships with key customer decision-makers and internal stakeholders, and return post-deployment with measured value delivered to drive renewal and expansion.

REQUIRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, & SKILLS:


  • Five (5) or more years of quota-carrying software or SaaS sales experience, with proven attainment against a recurring revenue (ARR or MRR) target.
  • Demonstrated new-business hunting track record: the majority of pipeline self-sourced through outbound prospecting and market research, rather than inherited accounts, inbound leads or renewal-led growth.
  • Proven record of winning net-new business and displacing incumbent solutions in accounts with no prior software relationship, including identifying and developing new markets or segments.
  • Strong capability in pipeline development, opportunity qualification and forecasting.
  • Experience preparing enterprise proposals, RFPs, RFTs or tender submissions, and coordinating cross-functional input into complex, multi-stakeholder bids.
  • Proven stakeholder mapping and account strategy across complex, multi-site customer organizations, including the ability to reach executive, finance, IT and sustainability stakeholders independently.
  • Experience managing long-cycle consultative sales processes of six to twelve months with multiple decision-makers.
  • Sufficient technical aptitude to become credible quickly in HVAC-R, building systems or energy management, and able to hold a conversation with a facilities engineer and translate technical output into commercial value.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence, coach and enable a sales organization without direct reporting authority.
  • Strong organizational skills, with experience managing CRM systems, forecasting and pipeline reporting, and driving standardization of sales processes and documentation.
  • Resilience, self-direction and comfort operating without an established playbook.
  • Effective communication skills across customer, team and internal stakeholder groups, credible with both engineers and executives.
  • Travel up to approximately 50% is expected, across customer sites, field sales territories and industry events.
  • Legal authorization to work in the country of employment; sponsorship will not be provided.

PREFERRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, & SKILLS:


  • Seven (7) or more years of total B2B sales or business development experience, of which at least five (5) are in software, analytics or connected-services subscriptions.
  • Experience in HVACR, heating, refrigeration, building systems, energy or related technical sales environments, or a demonstrated record of acquiring deep technical domain knowledge quickly in a previous role.
  • Direct experience with building analytics, fault detection and diagnostics, energy management, remote monitoring, or IoT platforms.
  • Experience as the first or an early software seller within a hardware-led organization, converting an installed equipment base into recurring digital revenue.
  • Understanding of decarbonization and compliance drivers, including refrigerant regulation and phase-down, energy reporting and ESG or rating frameworks.
  • Exposure to contractor and service-partner channels, and to overlay, specialist or partner-sales operating models.
  • Experience owning or contributing to enterprise RFP/RFT response processes and standardizing sales enablement documentation, ideally in a platform, analytics or SaaS business.
  • Formal training in a modern sales methodology such as MEDDICC, Challenger or Command of the Message, alongside advanced consultative selling, account strategy or CRM-based sales management training.

Remote Work Arrangement:

This role is fully remote sales position. Copeland is committed to fostering a productive and connected culture, so you will have the opportunity to work with your team and leader to understand your team operating principles to collaborate effectively.


Our compensation philosophy is simple: we pay a competitive base salary, within the local market in which we operate, and reward performance during our annual merit review process. In accordance with Colorado EPEWA, the total compensation (base + bonus target) range for this role is $120,450 - $181,500 commensurate with the skills, talent, capabilities, and experience each candidate brings to a role.

Our Commitment to Our People

Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.

Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs: medical insurance plans, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) and more. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation and holiday leave. 

Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!

Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging

At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.

jobs.description:
About Us

Let’s go on an adventure together!

Hey there, we’re G Adventures. We’re one of the world’s leading small group travel companies, and we’ve always believed that travel isn’t just about where you go — it’s about how it changes you.

For the last 35 years, we’ve set out to do things differently. No cookie-cutter tours. No giant buses or cruise ships. And not to mention, as few selfie sticks as possible. Just real humans, travelling your heart out across the world with open minds and a non-stop desire to make our planet better, simply by exploring it.

At G Adventures, our DNA (or GNA, if you will) is built on belonging — where bringing your authentic self to work every day isn’t just accepted, it’s downright celebrated. For our office crew — you wanna rock a t-shirt with your dog’s face on it? We say go for it. For our Chief Experience Officers — you wanna hit the road and call some of the most epic places on Earth your home office? We love that — and we’ve got you. Wanna spend your days with people you genuinely like? Us too — and we’re pretty sure you’ll fit right in, wherever that is.

Now about that career of yours — this is the kind of place where you can spread your wings and truly grow into your role. The best part? You get to do it all alongside a passionate, freakishly talented, one-of-a-kind bunch excited to produce top-notch work and spread a ridiculous amount of goodness at the same time.

Feel like this could be the right fit? We think so too, and we’re already way too excited to meet you.

About the Role


The Regional Operations Manager role is a pivotal leadership position that is primarily responsible for the successful delivery of G Adventures’ comprehensive tour programme across Oceania. This is a dynamic and multi-faceted role that leads a diverse team to ensure sustainable business growth, operational excellence, profitability and quality. This role oversees supplier relationships, team development, and compliance, ensuring efficient, innovative, and customer-focused tour operations.


It also manages risk, fosters cross-functional collaboration and champions continuous improvement to uphold brand standards and safety. This role builds on a highly successful platform but with significant opportunity to drive continued growth and evolution of the Oceania region in the coming years.


We welcome applications from candidates from Australia or New Zealand, with a preference for Brisbane based (Australia) or Christchurch/Auckland (NZ) applicants, but please still apply if you are outside of these locations and meet all other criteria for the role.


What you'll be doing


Strategic Leadership and Regional Planning

  • Lead ongoing enhancements of operational and administrative processes, ensuring systematic and efficient workflow across regional operations, key suppliers and shared services functions.
  • Coordinate with Product and Strategic Operations divisions to manage product lines and inventory efficiently and profitably.
  • Ensure accurate regional overhead budget forecasting, spend and tracking
  • Contribute to strategic destination management functions, including product mix, inventory strategy, quality management and supplier mix.
  • Contribute to development and implementation of a regional staffing strategy across Regional Operations, Tour Staff, and Shared Services functions.
  • Ensure trips run to budget, and identify opportunities for cost reductions in collaboration with the Buying team.

Supplier and Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with the Buying team on supplier selection, vetting, and training.
  • Build and manage effective relationships with suppliers and DMC partners, ensuring consistent service delivery and clear communication at all levels.
  • Travel within the region to inspect hotels, transportation and suppliers; provide support, attend industry events and stay informed on new industry trends.
  • Develop the company’s presence within local tourism boards, associations and committees, promoting brand awareness and industry engagement in the region.
  • Ensure all operational areas uphold brand standards and properly represent third-party wholesaler brands as required.
  • Maintain strong communication and positive working relationships between regional operations, shared services functions and other internal stakeholders. Consistently review and manage workflow and processes.

Team Leadership and Development

  • Lead and manage a remote team of office employees and tour staff across the Oceania region, fostering a culture of trust, respect and accountability both internally and externally.
  • Oversee ongoing training programs for office employees, tour staff, and local operators to build leadership capacity and regional infrastructure that supports rapid growth.
  • Foster and promote company culture among office employees, suppliers and tour staff, enhancing engagement and alignment with company values and community tourism.
  • Support travel style training initiatives within the region to ensure consistent customer experience.

Operational Excellence and Quality Control

  • Regularly review traveller evaluations to identify trends, pinpoint areas for improvement and develop initiatives that add value to tours.
  • Champion the adoption of new systems, initiatives and programs in a fast-paced, constantly evolving global business.
  • Analyze international competitors and regional operators, consistently seeking value innovations and applying improvements across tours.
  • Lead the tour staff leadership team and suppliers in upholding and improving safety and quality standards across tours, vehicles, and accommodations.

Compliance, Risk, and Incident Management


  • Take an active role in managing critical incidents and emergencies in the field, coordinating communication and ensuring all relevant parties are kept informed.
  • Support the Operations team in developing and implementing contingency plans in the event of on-tour disruptions and adjustments.
  • Ensure effective, consistent and timely incident reporting from tour staff and suppliers.
  • Ensure safe, compliant tour operations across office and tour staff and supply chain, through adherence to all relevant laws and regulations.
  • Ensure adherence to G Adventures welfare policies and community tourism standards.
  • Ownership of the emergency phone roster, ensuring equitable distribution of out of hours responsibility across the operations team. The role is included in the emergency phone rotation, and acts as an escalation point on a shared basis also.

Communication and Content Management

  • Work closely with the Product team to verify the completeness and accuracy of all trip content, and tour staff resources, including trip details, brochure and web content, and trip flows.
  • Monitor and maintain communication channels such as passenger feedback and regional correspondence to ensure timely responses and issue resolution.

What you'll need to be successful


  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in the travel industry, with extensive travel experience in the region.
  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience in an operations leadership role.
  • Experience in new product development and supplier negotiation is desirable.
  • Experience developing and implementing systems and procedures to improve operational efficiency.
  • Proficient in office administration, problem solving and organizational management.
  • Proficient in working across a diverse suite of platforms, and the ability to
  • Ability to manage crises and take responsibility for the safety and well-being of others.
  • Ability to train, mentor and lead team members effectively.
  • Commitment to delivering high levels of customer satisfaction and ability to manage complex customer service issues.
  • Effective stakeholder management skills across a geographically and culturally diverse organisation.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship management skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize competing demands effectively.
  • A functional knowledge of relevant laws and regulations, relating to employment, passenger transport, and national parks visitation.
  • Right to Work in Australia or New Zealand

What Do We Offer You?

  • Competitive Total Rewards Package, including exclusive travel perks!
  • Additional days off, including on your birthday!
  • Vacation time for you to recharge
  • Enhanced Parental Leave
  • Meaningful Employee Recognition Program
  • Learning and Growth Opportunities
  • Employee Resource Groups

*Applicable based on location*

G Adventures is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We consider all qualified applicants.

🤖 Explore AI and support automation
You’ll contribute to agentic AI experiments alongside experienced engineers. That could mean helping develop prompts, designing tests, evaluating results, and learning how emerging AI patterns can solve genuine support challenges.

You’ll also take ownership of keeping project and build work visible through the team backlog and ticketing processes, while maintaining clear communication and availability during business hours.

Job Description:

Job Title: VP, Fleet Account Executive

Location: Remote | USA
Reports to: SVP, OEM Sales

Employment Type: Full-time

This is an existing vacancy

About the Role:

The Fleet Account Executive is a strategic leader and relationship maestro responsible for driving profitable revenue growth by leveraging JD Power’s cutting-edge data, advisory, and predictive analytics solutions specifically across the North American fleet industry. This role combines expertise in the fleet industry with strong relationship-building and problem-solving skills to deliver solutions that address client challenges and opportunities. By collaborating with customer success, customer solutions, and product development teams, this position will develop fleet industry specific strategies, manage sales pipelines, and craft compelling proposals to highlight JD Power's unique value proposition within the fleet industry. With a focus on industry trends, innovative solutions and superior client service, this position plays a pivotal role in shaping company success while fostering professional partnerships and delivering exceptional business results. In this role you will Drive JD Power's revenue expansion by cultivating and maintaining C-suite client relationships within the fleet industry that support achievement well beyond established revenue goals.


This highly visible role plays a key part in achieving sales targets within the JD Power sales organization. As a member of a dynamic fleet sales team, the individual will gain exposure to JD Power's full suite of products and services while partnering with business development and account management leaders to deliver best-in-class client support and business growth.


This position is part of a fast-paced, dynamic, and motivated team tasked with selling the suite of JD Power products and services across the fleet industry. The team is comprised of business development and account management leaders delivering best-in-class client support and service.

In this role, you will: Develop a comprehensive understanding of JD Power’s data, products, advisory, and predictive analytics solutions, including the specific value propositions for the fleet industry.

  • Be a leader/expert and demonstrate an advanced knowledge in the services we provide and the North American fleet industry.
    • Attend fleet industry forums and functions as a representative of the Company and a subject matter expert.
    • Present/speak/write as a representative of the Company and subject matter expert.
  • Expand the business and build the revenue base within the fleet industry
    • Define how to bundle our products and services for the North American fleet industry to enhance our offerings and build new ones.
    • Negotiate and close new sales deals.
    • Manage day-to-day client interactions including client expectation, monitoring and managing customer satisfaction.
    • Build a knowledge base of each client's business, organization and objectives.
  • Responsible for sourcing, developing and nurturing relationships within our target client accounts and using current contacts, cold calling and networking to generate new contacts for the company.
  • Gain a strong understanding of competitive products and solutions in the fleet industry marketplace.
    • Articulate the differentiation and unique selling points of JD Power’s offerings.
  • Collaborate with customer success, customer solutions and product development teams to:
    • Manage the sales pipeline in Salesforce, ensuring timely follow-ups and maintaining a consistent cadence for renewals and new opportunities.
    • Create professional PowerPoint proposals and presentations showcasing solution capabilities and value propositions.
    • Complete and/or support responses to RFI, RFP, and RFQ’s.
    • Assist in the development and execution of cross-sell and up-sell strategies in collaboration with other JD Power product groups.
    • Develop, review, and manage contractual documents to ensure alignment with client needs and organizational standards.
  • Manage client engagement by:
    • Building meaningful, trusting, and professional relationships with client stakeholders, budget holders, and executives.
    • Driving discovery in client meetings and presentations to identify client challenges and opportunities, aligning JD Power’s existing or potential solutions to address those needs.
    • Developing client-specific annual sales and pricing strategies, including carryover services, upselling and cross-selling existing solutions, as well as roadmaps for product enhancements and new product development.
    • Working with JD Power’s project managers to proactively oversee projects to ensure deliverables meet the client’s expectations.

Required Qualifications:

  • Education and Job Experience:
    • 8-10 years fleet industry experience, this must be in the fleet industry preferably with a fleet organization.
    • Bachelor’s degree; advanced degree a plus.
    • Experience in sales, marketing, customer success, or product development.
    • Cross functional team experience.
  • Industry Expertise:
    • Fluent in the fleet and adjacent industries, organization structures, business challenges, etc.
    • Working understanding of online marketing tools and technologies for tier 1, tier 2 and tier 3 channels.
    • Ability to consult with clients to help them analyze and define creative solutions/concepts.
    • Demonstrated knowledge of OEM variable marketing strategies, including incentives, and their impact on sales volume.
    • Strong knowledge of data analytics and consulting as well as their complimentary solutions.
    • Ability to identify industry trends and a solid understanding of macroeconomic cycles.
  • Skills and Competencies:
    • Experience and expertise in the North American fleet industry, established industry contacts and relationships.
    • Superior ability to build and maintain strong client relationships including professional protocols.
    • Analytical, evaluative, and problem-solving abilities.
    • Excellent communication, time management and organizational skills.
    • Expertise in creating and delivering impactful presentations.
    • Proficiency in contract management, including drafting and negotiating Statements of Work (SOW), Change Orders (CO), Master Service Agreements (MSA), License and Service Agreements (LSA), and commercial Terms & Conditions (T&C).
  • Technical Proficiency:
    • Advanced proficiency in Salesforce for opportunity management and tracking.
    • Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Personal Attributes:
    • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and adaptable to fast-paced environments.
    • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
    • Willingness to travel as required (up to 15-50%).

Compensation and Benefits

This position has a Total Target Compensation (TTC) range of USD $280,000 – $320,000 per year, inclusive of base salary and target incentive opportunity. This position has uncapped earnings potential based upon sales commission plan achievement. This is the range we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s compensation within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.


Why Join JD Power

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

· We power our customers’ success. Everything we do is focused on helping customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

· We are innovative, collaborative, and grounded in data. We combine advanced analytics with human expertise to deliver insight that holds up in the real world.

· We make things easy. We turn complexity into clarity so teams can act faster and with confidence.

· We get it done. We focus on execution, accountability, and results.

· We start with trust and prove it every day. Independence, integrity, and credibility are the foundation of our work.


Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

JD Power is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

JD Power is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for individuals with disabilities or other protected needs under applicable local laws. Please contact for accommodation request.


Data Privacy

JD Power does not disclose your personal data to unauthorized third parties. However, as a global corporation consisting of multiple affiliated companies in various countries, JD Power has international sites and JD Power uses resources located throughout the world. JD Power may from time to time also use third parties to act on JD Power’s behalf. You agree to the fact that to the extent necessary your personal data may be transferred and/or disclosed to any company within JD Power group of companies as well as to third parties acting on JD Power’s behalf, including also transfers to servers and databases outside the country where you provided JD Power with your personal data. Such transfers may include for example transfers and/or disclosures outside the European Economic Area and in the United States of America. If you are a California or United Kingdom resident, additional disclosures about the information we collect and how we use that information can be found by clicking here.

Ensures the contracted Data Management for projects are carried out by the Company in accordance with the executed contract and the Sponsor’s expectations. The scope may include projects that are large and/or complex and/or with particular challenge.

On a full service project acts as Functional Lead for Data Management including primary contact for internal liaison between Data Management/Operations and Project Management, Clinical Monitoring, and other functional groups.

  • Ability to evaluate, improve, and optimize operational processes

  • Strong project management skills and knowledge of project management methodologies.

  • Effective oral and written communication skills.

  • Good organizational, planning, and time management skills with the ability to multitask under tight deadlines while providing attention to detail.
  • Ability to be flexible and adapt to change, to work independently, as well as part of a multi-disciplinary team.
  • Ability to make effective decisions and manage multiple priorities in a highly dynamic environment.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

This is a remote position.

About Support Tech LLC

Support Tech LLC is a nationwide provider of IT field services and infrastructure solutions. We deploy and support the physical side of technology for some of the country’s largest brands—quick-service restaurant chains, managed service providers, and large-scale construction and facilities companies. Think hardware rollouts, network infrastructure, structured cabling, and on-site technician dispatch, all coordinated across the country.

We are growing fast and we need a driven, organized, and persistent sales professional to help us fill the pipeline and close new business.

The Opportunity

This is a full-cycle sales role built for someone who is hungry to prove themselves. You will research and target the right companies, reach the right contacts through every channel available—phone, email, text, and LinkedIn—and then run the sales conversation yourself from first contact all the way through to a signed agreement.

You do not need a deep IT background. You need to be smart, coachable, relentless, and organized. We will teach you the service offering. You bring the hustle and the process.

This role is ideal for someone coming out of retail management, restaurant leadership, or a recent college graduate ready to launch a high-earning sales career. If you have ever worked a fast-paced customer-facing job, managed multiple priorities at once, and refused to quit on a tough day, you already have the foundation we are looking for.


Requirements

What You Will Do

Account-Based Prospecting

  • Research and build targeted lists of companies that match our ideal client profile: quick-service restaurant chains, IT managed service providers, and large construction and facilities companies.

  • Identify the right decision-makers at each account—IT directors, operations managers, procurement leads—and build a multi-touch outreach plan for each.

  • Use LinkedIn, company websites, trade publications, and AI-powered research tools to develop insight on each target before you ever reach out.

Multi-Channel Outreach

  • Execute persistent, professional outreach campaigns across phone calls, emails, text messages, and LinkedIn messages.

  • Craft personalized messaging that gets responses not generic copy-paste blasts. You understand that relevance beats volume.

  • Follow up consistently and strategically. Most deals are won on the fifth or sixth touch.

Sales Conversations & Closing

  • Once you have a prospect’s attention, you own the conversation. Qualify the opportunity, understand the pain, present our solution, and move toward a commitment.

  • Run discovery calls and presentations independently. We will give you the tools and coaching you bring the energy and the close.

  • Document all activity and pipeline stages accurately in our CRM so nothing falls through the cracks.

Post-Sale Alignment

  • Stay involved after the deal closes. Attend project kickoff meetings to ensure the delivery team understands what was promised and the client feels supported.

  • Build long-term relationships that lead to repeat business and referrals.

Who We Are Looking For

We are not looking for someone with 10 years of IT experience. We are looking for someone with the right mindset, habits, and drive. Here is what that looks like:

  • Self-starter.You do not wait to be told what to do. You see a gap and you fill it.

  • Organized and process-driven.You track your activities, manage your time well, and never let follow-ups slip.

  • Comfortable on the phone.Cold calling does not scare you. Rejection is just part of the game.

  • Strong communicator.Whether writing an email, leaving a voicemail, or presenting a solution, you are clear, confident, and professional.

  • Tech-comfortable.You are proficient in Google Business Suite and genuinely excited about using AI tools to work smarter and faster.

  • Coachable.You want feedback, you apply it, and you keep improving.

Background: We love to see retail management, restaurant or hospitality leadership, recent college graduates (any major), inside sales, customer service, recruiting, or any role that requires you to be persistently persuasive with people you have never met before.

Compensation & Structure

This role is structured as base hourly pay plus commission, providing income stability while rewarding strong performance.

  • Base Pay:$20/hour guaranteed.

  • Commission:Earn commission on every deal you close. There is no cap. The more you sell, the more you earn.

  • Remote:100% remote, USA-based.

  • Travel:Occasional travel for trade shows and key client meetings (approximately 10–15%), fully reimbursed.

  • Tools:Provided with CRM, sales enablement technology, and AI tools to maximize your productivity.


Benefits

Why Join Support Tech LLC

  • Real earning potential from day one—your commission is uncapped and tied directly to your effort.

  • You will be an early and important part of a growing sales team, with a clear path to senior sales and leadership roles.

  • A diverse portfolio of services means you will always have a compelling solution for the right prospect.

  • No micromanagement. We care about results, not time-tracking.

  • You will develop skills in account-based selling, AI-assisted research, and multi-channel outreach that are valuable across any industry.

How to Apply

If this sounds like the role you have been looking for, we want to hear from you. Submit your resume and a brief note telling us about a time you had to work hard to convince someone of something—and what happened.

Skills Ontology and Learning Recognition Project Lead

Office of Registrar

Exempt, Contingent II, Full Time, Pay Grade 3.4

Job location: Stateside Remote


This (role) role is funded through a grant from The Gates Foundation. The grant lasts 2 years and funding for this role is tied to that grant. In addition, this role will be responsible for the execution and delivery of grant project initiatives, working collaboratively with cross-functional teams to align these projects with the university's broader strategic goals.


The Skills Ontology and Learning Recognition Project Lead supports implementation of UMGC’s learning-recognition initiative by coordinating the day-to-day work required to operationalize the Director’s skills ontology, translation framework, and related project deliverables. Under the direction of the Skills Ontology and Learning Recognition Director, this role combines strong project-execution skills with working fluency in skills ontology and learning-recognition concepts to translate strategy into work plans, documentation, stakeholder follow-through, and coordinated delivery across academic, technical, and partner teams.

Working closely with the Director, faculty subject matter experts, data and interoperability specialists, and participating partner institutions, the Project Lead maintains project momentum, organizes cross-functional workstreams, supports crosswalks, standards mappings, and implementation documentation, and helps ensure that UMGC’s learning-recognition approach is implemented consistently and transparently, with clear traceability and on schedule.


Project Planning & Workstream Coordination


  • Maintain the integrated project plan, timelines, milestones, dependency tracking, and action logs for the learning-recognition workstreams.
  • Coordinate day-to-day activity across faculty reviewers, subject matter experts, data and interoperability staff, advising, institutional research, Military and Veterans Programs, and other participating units.
  • Track progress against deliverables, technical dependencies, and review cycles; escalate risks, delays, or implementation issues to the Director with recommended next steps.

Skills Mapping Operations & Documentation


  • Support development and maintenance of working crosswalks, evidence tables, standards mappings, and version-controlled records that operationalize the Director’s skills-to-credit strategy.
  • Document taxonomy research, standards decisions, architecture and implementation decisions, and process changes so methods remain transparent, auditable, traceable, and reusable.
  • Coordinate review cycles, consolidate feedback, and maintain current working materials for project teams, technical contributors, and faculty reviewers.

Faculty & SME Engagement Logistics


  • Identify, schedule, onboard, and coordinate faculty reviewers and external subject matter experts needed for mapping, policy review, and methodology implementation.
  • Manage work plans, meeting schedules, contracts, stipends, and workload documentation in partnership with Academic Affairs, Human Resources, and other administrative offices.
  • Prepare materials, agendas, and follow-up items that keep faculty and SMEs aligned on deliverables, review expectations, and deadlines.

Governance, Reporting & Communications


  • Prepare governance materials, status reports, meeting notes, decision logs, and traceability documentation for internal leadership, partner discussions, and sponsored reporting needs.
  • Organize content and documentation supporting reports, toolkit materials, implementation guides, and other dissemination outputs.
  • Maintain centralized records of requirements, use cases, approvals, and workflow artifacts, including documentation that supports transparent review of AI-assisted recommendation processes.

Risk, Budget & Resource Tracking


  • Maintain the project risk register and support mitigation tracking in coordination with the Director and project leadership.
  • Monitor personnel and non-personnel expenditures, resource needs, and administrative dependencies related to project operations and faculty engagement.
  • Flag emerging issues early and recommend sequencing or resourcing adjustments when timelines, dependencies, or review requirements change.

Partner & Pilot Coordination


  • Support coordination with partner institutions and ecosystem organizations by scheduling working sessions, documenting requirements, and tracking shared commitments.
  • Coordinate logistics and follow-through for demonstrations, pilots, interoperability and standards discussions, schema or data-exchange working sessions, and other cross-institution activities.
  • Collaborate with data and interoperability specialists to organize materials related to reusable data structures, standards mappings, APIs, and partner-facing implementation discussions.
  • Other Duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree in higher education administration, education, workforce development, project management, instructional design, information science, assessment, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum 5–7 years of progressively responsible experience in project or program coordination, academic administration, learning recognition, workforce-aligned education, skills-related initiatives, or a related area.
  • Experience managing project plans, workstreams, timelines, documentation, and stakeholder communication across multiple contributors and functional areas.
  • Working familiarity with skills taxonomies, ontologies, competency frameworks, prior learning assessment (PLA), credentialing, or structured crosswalks; ability to support subject-matter work without serving as the primary methodological authority.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate faculty or subject matter expert engagement, including meeting preparation, work-plan management, follow-up, documentation, and review logistics.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and written communication skills, including experience producing status reports, meeting materials, technical documentation, implementation records, and process guides.
  • Comfort working with project management tools, shared documentation environments, implementation artifacts, risk tracking, budget/resource monitoring, and transparent decision logs in a cross-functional setting.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience supporting grant-funded initiatives, multi-institution collaborations, or externally sponsored projects.
  • Familiarity with military learning evaluation, workforce learning records, digital credentials, interoperability-related initiatives, or standards-mapping work.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted recommendation or evaluation workflows, documentation traceability, data governance, or quality assurance practices.
  • PMP certification, CAPM, Agile/project coordination training, or comparable experience managing complex project delivery.

jobs.excerpt: Who are we?  We are a female-founded scale-up, currently made up of around 100 AltoVitians.
jobs.description:
Who are we?
We are a female-founded scale-up, currently made up of around 100 AltoVitians. Our fully-remote team hails from 26 different countries and collectively speaks 29 languages. Most of the time, it is our differences that are celebrated (whether they are in cultures, personalities, preferences or passions). However, despite those differences, there are a few principal attributes that we share which define an AltoVitian. AltoVitians are tenacious, humble, and thoughtful. Being humble is important because it enables us to keep learning every day, and tenacity is necessary because in a high performing environment as fast-paced as AltoVita, taking it slow is simply not an option!

As we look to scale our Global Commercial engine, today is a particularly exciting time to join our team. This next chapter won’t always be a smooth ride, but it will be filled with innovation, excitement and opportunities. If you are ambitious, commercially hungry and ready for the challenge (and the fun!) of growing with us, we would love to hear from you.

What we do

AltoVita is a multi-award winning accommodation platform that enables enterprises to consolidate accommodation programmes through the power of proprietary technology paired with a human centric approach.

AltoVita’s unique offering sets us apart in the market, providing a network of 10 million+ verified and vetted properties are all duty of care compliant, backed by a four-tier quality control process; located in over 35,000 cities & 165 countries world-wide. With our award-winning enterprise software and human-centric approach, we deliver smart and sustainable solutions to global talent mobility & business travel managers worldwide.

Our Client Development team plays a vital role as trusted advisors and partners to our clients. Embodying our consultative philosophy, this dedicated team proactively shares new market insights, analyzes data, and empowers our clients with the tools and knowledge to make informed decisions, ensuring our clients are always equipped to make the best choices for their corporate housing needs.

AltoVita’s technology provides a cloud-based bridge between the highly fragmented property distribution system and multinational Global 2000 companies. A proprietary two-way API integration with a standardised sourcing process reduces the legacy, inefficient 48-to-72-hour bidding process down to a few minutes, saving valuable time and money.

Corporate clients love the bespoke user interface seamlessly configured to their mobility policies, and employees enjoy a greater sense of choice and support in their relocation journey.

About the role

We're looking for a Sales Enablement Manager to empower our Go To Market teams following the roll out of a new sales enablement platform across the business. You will own the ongoing adoption and success of the platform, making it the single source of truth for everything our commercial teams need to sell, from content and playbooks to training and buyer insights. You will ensure the team has the tools, insights and materials to perform at their best, turning strategy into execution and complexity into clarity.

This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on making things more efficient, scalable and impactful, and who knows that a platform is only as good as the adoption behind it.

Your Responsibilities:

Platform ownership and adoption

  • Lead the ongoing upkeep of our new sales enablement platform, including configuration, content migration, user setup and phased launch across our global commercial teams.

  • Act as the platform's owner and primary administrator, managing permissions, content structure, taxonomy and governance so the right material is easy to find at the right time.

  • Drive adoption across Sales, Client Development and Customer Success, setting clear usage expectations and working with sales leadership to embed the platform into daily workflows.

  • Integrate the platform with HubSpot CRM and other core tools, working with RevOps to connect content usage and buyer engagement to pipeline and deal outcomes.

  • Track and report on platform analytics, including content usage, buyer engagement and adoption, to show what is driving wins and where to invest.

Content and messaging

  • Build and maintain a comprehensive, well-organised library of strategic sales content within the platform, including pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, battle cards and email templates.

  • Create and continuously optimise sales presentations and proposal decks aligned with our value proposition and tailored to client needs.

  • Use platform data and insights from Sales and Customer Success to identify content gaps and underperforming materials, and develop resources that address them.

  • Run regular content audits to keep materials accurate, relevant and on-brand, retiring outdated content so the library stays current.

  • Act as a key liaison between Sales, Marketing, Client Development and Product Marketing to ensure consistent messaging and timely delivery of relevant content.

  • Develop high-impact content for each stage of the buyer journey, enabling Sales to drive engagement and conversion.

Training and onboarding

  • Design, deliver and manage training on the platform, sales processes and enablement strategies, including onboarding paths, refresher sessions and certification where appropriate.

  • Lead enablement sessions to train new and existing sales team members on new content, messaging and platform features.

  • Build a structured, platform-based onboarding programme so new sales hires ramp up quickly and consistently across markets.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing and RevOps to continually improve enablement tools, templates and workflows.

  • Support sales leadership with content, market insights and performance data to improve team productivity and effectiveness.

Who you are:

  • 3+ years' experience in sales operations or sales enablement.

  • Hands-on experience implementing and administering a sales enablement platform (e.g. Highspot, Seismic, Showpad, Mindtickle, Dock or similar), ideally including leading a rollout from scratch.

  • Proven track record of driving tool adoption and managing change across commercial teams.

  • 2+ years' experience in the business travel or corporate housing industry is desirable.

  • Proven experience delivering measurable improvements in sales performance.

  • Experience working in a high-growth, scale-up environment is a MUST.

  • Comfortable using data and analytics to measure content effectiveness and influence decisions.

  • Excellent problem-solving, project management, interpersonal and organisational skills.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally and prioritise multiple projects.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Able to think strategically.

  • Proactive mindset, always looking for ways to improve and support the team.

Ways of Working

AltoVita is a fully remote team. Although we have regular touch-points throughout the week, organise off-sites in several locations, trust is essential for us to work effectively as a team. Our founders empower us to make decisions autonomously, and in turn expect that we also empower our direct reports.

Join our Team

AltoVita is the sum of every member of the team. We know that a strong team is a diverse team, and are therefore committed to being an equal opportunity employer, so please bring all of yourself to the interviews and most importantly to our team.

Becoming an AltoVitian means you will benefit from:

  • A team that will always put you first

  • Incredible opportunities for growth and career advancement

  • A fully-remote working environment

  • Wellness benefits and a wellness budget, which can be spent on a range of options including gym memberships, home meal delivery services, mindfulness applications, and many more

  • A work-from-home allowance to get your home-office set up

  • A generous vacation package so you can recharge or explore

jobs.description:
As a 360 Talent Management Agency, and with over 350 creators alongside athletes, entertainers, and models, we believe talent deserves long-term career strategy, not transactional management. We empower our teams to think like entrepreneurs while providing the infrastructure, tools, and support needed to build sustainable careers.

Our culture is ambitious, deeply collaborative, and growth-oriented. We celebrate wins together, share knowledge openly, continuously improve and innovate how we operate, and invest heavily in giving our people the best environment to succeed. And we dream big.

A Little About the Role

At Dulcedo, a Team Manager is much more than a people manager. A true leader is what we look for: someone who enjoys coaching others, spotting strengths, unlocking potential, and building a winning team. You will oversee a team of Agents, help them grow in confidence and performance, and play a direct role in continuing to shape our healthy, dynamic and high-performing culture. You will:

  • Lead, coach, and mentor a small team, helping each individual grow in performance, confidence, and accountability
  • Hold regular 1:1s with team members to provide guidance, feedback, support, and strategic direction
  • Partner closely with Associate Directors and leadership to align on priorities, performance, team needs, and business opportunities
  • Take an active role in building your team through recruitment, selection, onboarding, and training, ensuring new hires are set up for long-term success.
  • Lead performance reviews, support goal-setting, and help create development plans tailored to each team member
  • Continue representing talent directly and contributing to sales performance, while leading by example

Why This Role Matters

Our Team Managers play a key role in the health, performance, and culture of the agency. They create consistency, elevate standards for talents and clients, and develop people from within. At Dulcedo, leadership is not about hierarchy - it’s about impact, trust, and the ability to help others grow while moving the business forward.

What You Bring

Ideally, you have around 5+ years of experience in talent management or influencer marketing and experience leading, mentoring, or supporting more junior team members, formally or informally.

Don’t meet what we're looking for, or coming from an adjacent background? We encourage you to apply regardless! What matters most to us is that you have a passion for mentoring people and for the creator space. The rest, we'll teach you!

A Few Reasons Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Enjoy unlimited paid vacation, 12 personal days, sick days, your birthday off, flexible schedules, an agency-wide Holiday Recharge between Christmas and New Year’s, and early finish Fridays. Whether you prefer working remotely or from one of our pet-friendly offices, you’ll have the flexibility, tools, and support to adapt your work to better match your lifestyle.
  • Benefit from uncapped individual commissions, team commissions, and performance bonuses, along with yearly salary reviews driven by results, contribution, leadership, and continuous development - not tenure alone.
  • Feel the entrepreneurial energy of a high-growth boutique-style agency with the stability, reputation, and resources of one of North America’s leading talent management agencies — it’s truly the best of both worlds.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to making sure everyone feels included, supported, and valued. Should you require any accommodations during the application process, please write to and we will adjust the process to your needs.

Et pour y arriver, on a plusieurs cordes à notre arc :

  • Stratégie créative – On scrute les comptes de nos clients sous toutes leurs coutures et on propose des recommandations créatives structurées et actionnables pour maximiser la perf'.

Vos missions

Ce qu’on attend de toi 🫵

Vos compétences

  • Expérience solide en stratégie créative, avec une compréhension approfondie des régies publicitaires.
  • Capacité à transformer des insights en idées créatives percutantes.
  • Compétences solides en copywriting.

Program Manager, Recruitment Marketing – Talent Community & CRM


The Program Manager,Recruitment Marketing – Talent Community & CRM, is responsible for building and executing Advocate Health’s enterprise candidate nurturing strategy to support workforce priorities, talent pipeline development, and recruiting outcomes. This role develops targeted engagement programs that grow talent communities, strengthen candidate relationships, support employer brand storytelling, and improve candidate movement from initial interest through hire.

Serving as the strategic lead for Advocate Health’s talent community strategy, this position will partner closely with the Employer Brand team to bring our brand to life through personalized candidate journeys, while collaborating with the Innovation & Experience team to maximize the capabilities of our CRM platform and supporting technologies. Together, these partnerships will create a seamless, data-driven experience across the enterprise.


Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Talent Attraction

  • Develop and lead Advocate Health’s talent community strategy aligned to workforce priorities.
  • Design personalized candidate journeys across key talent segments including physicians, APP’s, nursing, allied health, executives, early careers and hard-to-fill specialties.
  • Build scalable programs that increase candidate engagement, improve conversion, and strengthen long-term talent pipelines.
  • Establish governance, standards and best practices for talent community strategy, CRM campaign execution, and candidate engagement programs.
  • Develop audience segmentation, campaign calendars, automated workflows, and lifecycle communications.
  • Lead campaign planning, execution, optimization, and performance measurement.
  • Continuously test and learn, improving engagement strategies through analytics, A/B testing, and candidate insights.
  • Identify new opportunities to leverage CRM capabilities to improve recruiting outcomes and candidate experience.
  • Maintain CRM campaign briefs, approved messaging, nurture journey documentation, templates, and performance learnings in a shared repository to support consistency, reuse, and visibility across Talent Acquisition partners.

Employer Brand Partnership

  • Partner closely with the Employer Brand team to define enterprise talent engagement campaigns, messaging, and candidate experiences.
  • Develop CRM campaign content, messaging and candidate communications that align with Advocate Health’s employer brand, voice, and creative standards.
  • Translate employer brand strategy into personalized, relevant candidate experiences across the talent lifecycle.

Innovation & Experience Partnership

  • Partner with the Talent Acquisition Innovation & Experience team, which owns CRM platform administration, technical configuration and system integrations.
  • Collaborate to identify opportunities for automation, personalization, reporting, roadmap priorities, user adoption, and process improvements.

Measurement & Insights

  • Define success metrics for talent engagement initiatives.
  • Develop dashboards and executive reporting on talent community growth, campaign performance, engagement, conversion and recruiting outcomes.
  • Leverage data and market insights to continuously improve candidate experiences and enterprise talent attraction strategies.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition leaders, recruiters, marketing, digital and HR stakeholders to support enterprise hiring priorities.
  • Influence without direct authority, building strong partnerships across Talent Attraction, Sourcing, Talent Acquisition Delivery and Enterprise People & Culture teammates.
  • Stay current on emerging CRM, candidate engagement and talent marketing trends, bringing innovative ideas to Advocate Health.

What Success Looks Like

  • A thriving, segmented enterprise talent community that consistently generates qualified candidates.
  • Personalized candidate journeys that improve engagement, conversion and candidate experience.
  • Strong alignment between Employer Brand, Sourcing, and TA Delivery priorities.
  • A scalable talent engagement strategy that supports enterprise hiring across all major talent segments.

We are a professional business which is dedicated to the highest standard of excellence and ethical performance of radon measurement, mitigation, and the transfer of information to its customers and the general public.

What is Radon?

Radon is a naturally-occuring cancer-causing radioactive gas that you can’t see, smell or taste. Radon comes from the decay of radium in the soil, which is a decay product of uranium. Its presence in your home can pose a danger to your family’s health.

Why is radon harmful?

The US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) has identified radon as the second leading cause of lung cancer in the United States and claims about 20,000 lives annually. If you smoke and your home has high radon levels, your risk of lung cancer is especially high.

When radon and its decay products are inhaled into your lungs, they emit alpha particles. These alpha particles can strike the sensitive lining of the bronchi. When this happens, the cells in your lungs are damaged, subsequently increasing your risk to radon-related cancer. Most alpha particle radiation comes from radon decay products. However, because it is easier to measure radon rather than its decay products, people usually characterize the exposure by the amount of radon in their living spaces.

jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Mechanical Designer to join our Fuel Recycling Engineering team.

Position Description

The person in this role is responsible for developing detailed mechanical designs, 3D CAD models, fabrication drawings, and prototype hardware supporting Oklo's first-of-a-kind nuclear fuel recycling technology. This work directly supports the development of advanced electrochemical processing equipment used to close the nuclear fuel cycle.

This position is heavily focused on translating engineering concepts into practical, manufacturable hardware. Working closely with mechanical, process, nuclear, materials, and controls engineers, the Mechanical Designer will create production-quality CAD models and drawing packages for custom equipment ranging from benchtop prototypes to production-scale process systems.

The ideal candidate enjoys designing hardware that gets built, working directly with machinists and fabricators, and iterating designs through hands-on prototyping and testing.

The equipment developed will operate in high-temperature (>500 °C), chemically aggressive, and high-radiation environments and includes molten salt vessels, high-temperature furnaces, gloveboxes, hot cells, tooling, fixtures, remote handling equipment, and other custom process hardware.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Develop detailed 3D CAD models and manufacturing drawings using SolidWorks.

  • Produce fabrication, assembly, weldment, machining, and installation drawings suitable for manufacturing and procurement.

  • Translate engineering concepts into manufacturable mechanical designs with strong attention to detail.

  • Apply Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles throughout the design process.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers, machinists, welders, and fabrication vendors to optimize designs for manufacturing, assembly, and maintenance.

  • Develop custom mechanical assemblies, fixtures, tooling, furnace components, vessels, and supporting process equipment.

  • Support prototype fabrication by responding to shop questions, incorporating manufacturing feedback, and revising drawings as designs evolve.

  • Maintain engineering documentation including bills of materials, drawing revisions, and controlled CAD files.

  • Participate in design reviews and contribute practical fabrication and assembly recommendations.

  • Assist with prototype assembly, equipment integration, and iterative design improvements based on testing and operational feedback.

  • Help develop CAD standards, drawing templates, and design best practices that improve consistency across the engineering organization.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Associate's degree, technical certification, or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Design, Mechanical Engineering Technology, Drafting, or a related technical field (or equivalent professional experience).

  • 5+ years of experience developing detailed mechanical designs and fabrication drawings.

  • Advanced proficiency with SolidWorks, including complex assemblies, weldments, sheet metal, and drawing creation.

  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes including machining, welding, sheet metal fabrication, and mechanical assembly.

  • Experience creating fabrication drawings with appropriate GD&T, tolerancing, bills of materials, and manufacturing notes.

  • Demonstrated experience applying Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles.

  • Ability to interpret engineering requirements and produce accurate, complete mechanical documentation.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience designing equipment for radiological or nuclear facilities.

  • Experience designing gloveboxes, hot cells, shielded equipment, or remote handling systems.

  • Experience designing high-temperature process equipment, including furnaces or thermal processing systems operating above 500 °C.

  • Experience with molten salt systems, vacuum systems, or corrosive chemical processing equipment.

  • Experience producing large weldments, pressure-containing assemblies, or custom process vessels.

  • Familiarity with ASME Y14.5 GD&T standards and industrial drafting best practices.

  • Experience using PDM/PLM systems for CAD and document management.

  • Experience supporting rapid prototyping and iterative hardware development.

  • Experience collaborating directly with machine shops, fabrication vendors, and equipment installers.

  • Experience in commercial or governmental nuclear projects.

Competencies

We are looking for a Mechanical Designer that is:

  • Passionate about clean energy and advancing nuclear technology.

  • Highly proficient in SolidWorks with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Passionate about creating clean, organized, and accurate fabrication drawings.

  • Experienced designing components that are straightforward to machine, fabricate, weld, and assemble.

  • Comfortable working closely with fabrication shops and incorporating practical manufacturing feedback into designs.

  • Curious about how things are built and motivated to continuously improve designs through rapid iteration.

  • Comfortable working on first-of-a-kind equipment where requirements evolve as prototypes are developed.

  • Organized and capable of managing multiple concurrent design efforts.

  • An optimist at heart, comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment.

  • An excellent communicator who enjoys collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Experience level:

  • Experienced (5+ years): Candidates should have demonstrated experience producing mechanical designs and fabrication drawings for custom industrial equipment, machinery, or prototype systems.

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $100,000 - $150,000 DOE

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

jobs.excerpt: Overview: FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe.
jobs.description:
Overview:

FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe. We're developing an intelligent system that can explore theoretical frameworks, reason across disciplines, and generate novel insights to tackle the deepest unsolved problems in physics. By combining AI, symbolic reasoning, and autonomous research capabilities, we're developing a platform that goes beyond analyzing existing knowledge to actively contribute to physics research. Our goal is to accelerate progress on the questions that have captivated humanity for centuries.

We operate as a global nonprofit organization, with a Canadian foundation, a US-based 501(c)(3).

As part of this effort, we are launching a Research Fellowship Program for advanced AI and physics researchers. Fellows will work directly with the FirstPrinciples Research and Engineering teams to design, test, and implement state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods and applications that will be integrated into the core AI Physicist system. This is not a paper-only fellowship and your work will go straight into production, helping shape how scientific research is performed.

What You will DoAs a Research Fellow, you will own a well-scoped research direction that contributes directly to the AI Physicist's ability to reason about physics.

Core Objectives:

  • Improve Theo’s ability to produce scientifically sound, high-quality outputs in 2026;
  • Introduce new ideas, methods, and approaches that meaningfully shift system performance;
  • Bring deep domain expertise (PhD+ level) in one or more targeted research areas.

Research Areas & Responsibilities

Fundamental Model Research:

  • Research, design, and test novel model architectures that combine academic literature, NLP, symbolic reasoning, and structured scientific workflows.
  • Prototype and build embedding representations for physical concepts, mathematical objects, and logical structures, enabling models to reason over equations, abstractions, and scientific constraints rather than surface text alone.
  • Investigate alternatives to transformer-based architectures and deliver concrete recommendations.
  • Design and run targeted experiments to evaluate new architectural ideas, using empirical results to guide the development of next-generation model architectures.
  • Develop reinforcement learning loops that enable models to run internal and independent thought experiment.

Multimodal Data & Benchmarking:

  • Design and automate scalable data ingestion pipelines that aggregate scientific literature, metadata, equations, and experimental data.
  • Create custom benchmarks to measure physical understanding, mathematical reasoning, and failure modes in scientific reasoning and abstraction.
  • Refine and release curated datasets and baselines once internal validation is complete.

Training, Testing & Safety:

  • Run and track model training jobs while managing compute usage and budget constraints.
  • Design sandbox environments for controlled autonomous exploration.
  • Build evaluation frameworks using visual and statistical tools to identify strengths and blind spots.
  • Implement tests and guardrails that flag low-quality or unsafe outputs.
  • Maintain internal issue tracking with clear failure modes and fixes.

Collaboration & Technical Guidance:

  • Work closely with engineers to ensure research is feasible and production-ready.
  • Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Present regular research updates tied to defined milestones.

Who This Fellowship Is ForWe are looking for researchers who:

  • Can operate independently and own a problem end-to-end.
  • Are motivated by ambitious, long-horizon goals.
  • Have strong builder instincts, not just theory.
  • Value rigor, clarity, and intellectual honesty.
  • Are comfortable engaging with exploratory, incomplete results.

Typical profiles include:

  • PhD or postdoctoral researchers in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Theoretical Physics, or a closely related field.
  • Track record of research in either:
    • model architectures, representation learning, or reasoning systems (CS/ML path); or
    • mathematical, physical, or formal reasoning applied to fundamental problems (physics path).
  • Demonstrated ability to translate abstract theory into testable computational systems.
  • Comfortable working across disciplinary boundaries.

Program Structure

  • 6-12 month engagement with full-time or equivalent commitment
  • Fully remote
  • Fellows participate in projects and are expected to produce outputs (code, models, and other deliverables)
  • Fixed stipend for the full term

How to Express Interest:If this resonates, we welcome an expression of interest, including:

  • Resume;
  • Description of your research background;
  • Primary areas of expertise; and
  • Relevant recent work.

Join us at FirstPrinciples and be a part of a transformative journey where science drives progress and unlocks the potential of humanity.
