任职要求

  • 教育背景： 分子生物学、生物化学、细胞生物学、生物工程或相关专业硕士及以上学历。
  • 工作经验： 拥有3-5年及以上在知名生物科技公司、CRO或药企的研发、应用支持经验。
  • 专业知识：
    • 熟悉linux的基本操作，有一定的生物信息学基础。
    • 深刻理解寡核苷酸和基因合成技术的原理、工艺及质量控制要点。
    • 熟悉DNA合成产品在以下至少两个领域的应用：
      1. 抗体新药开发: 如抗体库构建、人源化、亲和力成熟、序列优化。
      2. 细胞治疗: 如CAR结构设计、病毒载体构建、T细胞功能验证。
      3. 基因治疗: 如AAV基因组设计、sgRNA筛选、mRNA疫苗/LNP应用。
      4. AI在药物开发中的应用。
  • 实验技能：
    • 具备分子生物学和细胞生物学实验操作经验，包括但不限于：分子克隆、质粒构建、PCR、细胞培养、转染/转导。
    • 能够独立解决客户的技术问题。
  • 沟通能力：
    • 出色的中英文沟通能力（书面和口语），能够清晰、有逻辑地向不同背景的客户解释复杂技术概念。
    • 卓越的客户服务意识、主动性和解决问题的能力。
    • 优秀的团队协作精神和项目管理能力。

Job Overview

This position requires an expert with both a profound technical background and excellent communication skills. You will serve as a crucial bridge connecting the company's products with customer success, providing comprehensive and in-depth technical support for NGS panel design and synbio-related products to customers in China, both pre-sales and post-sales. You not only need to possess deep background in life sciences and knowledge of bioinformatics, but also be able to answer product questions, act as a trusted advisor for both basic research and industrial customers (encompassing antibody development, cell therapy, gene therapy and AI driven drug discovery), and solve practical problems through professional technical solutions to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty.

Core Responsibilities

NGS Panel Design

  • Efficiently fulfill NGS panel design requirements in China.
  • Actively participate in discussions with customers regarding special panel designs.
  • Maintain regular and effective communication with the global design team.

Technical Consultation and Support

  • Handle and respond to complex technical inquiries from customers about DNA synthesis products (genes, oligo pools, mutant libraries, etc.), providing professional, timely, and accurate solutions.
  • Gain a deep understanding of customer application scenarios in areas such as antibody drug discovery, cell therapy, and gene therapy, and offer research solutions based on the company's products.

Customer Relationship Management

  • Proactively follow up on R&D projects of key customers, establish and maintain strong technical trust relationships, and enhance customer satisfaction and product stickiness.
  • Collect, analyze, and provide feedback on customer needs and market trends to inform the company's product development and marketing strategies.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to participate in technical visits to important customers, provide professional technical demonstrations, and assist in achieving sales targets.
  • Work with R&D and production departments to thoroughly investigate and resolve complex technical issues raised by customers, driving continuous improvement in product quality and processes.

Job Requirements

  • Educational Background: Master's degree or higher in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Cell Biology, Bioengineering, or a related field.
  • Work Experience: 3-5 years or more of R&D or application support experience in renowned biotechnology companies, CROs, or pharmaceutical companies.

Professional Knowledge

  • Familiar with basic Linux operations and possess a certain foundation in bioinformatics.
  • Have a profound understanding of the principles, processes, and quality control points of oligonucleotide and gene synthesis technologies.
  • Be familiar with the applications of DNA synthesis products in at least two of the following areas:

1）Antibody Drug Development: Such as antibody library construction, humanization, affinity maturation, and sequence optimization.

2）Cell Therapy: Such as CAR structure design, viral vector construction, and T-cell functional validation.

3）Gene Therapy: Such as AAV genome design, sgRNA screening, and mRNA vaccine/LNP applications.

4）AI in Drug Discovery and Development.

Experimental Skills

  • Possess hands-on experience in molecular biology and cell biology experiments, including but not limited to molecular cloning, plasmid construction, PCR, cell culture, and transfection/transduction.
  • Be able to independently resolve customer technical issues.

Communication Skills

  • Excellent communication skills in both Chinese and English (written and oral), capable of clearly and logically explaining complex technical concepts to customers from diverse backgrounds.
  • Demonstrate exceptional customer service awareness, initiative, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Exhibit excellent teamwork spirit and project management skills.

About Twist Bioscience

Twist Bioscience synthesizes genes from scratch, known as “writing” DNA. Just as children learn to both read and write, the next phase of development for the genomics revolution is the ability to write DNA.

At Twist Bioscience, we work in service of people who are changing the world for the better. In fields such as health care, agriculture, industrial chemicals and data storage, our unique silicon-based DNA Synthesis Platform provides precision at a scale that is otherwise unavailable to our customers.

The role requires a sharp political instinct, genuine interest in the telecoms and digital economy regulatory space, and the credibility to represent a global brand.

What You'll Bring:

  • Demonstrable track record of influencing regulatory outcomes and managing multi-jurisdictional government relations programmes.

About Engine

Engine is the all-in-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K+ businesses and groups representing 1.8M+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, the fastest-growing company in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

The Role

Engine is redefining what business travel looks like and the Senior Director of Travel Support is accountable for redefining what best-in-class travel support looks like alongside it. This role owns the full member support operation across Lodging, Flights, Cars, and Engine X, leads the Customer Advocacy Team, and architects the Elevate program that sets the standard for how Engine's highest-value customers experience the platform.

This isn't a role for someone who manages from a dashboard. We're looking for a player/coach; a leader who is as comfortable pulling up a case, jumping on a call with a stranded traveler, or diving into EVA containment data as they are running a QBR with their leadership team or presenting to the executive team. You set the standard by modeling it, not just by defining it.

At Engine, we don't benchmark against the industry, we make the industry benchmark against us. If your instinct is to hit 90% CSAT because that's what the industry calls good, this isn't the right seat. If your instinct is to ask why we're not at 95% and build the plan to get there, keep reading.

What You'll Own

Member Support: Lodging, Flights, Cars & Engine X You are the operational and strategic owner of Engine's core travel and spend support function. That means full accountability for service levels, quality, customer satisfaction, and cost efficiency across all four verticals, not as separate teams reporting up to you, but as an integrated support operation you actively shape and lead.

  • Own and continuously improve end-to-end support performance across Lodging, Flights, Cars, and Engine X: CSAT, SLA, CRI rate, AHT, CPH, and contact rate
  • Lead a senior management team across verticals and shifts, including 24/7 coverage across weekday, weekend, and after-hours operations
  • Be the escalation owner for P1 incidents and high-severity customer situations, you are reachable and decisive when it matters
  • Own the Engine X support motion end-to-end: card failures, spend management inquiries, application support, billing disputes, and KYC/KYB escalations — ensuring Engine X customers receive a support experience that matches the sophistication of the product
  • Partner directly with Product and Engineering to drive the tooling, automation, and platform improvements that reduce avoidable contacts and improve agent capability across all four verticals

Customer Advocacy Team The CAT is Engine's escalation tier for complex, high-stakes, and retention-critical customer situations across Travel and Engine X. You own the function, the standards, and the outcomes.

  • Lead the CAT team and set the bar for what exceptional service recovery looks like at Engine
  • Own escalation SLAs, QA accuracy, and retention outcomes for the accounts and customers that land in this team
  • Build the playbooks, escalation protocols, and account-specific strategies that prevent your best customers from churning

BPO & Vendor Operations You've run BPO partnerships before and you know exactly where the leverage points are and where the risk lives.

  • Own the performance and commercial relationship with Engine's BPO partners across the Travel Support and Engine X verticals
  • Hold vendors to Engine's quality standards — not their own — and escalate without hesitation when performance doesn't meet the bar
  • Partner with the OpEx Vendor Manager to manage contracts, rate structures, and headcount transitions

What We're Looking For

You are customer obsessed, genuinely. Not as a value statement, but as an operating mode. You read case transcripts. You listen to call recordings. You know which hotel chains generate the most CRI volume and why. You treat every friction point in the customer journey as a personal problem to solve — whether that's a traveler stranded at check-in or a cardholder blocked from completing a transaction.

You have deep contact center DNA. You've built and run contact center operations in the US, and you've managed BPO partnerships at a meaningful scale. You know the difference between a workforce management problem and a quality problem. You've owned SLAs and missed them and learned exactly how to fix it. You've managed shift structures, handled overnight and weekend coverage gaps, and built the management layers that make 24/7 operations sustainable.

You are a player/coach. You don't manage from a distance. You are in the work — reviewing escalations, sitting with agents, pressure-testing SOPs, running post-mortems on P1 incidents. Your team looks to you not just for direction but for the standard. When something is hard, you go first.

You set standards, you don't chase them. Industry benchmarks are a floor for you, not a ceiling. You have strong opinions about what great looks like, you build toward it with urgency, and you measure progress relentlessly.

You are a continuous improvement practitioner. You use data to find problems before customers report them. You have experience implementing process improvement frameworks (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent). You build feedback loops — from QA to coaching to SOP to retraining — and you close them.

You build leaders, not just teams. The people who work for you get better. You give direct feedback, you invest in development, and you're known for producing leaders who go on to run their own operations.

Experience & Qualifications

  • 12+ years in customer operations, contact center leadership, or travel support — with at least 5 years at the director level or above
  • Proven experience running a US-based contact center operation with full P&L or cost accountability
  • Hands-on BPO management experience — vendor selection, performance management, commercial negotiations, and transitions
  • Experience in travel, hospitality, fintech, or a high-complexity booking and transaction environment strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with modern support tooling — Salesforce Service Cloud, WFM platforms, AI-assisted support, and quality management systems
  • Experience supporting financial products — corporate cards, expense management, billing operations, or payments — is a strong plus
  • Experience building or scaling a premium or tiered support offering is a strong plus
  • Strong analytical instincts — you are comfortable in data, know which metrics matter, and can translate numbers into operational decisions quickly

Why This Role, Why Now

Engine is at an inflection point. Gross bookings crossed $2B in annual GBV, Engine X is scaling fast, and the platform serves 33,000+ businesses. The support operation that got us here is good — but the support operation that takes us to the next level needs a different kind of leadership at the top. This role is the person who builds that. You'll have the scope, the resources, the executive support, and the mandate to make Engine's travel and spend support operation genuinely world-class. Not world-class by industry standards. World-class by the standards we set ourselves.

Applications for this role will be accepted through December 28th, 2026 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

What we are building

Domino is the platform enterprises trust when the stakes on AI are highest. Global pharma running drug-discovery pipelines, top-five insurers underwriting billion-dollar risk, defense and intelligence agencies retraining mission-critical systems. Every model has to be auditable, defensible and reproducible from the day it's built. This is why Gartner has recognised us three times in the Enterprise Data Science & ML Platforms category.

Frontier models have unlocked a new class of AI applications regulated companies couldn't previously ship — the governance, auditability and control primitives weren't there. Domino is building that layer. As a technical Product Manager, you'll own capabilities within it and shape the next chapter of what regulated enterprise AI looks like.

What your impact will be

  • Advance our Governance feature set — embedding model validation, review and audit-readiness directly into the development lifecycle, including automated model documentation and modern takes on longstanding requirements like attestation and revalidation.

  • Partner directly with customer executives — up to and including CIOs, CTOs and Chief Data Officers at Fortune 100 companies — to turn their hardest operational-AI problems into product decisions.

What we look for in this role

This role is for builders. We're looking for PMs who default to shipping, who can carry a technical conversation on their own merit, and whose past work stands up to engineering scrutiny.

  • 5+ years of product management experience shipping enterprise software to developers, ML engineers, quantitative researchers, data scientists or similar practitioners — users who write code as their primary interface with the product. Non-negotiable.

What we value

  • We value a growth mindset. High-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and see the opportunities for success

  • We value all of you that believe improving is always possible. At Domino, everything is a work in progress – we can do better at everything.

jobs.excerpt: Social Heaven, part of trafficdesign | 100 % remote möglich, oder aus unseren Büros in Köln und Hamburg | Vollzeit | ab sofort Aufgaben#deinestelle 🚀UGC Ads in 18 Tagen, über 800 Stück im Monat, für DTC-Brands aus Beauty, Food, Supplements, Fashion und Health.
jobs.description:
Social Heaven, part of trafficdesign | 100 % remote möglich, oder aus unseren Büros in Köln und Hamburg | Vollzeit | ab sofort

Aufgaben

#deinestelle 🚀

UGC Ads in 18 Tagen, über 800 Stück im Monat, für DTC-Brands aus Beauty, Food, Supplements, Fashion und Health. Zwischen Kundenbriefing und fertiger Ad liegt eine Menge Organisation, Gespür und Qualitätsgefühl. Genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Du bist die Person, die ein Kundenbriefing in konkrete Content-Ideen übersetzt, aus über 900 Creatorn die richtigen heraussucht, sie briefst, durch die Produktion begleitest und am Ende entscheidest, was gut genug ist. Und du bist die Person, mit der unsere Kund:innen sprechen, wenn es um genau diesen Content geht.

#deineaufgaben

🔥 Research & Angles: Du gräbst dich in Produkt, Zielgruppe, Reviews und Wettbewerb ein und holst genau die Sätze heraus, die deine Zielgruppe selbst benutzt. Daraus baust du Angles, die den Nerv treffen. Pro Brand, pro Funnel-Stufe, pro Plattform.

🔥 Hooks & Scripting: Dein Kerngeschäft. Du schreibst Hooks in Serie, testest Varianten gegeneinander und baust daraus Skripte für UGC Ads, Street Interviews und Advertorials. Sprechbar statt werblich, so klar, dass ein Creator sie ohne Rückfragen umsetzen kann, so offen, dass seine Persönlichkeit erhalten bleibt.

🔥 Ad Concepts: Du denkst nicht in einzelnen Texten, sondern in Konzepten. Format, Ablauf, Bildidee, Textebene, Call-to-Action. Von der ersten Sekunde bis zum Payoff steht alles auf dem Papier, bevor jemand die Kamera anmacht.

🔥 Creator-Auswahl: Beim Schreiben weißt du schon, wer es sagen soll. Du wählst aus unserem Pool die Creator aus, die zur Marke, zur Zielgruppe und zu deinem Angle passen. Typ, Sprache, Branche, Glaubwürdigkeit, alles muss stimmen. Wenn niemand passt, sourct ihr gezielt nach.

🔥 Qualitätssicherung: Du sichtest, was reinkommt, und prüfst es gegen dein Konzept. Sitzt die Hook, trägt der Text, passt Aussage und Markenfit, ist die Compliance sauber. Was dein Okay hat, geht zur Kundin.

🔥 Kundenkommunikation: Du präsentierst deine Konzepte selbst, holst Feedback ein und ordnest es ein, steuerst Freigaben und Textschleifen und sagst auch mal begründet Nein, wenn eine Änderung die Ad schwächer macht. Aus Ergebnissen und Kundenzielen leitest du die nächste Welle ab.

🔥 Creative Data: Du schaust dir an, welche Hook gehalten hat, welcher Satz den Scroll gestoppt hat und welches Format gelaufen ist. Die Learnings landen direkt im nächsten Skript. Testing-Logik statt Bauchgefühl.

Qualifikation

#wasdumitbringst

🤝 Erfahrung im Schreiben für Social: UGC Ads, Performance Copy, Content-Konzeption oder Redaktion, gerne aus Agentur, DTC-Brand oder Creator-Umfeld

🤝 Du kannst schreiben, und zwar viel. Hooks in Serie statt eine perfekte Zeile, Skripte, die gesprochen funktionieren, Briefings, bei denen niemand nachfragen muss

🤝 Du triffst Tonalitäten: die eine Marke klingt nach bester Freundin, die nächste nach Arzt. Beides kriegst du hin, ohne dass es aufgesetzt wirkt

🤝 Du weißt, was eine Ad verkauft und was nur schön ist. Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR und CPA sind für dich Arbeitsmaterial, nicht Reporting-Deko

🤝 Konzeptstärke: du denkst über den Text hinaus in Format, Ablauf und Bildidee

🤝 Ein gutes Auge für Menschen: du erkennst, welcher Creator deine Worte glaubwürdig trägt

🤝 Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Kund:innen, auch wenn Feedback mal unbequem ist, und die Fähigkeit, deine Textentscheidungen zu begründen

🤝 Du nimmst Korrekturen nicht persönlich und trennst berechtigtes Feedback von Geschmacksfragen

🤝 Struktur und Eigenverantwortung, gerade im Remote-Setup, und Verlässlichkeit bei Deadlines, weil hinter dir Creator und Editing warten

🤝 Offenheit für AI-Tools in Recherche und Ideation, mit dem Anspruch, dass die finale Zeile von dir kommt

🤝 Perfektes Deutsch und gutes Englisch

🤝 Du findest dich in unseren Werten wieder: Kundenbegeisterung, Authentizität, Qualitätsversprechen, Zuverlässigkeit und ein freundschaftliches Miteinander

Benefits

#partoftrafficdesign🩵

Social Heaven ist Teil von trafficdesign, einer der etablierten Online-Marketing-Agenturen mit Sitz in Köln und Hamburg und über 70 Kolleg:innen.

Für dich heißt das: Du arbeitest in einem kleinen, schnellen, remote-first Team mit kurzen Wegen und viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Gleichzeitig hast du die Strukturen einer großen Agentur im Rücken. Media Buyer, die dir sagen, wie deine Creatives wirklich performt haben. Analytics und Account Management, die du nicht selbst aufbauen musst. Zwei Büros, in die du kommen kannst, wenn du Lust auf Menschen hast. Weiterbildungsbudget, Coaching und ein Benefit-Paket, das du als kleine Content-Agentur sonst nicht bekommst. Und Karrierewege, die nicht an der Grenze einer Zehn-Personen-Firma enden.

Marke eigenständig, Ressourcen groß. Das ist der Deal 🤝

#benefits

Über die Gruppe bekommst du das volle trafficdesign Paket:

Remote Work, 100 % oder hybrid aus Köln und Hamburg

Deine persönliche Entwicklung steht bei uns im Vordergrund 🫵 (Coachings, Weiterbildungsbudget und jährliche Entwicklungsgespräche, in denen es nur um dich geht💜)

Regelmäßige Teamevents, Messen 🪩

Workation möglich 🏝️ (und zwar nicht nur auf dem Papier)

Hardware nach deiner Wahl, Essenszuschuss, Jobticket, Urban Sports Club, uvm.

Zwei Büros mit (Dach)-Terrasse ☀️

Dogs are welcome 🐶

  1. Bewerbung per Join ✍️ Lebenslauf reicht, ein paar Ads, die du konzipiert hast, freuen uns extra.
  2. Wir telefonieren kurz für den 1st Check "was suchst du und was suchen wir" 🔎
  3. Wir lernen uns danach in einem fachlicheren Video-Call noch besser kennen ✨
  4. Du bekommst eine kleine Konzeptaufgabe oder kommst zum Probetag, damit wir beide wissen, ob es passt 🚀
  5. Dann nur noch den Vertrag und das Onboarding 🫶

jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Quantitative Risk Analyst II supports the Financial Risk Management and Enterprise Risk Management functions through quantitative analysis, risk reporting, balance sheet analytics, model development, and automated reporting. This role focuses on market risk, liquidity risk, deposit analytics, and enterprise risk monitoring, while providing analytical support for credit risk and stress testing initiatives. Partners with Treasury, Finance, Credit Administration, and Risk teams to leverage data and analytical tools to identify emerging risks, enhance risk measurement, improve reporting efficiency, and support strategic decision-making through data-driven insights.

Duties & Responsibilities

Risk Analytics and Reporting

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance recurring risk reporting packages, dashboards, and analytical tools supporting Financial Risk Management and Enterprise Risk Management activities.
  • Produce meaningful analysis and reporting related to market risk, liquidity risk, credit risk, capital risk, and emerging enterprise risks.
  • Monitor and report key risk indicators, early warning indicators, and concentration measures.
  • Design and maintain executive-level reporting and visualizations for management.
  • Identify notable trends, anomalies, and emerging risks through ongoing analysis of internal and external data sources.

Market Risk and Balance Sheet Analytics

  • Perform quantitative analysis of interest rate risk and analyze balance sheet composition and trends to support strategic decision-making and risk oversight activities.
  • Support development of analytical frameworks used to assess the impact of changing economic and market conditions on earnings, capital, and liquidity.
  • Research and analyze macroeconomic, industry, and financial market trends to identify potential implications for the Bank's risk profile.

Deposit and Liquidity Risk Analytics

  • Assist in the development and enhancement of deposit behavior models, attrition analyses, deposit segmentation methodologies, and funding stability assessments.
  • Support analysis of uninsured deposits, deposit concentration metrics, customer behavior patterns, pricing sensitivity, and other liquidity-related risk indicators.
  • Produce analytical reporting related to funding sources, liquidity trends, and balance sheet stability.
  • Collaborate with Treasury and Finance to evaluate liquidity stress assumptions and changing customer behaviors across varying economic environments.

Quantitative Modeling and Data Analytics

  • Support the development, testing, implementation, monitoring, and enhancement of quantitative models used for risk measurement and decision support.
  • Apply statistical, econometric, forecasting, and data analysis techniques to evaluate relationships between economic variables and portfolio performance.
  • Utilize Python, SQL, and other analytical tools to develop automated processes, scenario analyses, forecasting solutions, and decision-support tools.

Stress Testing Support

  • Support enterprise stress testing activities through data preparation, scenario analysis, forecasting support, model execution, and reporting.
  • Assist in the preparation of analytical materials supporting loan portfolio, liquidity, and capital stress testing exercises.
  • Research economic trends and scenario drivers used in stress testing activities.
  • Provide quantitative support for management review and interpretation of stress testing results.

Innovation and Process Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability through automation and process redesign that help to reduce manual effort and improve data integrity.
  • Utilize modern analytical technologies, including artificial intelligence, machine learning, advanced analytics, and business intelligence platforms, to enhance reporting and analytical capabilities.
  • Special projects and initiatives that support ongoing risk management framework enhancements.

Education & Experience

Required Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Financial Engineering, Data Science or a closely related field.

Required Experience

  • 3-5 years of experience in banking, financial services, treasury, finance, risk management, portfolio analytics, quantitative analytics, or related disciplines.
  • Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence / data visualization platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of financial statement analysis.
  • Experience performing quantitative analysis using large and complex datasets.
  • Experience developing automated reporting, analytical tools, dashboards, or risk reporting processes.
  • Experience using Python, SQL, or similar analytical programming languages.
  • Experience communicating analytical findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

  • Banking industry experience involves market risk, liquidity risk, treasury, ALM, or portfolio analytics.
  • Experience supporting deposit analytics, balance sheet risk management, or funding risk assessments.
  • Experience utilizing Moody's analytical solutions (Moody’s Analytics, EFX, CMM).
  • Experience applying statistical, econometric, forecasting, or machine learning techniques.
  • AI-assisted development and workflow automation tools

Responsibilities

SafeGuard Services (SGS), a subsidiary of Peraton, performs data analysis, investigation, and medical review to detect, prevent, deter, reduce, and make referrals to recover fraud, waste, and abuse.

We are looking to add a Fraud Auditor Associate to our SGS team of talented professionals.

What you'll do:

The position is an entry level fraud investigator/auditor position expected to work under the direct supervision of a team manager and/or team lead. The team performs high level complex investigations of medical professional service providers and develops cases/reports for future action, including referral to law enforcement, education, over payment recovery and other administrative actions. This position will support the team of fraud investigators/auditors and will work with internal resources and external agencies to develop cases/audits and corrective actions as well as respond to requests for data and support.

  • The auditor uses good judgment and will work under the direct supervision of team manager and/or team lead
  • The audit associate will work in support of a team who works with state and/or federal investigators and other personnel.
  • The auditor handles multiple caseload assignments concurrently; organizes and analyzes information in support of the team’s workload
  • The auditor may also be required to assist in the completion of complex reports that apply regulations or rules to the program(s) affected by the behavior being reviewed.
  • Auditor will work collaboratively within the team and participate in researching and understanding the relevant offenses being reviewed; participate in conducting efficient and effective investigations/audits concerning those alleged offenses and detect or verify suspected violations; obtain information and evidence by observation, record examination, and interview.
  • Auditor will collaborate with team members to analyze the results of the investigation/audit to ascertain if the allegations have been corroborated and work with others to determine the appropriate steps that need to be taken to address the issues.
  • As part of an audit, the auditor will need to prepare correspondence; be objective and accurate and communicate with others with tact.
  • There may be times when auditors need to react to unplanned situations, be flexible in planning their activities and adopt effective courses of action.
  • As auditors will be working with health privacy information, they also must maintain confidentiality and understand all the laws, rules and regulations concerning health privacy.
  • Telework available from Eastern Time Zone

Qualifications

  • 0 years with BS/BA or 4 years with a HS Diploma/equivalent
  • Investigative and analytical experience
  • Strong communication and organization skills
  • Strong PC knowledge and skills
  • US. citizenship required

The most competitive candidates will have:

  • Strong background in investigations or compliance audits.
  • Experience in reviewing claims for technical requirements, performing medical review, and/or developing fraud cases and identifying overpayments.
  • Knowledge of investigative or audit practices regarding healthcare providers.
  • Knowledge of Medicare and/or Medicaid programs and the rules, regulations, policies and procedures
  • Background in evaluating, reviewing and analyzing medical claims and records
  • Ability to learn and operate a variety of data systems, equipment and tools used in investigations

Essential Functions:

  • Ability to perform research and draw conclusions
  • Ability to document information in support of investigative/audit workload of the team, present issues of concern, citing regulatory violations, alleging schemes or scams to defraud the Government
  • Ability to organize a case file, accurately and thoroughly document all steps taken
  • Ability to compose correspondence, reports and referral summary letters
  • Ability to educate providers, provider associations, law enforcement, other contractors and beneficiary advocacy groups on program safeguard matters
  • Ability to communicate effectively, internally and externally
  • Ability to interpret laws and regulations
  • Ability to handle confidential material.
  • Ability to report work activity on a timely basis.
  • Ability to work under direct supervision as a member of a team to deliver high-quality work
  • Ability to attend meetings, training conferences and overnight travel may be required.

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. About This Job

The Commercial Loan Officer – Income Property Lending (IPL) is responsible for originating, structuring, underwriting, and closing commercial real estate loans secured by income-producing properties. This role focuses on building and managing relationships with borrowers, brokers, and referral partners while identifying lending opportunities that align with the Bank’s credit standards and growth objectives. The Commercial Loan Officer serves as a trusted advisor throughout the lending process and works closely with Credit, Underwriting, Closing, Portfolio Management, and Servicing teams to deliver exceptional client service and high-quality loan production.

The IPL business focuses on financing stabilized and value-add commercial real estate assets including multifamily, office, retail, industrial, medical office, hospitality, mixed-use, and self-storage properties.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain relationships with commercial real estate investors, borrowers, mortgage brokers, and other referral sources
  • Source new lending opportunities for acquisition, refinance, cash-out, bridge, and value-add transactions
  • Analyze borrower financial statements, rent rolls, operating statements, and property cash flows to assess creditworthiness and lending opportunities.
  • Structure loan transactions that meet borrower objectives while adhering to credit policy and risk management guidelines
  • Evaluate key credit metrics including Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR), Loan-to-Value (LTV), debt yield, sponsorship strength, and global cash flow.
  • Present lending opportunities and recommendations to Credit and Executive Management
  • Negotiate loan terms, pricing, and conditions with borrowers and referral partners
  • Manage the transaction process from initial screening through funding, ensuring timely execution and an exceptional client experience
  • Coordinate with Underwriting, Appraisal, Legal, Closing, and Portfolio Management teams throughout the loan lifecycle
  • Monitor market trends, property values, and competitive lending activity within assigned territories
  • Maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities and achieve established production goals
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and credit standards
  • Support portfolio retention efforts, loan modifications, and relationship expansion opportunities as needed

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Real Estate, Accounting, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in commercial real estate lending, income property lending, commercial banking, or CRE originations
  • Strong understanding of commercial real estate finance and credit analysis
  • Experience underwriting and structuring loans secured by multifamily, office, industrial, retail, hospitality, mixed-use, and other income-producing properties
  • Working knowledge of DSCR, LTV, debt yield, NOI analysis, borrower global cash flow, and commercial loan documentation
  • Established network of commercial real estate borrowers, brokers, and industry professionals preferred
  • Strong sales, negotiation, and relationship management skills
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication abilities
  • Ability to manage multiple transactions and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and commercial lending systems

Axos Employee Benefits May Include:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance

  • Paid Sick Leave, 3 weeks’ Vacation, and Holidays (about 11 a year)

  • HSA or FSA account and other voluntary benefits

  • 401(k) Retirement Saving Plan with Employer Match Program and 529 Savings Plan

  • Employee Mortgage Loan Program and free access to an Axos Bank Account with Self-Directed Trading

Born digital-first, Axos delivers financial tools and services that allow individuals, small businesses, and companies to access and manage their money how, when, and where they want. We’re a diverse team of dynamic, insightful, and independent innovators who are excited to provide technology-driven solutions that offer unbeatable value to our customers.

Axos Financial is our holding company and is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "AX" (NYSE: AX).

This position serves as the liaison between University stakeholders and companies, major national and international foundations and non-profit entities, and government agencies. CAS uses intuitive technology, unparalleled scientific content and unmatched human expertise to help companies create groundbreaking innovations that benefit the world. As the scientific information solutions division of the American Chemical Society, CAS manages the largest curated reservoir of scientific knowledge, and for 119 years, has helped innovators mine, assess and apply that information to keep enterprises thriving. The CAS team is global, diverse, endlessly curious and strives to make scientific insights accessible to innovators worldwide.

CAS is currently seeking a Customer Success Manager on our Sales team. This position is remote and can be located anywhere in the United States.

Position Summary

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is accountable for profitable achievement of sales objectives for Academic accounts in an assigned territory by identifying opportunities to grow, retain, cross-sell, and penetrate the customer utilizing the product portfolio and services.

Identifies new customer opportunities, tracks selling activities, and manages contact information for sales prospects. Delivers sales presentations and partners with technical specialists in the field for the purpose of customer onboarding and consultative selling activity. Ensures that organizational products meet client needs.

The Customer Success function serves the Academic community by delivering consistently high-quality customer experience, ensuring that Academic customers receive value from CAS solutions, continue to partner with CAS, and expand their relationship where appropriate.

Position Accountabilities

The CSM ensures that every customer realizes the full value of CAS solutions by:

  • Onboarding, enabling, and teaching Academic users and customers how to realize the full value of CAS solutions.
  • Managing an assigned book of business and building, expanding, and solidifying relationships with existing clients via necessary sales and support visits, calls, emails, and presentations, with the expectation of creating, advancing, and closing revenue opportunities within an assigned territory.
  • Effectively identifying, communicating, and working through customer problems, issues, and opportunities.
  • Anticipating and driving growth of additional services and coverage levels by conducting thorough needs assessments and matching these needs to the appropriate solutions.
  • Cultivating relationships with the most senior buyer(s) in the client organization, as well as with day-to-day client representatives and buyers.
  • Following the established sales process and consistently utilizing the CRM to document prospect interaction, ensuring efficient lead management.
  • Monitoring customer dashboards, identifying risks, and acting where necessary to ensure optimal customer experience and product usage.
  • Understanding the importance of timely follow-up with customers, managers, and staff, and making communication a top priority.
  • Developing and maintaining workflows to maximize selling time (utilizing AI platforms and processes where available), including pre-call planning and adherence to metrics and customized scripts based on opportunity type.
  • Attending and presenting at trade shows, events, and conferences.
  • Adopting central AI tools to enable rapid analysis of usage data, contract information, and market data for risk and opportunity reporting.

Minimum Education/Experience/Technological Knowledge

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in science-related fields, business, communications, or other related disciplines
  • Three or more years of sales-related experience, which could include: lead generation; inside and outside sales; business development; customer service.
  • Proven track record of exceeding sales objectives and territory/account development
  • Experience with CRM and opportunity management systems, preferably Salesforce.com
  • Strategic thinking capabilities with strong analytical and problem-solving skills in selling science-related solutions and/or information/intellectual property that impacts performance
  • Strong capacity to articulate industry-specific value proposition to address customer pain points.
  • Experience with traveling for work-related projects or meetings with customers.
  • Advanced level of diagnostic/consultative selling
  • Demonstrated experience with virtual selling tools such as Zoom, Web-Ex, and other comparable tools
  • Experience of selling into, or working within, the Academic market would be preferred, but not essential.

CAS offers a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including a generous vacation plan, medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, and employee savings and retirement plans. Candidates for this position must be authorized to work in the United States and not require work authorization sponsorship by CAS for this position now or in the future. jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking a highly technical, hands-on Principal AI Research Cybersecurity Scientist to drive fast-paced research in frontier AI models, benchmarking, and evaluation.

The ideal candidate combines strong research credentials with exceptional engineering capabilities and a proven ability to execute rapid research cycles, moving quickly from identifying research questions to building prototypes, running experiments, and delivering actionable results.

The role requires deep expertise in LLMs, foundation models, reasoning, agents, and model evaluation, alongside the ability to translate complex customer challenges into measurable research outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct hands-on research in frontier AI models, reasoning, agents, and multimodal systems.
  • Design, implement, and iterate on AI benchmarks, evaluation frameworks, and experimental pipelines.
  • Execute short, high-impact research cycles, rapidly moving from hypotheses to experiments, prototypes, and validated findings.
  • Identify model limitations, evaluation gaps, and emerging research opportunities.
  • Work directly with customers and technical stakeholders to translate complex challenges into actionable research.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to turn research findings into practical solutions.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • PhD or MSc in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or a related field, with strong relevant research experience.
  • Strong publication record at leading AI/ML conferences such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, or equivalent venues.
  • Exceptional hands-on technical capabilities, including advanced Python, PyTorch, and experience building and evaluating complex AI systems.
  • Proven ability to independently design, implement, and execute research experiments within short development cycles.
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, foundation models, benchmarking, and evaluation methodologies.
  • Experience with frontier AI labs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google DeepMind is a strong advantage.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, customer-driven research environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI for Cybersecurity, including autonomous security agents, vulnerability research, penetration-testing automation, or security operations.
  • Experience with Security of AI, including LLM red teaming, adversarial machine learning, prompt injection, and agentic AI security.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and environments such as CTFs, sandboxed exploitation environments, static/dynamic code analysis, and security testing frameworks.
  • Experience developing cybersecurity benchmarks or evaluating frontier models on complex security-related tasks.

About Alice

Alice is a trust, safety, and security company built for the AI era. We safeguard the communicative technologies people use to create, collaborate, and interact- whether with each other or with machines.

In a world where AI has fundamentally changed the nature of risk, Alice provides end-to-end coverage across the entire AI lifecycle. We support frontier model labs, enterprises, and UGC platforms with a comprehensive suite of solutions: from model hardening evaluations and pre-deployment red-teaming to runtime guardrails and ongoing drift detection.

Alice is widely considered a global leader in online safety and AI security. We have some of the most forward-thinking and passionate minds in the world working to safeguard over 3 billion users across the largest AI and tech platforms.

If you're creative and driven to secure the future of AI, we want to hear from you!

jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

iTech AG is seeking a ServiceNow Architect – Field Service Management (FSM) / CMMS to lead the solution architecture for the Intelas Next Generation Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) program — a commercial healthcare engagement delivered for Intelas (a Compass Group USA company). This is a senior, architect-level role responsible for owning the end-to-end FSM solution design on the ServiceNow platform and the integration architecture that connects it across multiple ServiceNow products — FSM, Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)/CMDB, Customer Service Management (CSM)/Service Portal, Virtual Agent, IntegrationHub, and AI/Now Assist.

The ideal candidate is a true ServiceNow architect who has implemented FSM end-to-end — from solution and data model design through dispatch, mobile, customer portals, parts/inventory, and integrations — and can direct developers to deliver it. They bring proven experience architecting cross-product ServiceNow solutions and enterprise integrations, ideally in a healthcare, clinical/medical device (biomed/imaging), or asset-intensive setting. This role owns the Technical Solution Document (TSD), defines integration and security patterns, and collaborates with the iTech Solution SME, the Intelas Product Owner, iTech Master Architects (Dustin Barre and Allen Andreas), and dispatch/field operations teams using ServiceNow'sNow Create methodology — including data migration from teamCHAMPS/Nuvolo and integrations to OEM, RFID/RTLS, logistics, FDA/recall, and Snowflake.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the end-to-end solution architecture for the Intelas NextGen CMMS on ServiceNow FSM, including solution design, data model, and the phased roadmap across modules
  • Define the multi-product ServiceNow architecture spanning FSM, Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)/CMDB, Customer Service Management (CSM)/Service Portal, Virtual Agent, IntegrationHub, and AI/Now Assist
  • Author and maintain the Technical Solution Document (TSD) — architecture diagrams, data model, integration patterns, and security model — and drive architecture decisions and approvals each sprint
  • Architect and lead the implementation of ServiceNow FSM capabilities across the solution, including:
    • Work Order Management
    • Task Management
    • Scheduling and Dispatch
    • Mobile Workforce Enablement
    • Customer Communication and Self-Service
    • Inventory and Asset Management
    • Route Optimization and Resource Coordination
  • Define configuration standards and the design for digital work orders, field tasks, assignment rules, dispatch queues, and workflow automations
  • Develop and support task bundling, questionnaires, inspection checklists, and compliance verification workflows
  • Configure the work order lifecycle and dispatch model to Intelas' operating rules, including:
    • Work order lifecycle configuration
    • Automated skills-based dispatch is the system of record; manual reassignment is supported as an exception workflow, with dispatch logic and assignment rules
    • Technician Skills & Certifications (eQMS data usage)
    • User Types (e.g., biomed, imaging, cyber, apprentice, intern, etc.)
    • Customer Satisfaction/Preferences by Technician
    • Technician skills and availability, and scheduling setup
    • Overtime Approval Process
    • Technician Manager Discretion
    • First In/First Out, Priority/Impact
    • Workload of technician
    • Customer-facing output artifacts, including downloadable PDF work order packets for customer access and audit purposes
  • Support customer-initiated service requests, appointment booking, ticket visibility, and scheduling preferences (including preferred/favorite technicians) through the Service Portal and/or UI Builder
  • Configure route optimization and travel efficiency capabilities for field crews and technicians
  • Design, develop, and support mobile field service experiences including offline functionality and mobile work execution
  • Configure time tracking, labor tracking, and field activity reporting capabilities
  • Support collaboration features including chat, file sharing, and communication between dispatchers and field personnel
  • Configure proactive customer communications including ETA notifications, appointment reminders, and job status updates
  • Develop external customer-facing portals and web-embedded Virtual Agent experiences enabling service request submission, ticket visibility, role-based access, and downloadable PDF work order packets for customer and audit purposes
  • Support inventory and asset management capabilities including:
    • Warehouse inventory visibility
    • Truck stock inventory tracking
    • Consumable and parts usage logging
    • Automated inventory adjustments based on field usage
  • Design and govern the integration architecture between ServiceNow FSM/EAM and external systems including OneSource OEM manuals, Asimly utilization data, Vizzia/Intelligent Locations RFID/RTLS, FedEx/UPS shipment tracking, FDA & recall vendors, customer SSO, and the Snowflake data warehouse
  • Support Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) configuration and data migration — asset hierarchy and classes, preventive maintenance (monthly/quarterly), parts/inventory, and migration of data tables, PMs, and checklists from teamCHAMPS/Nuvolo into ServiceNow
  • Support Clinical Device Management (CDM) workflows and AI-assisted use cases such as recommended repair and skills-based routing as defined in the approved Technical Solution Document (TSD)
  • Establish development standards and hands-on build the most complex components — custom applications, workflows, business rules, UI policies, integrations, and Flow Designer automations
  • Partner with iTech AG Master Architects and the Solution SME on cross-product architecture and technical governance
  • Participate in Agile / Now Create ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, demos, and retrospectives, and contribute to Technical Solution Document (TSD) updates each sprint
  • Lead code and design reviews, mentor developers, and enforce platform best practices and technical governance
  • Support platform upgrades, patching, and performance optimization activities
  • Troubleshoot and resolve FSM defects, mobile issues, and production support requests
  • Ensure configurations and customizations align with Intelas data governance, quality/compliance (e.g., Joint Commission, eQMS, CAPA), and platform security requirements
  • Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge transfer, and operational readiness activities
  • Support organizational change management and end-user adoption efforts for FSM capabilities

jobs.excerpt: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations.
jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:

The CrowdStrike Data Science team is looking for a Principal Researcher to lead the technical direction of our AI red teaming research. This is an individual contributor role at the top of the technical ladder. You do not manage people. You set the research agenda, you do the hardest research yourself, you build the tooling that makes it repeatable, and you raise the bar for the researchers around you.


Our mission is to find out what can make an AI agent do something it should not, and whether the controls hold. We study how agentic systems are influenced through the channels they act on: tool results, files, MCP servers, web content, skills, memory and inter-agent messages. We red team frontier models and the agentic systems built on them, and we score every attack on observed actions, not on transcripts. Findings go through coordinated disclosure, become reusable attack modules in our automated AI security testing platform, and gate what ships in CrowdStrike's own AI products.

As the Principal Researcher, you decide which questions the team studies next, you answer the ones nobody else can, and you are the final technical reviewer on every disclosure, attack class and lab design. You are measured on whether the research got better, whether it reached the outside world, and whether the seniors around you can now do what only you could do before.


What You'll Do:


Research (about half of your time):

  • Bring the research subjects. Propose and prioritise the attack classes, agent target classes and frontier model behaviours the team studies, with a written rationale for each and a kill date.
  • Red team frontier models and the agentic systems. Track how each model release shifts attack success, agent behaviour and the controls that hold, and publish the result.
  • Conduct vulnerability research and security assessments on agentic ecosystems end to end: hypothesis, exploit, observed action, disclosure, patch verification.
  • Deliver state-of-the-art research: internal research notes on a monthly cadence, external papers, conference talks and coordinated disclosures with vendor credit.
  • Investigate failure modes personally where the evidence is hardest to get: multi-agent systems, long-horizon tasks, defences that look like they work.

Tooling for research and red teaming:

  • Design and write the tooling the research depends on: attack harnesses, action-trace capture, tool-call interception, payload converters, isolated lab targets and reproducible experiment runners.
  • Turn each finding into a reusable attack module with an executing payload test in the team's automated AI security testing platform, and set the engineering bar for how that is done.
  • Define the shared formats for attack content and action traces so red team output can be scored, replayed and reused by the benchmarking work without conversion.

Technical guidance (no people management):

  • Own the external research agenda for AI red teaming: which venues, which disclosures, which collaborations, and the quality bar for anything that leaves the team.
  • Review benchmark methodology from the other pillar for attacker realism, and accept review of your own findings for evidence quality.
  • Communicate findings, limitations and risk clearly to engineering, product owners, legal and executives. Report what was not tested as plainly as what was.

What You'll Need:


  • A public record of original security research: CVEs, coordinated disclosures, conference talks or peer-reviewed papers that you led. For this level we expect the record to be substantial and verifiable.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in offensive security: exploitation, vulnerability research or red teaming, with the ability to find and demonstrate a vulnerability end to end yourself.
  • Demonstrated research on LLMs or agentic systems: prompt and environment injection, tool-use abuse, jailbreaks, multi-agent attacks, or model evaluation under adversarial conditions. Shareable artifacts required.
  • Strong Python and systems engineering skills. You write the harnesses, interceptors and converters the team runs on, and you review others' code to a production standard.
  • Practical understanding of how agentic systems are built: tool use, planning loops, MCP, memory, sandboxing, and where trust boundaries sit.
  • Experience setting technical direction for other researchers as a tech lead or principal, with evidence that people you worked with went on to lead work themselves.
  • Exceptional written communication. Your research notes, disclosures and papers are the team's external face.

Bonus Points:


  • Published research on AI security, agent security or adversarial machine learning at recognised venues.
  • Experience red teaming frontier models directly, or working with frontier model providers on disclosures.
  • Patents or shipped tooling in automated red teaming, agent evaluation or security testing.
  • Experience with isolated lab design: sandboxing, egress control, C2 sinkholes, telemetry retention.

Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards
  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
  • Paid parental and adoption leaves
  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections

At Sunrun, we’re on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we’re building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. To do it, we’re designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. It’s why we’ve become the #1 home solar and battery company in America. We’re unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle – from sale through installation and beyond – so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.

Who We Are

We’re on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs. Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses.


OVERVIEW

Sunrun’s business model is complex and subject to a large body of dynamic inputs (both controllable and non-controllable) which impact our unit economics on an ongoing basis. Understanding and responding to these inputs in real time is critical to achieving strong, predictable financial outcomes. The Pricing team plays a critical role in developing the modeling frameworks that represent our storage and solar project economics and driving commercial decisions involving pricing and sales commissions to maximize profitability across the portfolio.

As the Senior Associate, Strategic Pricing, you will lead the development and maintenance of sophisticated pricing tools and processes that serve as the single source of truth for project proceeds and cost assumptions. You will work in tight coordination with senior leadership to drive expedient, coordinated decision-making with the goal of maximizing our profitability outcomes. This role sits at the intersection of finance, product, and revenue strategy, requiring you to ensure that finance leadership can quickly interpret and certify economic outputs while revenue strategy relies on your models for competitive proposals.

You will be responsible for recommending and executing new forms of pricing and commissions that accomplish corporate objectives, following through with change management and execution across various revenue channels. You will initiate regular collaboration with sales and operations leadership to understand pricing trade-offs and opportunities that increase profitability while enabling robust volume growth. By maintaining key competitive benchmarks and market share reports, you will also ensure our pricing remains competitive in the market.

Success in this role requires an exceptional balance of finance acumen and "get it done" grit. You must be able to operate both at a high level—influencing boardroom decisions—and in the weeds of complex financial modeling. We are looking for an impact-oriented leader who prioritizes solutions that yield the greatest return on time and effort, driving continuous improvement through a crawl-walk-run approach to sophisticated financial problems.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the accuracy and utility of core financial pricing tools and partnering with finance leadership to ensure tight feedback loop with corporate planning and forecasting

  • Partner with CFO and Revenue leaders to recommend and execute pricing and commission structures that maximize profitability

  • Standardize financial proposal formats to reduce executive review time and improve commercial velocity

  • Maintain competitive pricing benchmarks and market share reports to inform strategic value proposition adjustments

  • Lead trade-off analyses between volume growth and margin expansion to optimize total portfolio profitability

  • Continuously improve customer expectation setting pertaining to savings including periodically auditing sales behavior and customer feedback

  • Assist in business case development with sales leadership considering new business opportunities such as market expansion and new acquisition channels

  • Collaborate with Product teams on various new products [such as residential storage, residential distributed compute, and distributed power plants] to inform product strategy & business model

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL DEMONSTRATE

  • Exceptional Analytical skills: Can digest and analyze vast sets of data and build robust yet simple models that are outcome and impact oriented

  • Adaptability: Adjusts quickly to changing priorities and conditions; anticipates and copes effectively with the complexity of change (i.e., real-time support for adjustments in response to macro changes, where new scenarios must be quickly digested and analyzed)

  • Strategic Judgment: Develops the judgment to understand our products to inform strategy (i.e., implications of state rebates on our revenue, how utility tariffs impact our value proposition

  • Collaboration/Organizational Influence: Collaborates effectively with and influences a wide range of cross functional leaders including policy, sales leaders, product, finance and marketing

  • Organized and Impact-Oriented: Creates accessible tools for tracking and communicating top policy objectives including estimates of impact, status, and action items required

  • Communication & Storytelling: Can communicate concepts succinctly and effectively with the executive leadership team and influence meetings. Can develop succinct and impactful materials that drive quick and effective decisions

  • Versatility: Ability to operate both at a high level and get in the weeds (e.g., boardroom polish + get it done grit)

​

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

  • 3-5+ years of overall experience within financial services, renewable energy finance, commercial strategy, investment banking, corporate finance, or management consulting.

Functional & Specific Expertise

  • Proven experience building complex financial models that bridge project-level unit economics, dynamic market inputs, and portfolio P&L outcomes.

  • Demonstrated track record in pricing strategy and margin optimization, specifically designing pricing frameworks and sales commission models that maximize profitability.

  • Proven capability in executive communication and influence, with direct experience presenting complex quantitative scenarios and recommendations to C-suite decision-makers.

  • Demonstrated cross-functional leadership as an individual contributor, driving alignment and execution across Sales, Operations, Product, and Finance without direct supervisory authority. Experience working on high-performing teams in a fast-paced corporate environment

  • Undergraduate degree in Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

Location: This is a remote-based role that requires flexibility and willingness to travel within a specified region and for company-related purposes as needed.

The Opportunity

Praxis Precision Medicines is entering a pivotal moment as we prepare for commercialization, and how we build and scale capability across the organization will directly impact our success.We are seeking a driven and customer-focused Account Specialist to execute in the field and drive commercial performance across a defined territory. This individual will be responsible for engaging healthcare providers, building strong customer relationships, and delivering on commercial objectives.

Working closely with cross-functional partners, you will play a critical role in supporting product launches, driving adoption, and ensuring patients gain access to innovative therapies.

What You’ll Do

  • Execute territory business plans to achieve and exceed sales goals.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with healthcare providers and key stakeholders.
  • Drive product adoption through effective customer engagement and education.
  • Navigate complex patient pathways and support access to therapy.
  • Partner with Market Access, Strategic Accounts, Patient Services, and Medical teams to optimize customer and patient outcomes.
  • Support launch execution, including pre-launch planning and post-launch adoption strategies.
  • Leverage insights from the field to inform strategy and improve execution.
  • Maintain a high level of product, disease state, and market knowledge.
  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory and company policies.

How You Work

  • You think in terms of systems, not silos.
  • You balance rigor with speed, knowing when each matters most.
  • You hold a high bar for performance, quality, and accountability.
  • You collaborate deeply but act with ownership and urgency.
  • You are passionate about building strong customer relationships and driving impact for patients.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of direct sales experience in CNS or specialty pharmaceuticals.
  • Deep understanding of complex patient pathways and specialist prescriber dynamics.
  • Participation in a recent product launch highly preferred, including familiarity with pre-launch planning and early market execution.
  • Experience with formulary access strategies and early market penetration tactics.
  • Experience selling into hospital systems, IDNs, and institutional accounts is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of specialty pharmacy and hub services models.
  • Demonstrated track record of strong, consistent performance against quota and territory goals.
  • Evidence of execution against target metrics with year-over-year improvement.
  • The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement.  You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

To round out our world-class total rewards package, we provide annualized base salary in the range listed below. This range reflects the base salary the Company reasonably expects to pay for the position at the time of posting. Placement within the range will be based on job-related factors, including experience, qualifications, scope of responsibilities, and demonstrated track record of delivering results in similar roles.

Annualized Base Salary
$160,000—$192,000 USD

Compensation & BenefitsAt Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive.  This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans. We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future?  We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP.  We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns.  Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring.  We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results.  Let’s achieve the impossible together!

Company Overview

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance. At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders. Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
Guided by our core values, at Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. we continue to DARE FOR MORE® to advance, promote, and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion by encouraging individuals to bring their authentic selves and perspectives to work each day. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, genetics, military service and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

We strive to build solutions to client problems which find the right balance of speed of feature development, sustainable maintenance and ease of scaling. We also support our apps in production for most clients. We’re first and foremost a service delivery company.

Ackama Group is comprised of mainly developers, designers, project managers, and business development staff. We value the work we do, the people we do it with, and the clients we do it for.

A role you’ll love:

Your role as business development manager for Ackama Group will be focused on driving sustainable financial growth through boosting sales and forging strong relationships with clients. You’ll be working in the sales and marketing team, comprised of 6+ individuals currently, to work towards acquiring new business primarily. Your day to day will involve a range of activities to find new clients, pursuing expansion of accounts, and keeping up to date records on revenue forecasting, invoicing, contracts, and client communications.

  • Develop a growth strategy focused both on financial gain and customer satisfaction
  • Managing account managers
  • Arrange business meetings with prospective clients, and complete follow up activities
  • Promote the company’s services addressing or predicting clients’ objectives
  • Co-design and execute the various aspects of the sales processes implemented by the company
  • Keep records up to date of sales, revenue, invoices etc.
  • Provide trustworthy feedback between clients and project teams and after-sales support
  • Build long-term relationships with new and existing customers
  • Create, manage, and grow high-level professional relationships with clients, ideally across divisions and at C-level
  • Direct competitor analysis and find key areas where the company can grow market share and cement a leadership position in the market
  • Contribute to sales team recruitment as needed
  • Provide timely constructive feedback to team members to help uplift the team
  • Working with the sales team to help close deals for the business
Your key performance indicators (KPI’s) will be focused on measuring and monitoring:
  • Revenue targets being achieved - $2M in revenue per year

We never discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

About Soum:

Soum is a fast-growing B2C marketplace based in Riyadh, connecting buyers and sellers of used electronics and used cars across Saudi Arabia. Built on trust, speed, and a strong sense of ownership, our commercial team is central to how we grow revenue and deepen relationships with the buyers who purchase from us at scale.

About the Role:

We're hiring a Key Account Manager to own and grow relationships with our buyer accounts — including buyers purchasing products from Soum in bulk. You'll be the primary point of contact for these accounts, responsible for their satisfaction, retention, and growth, while coordinating closely with internal teams to deliver a seamless buying experience.

This is a commercial, buyer-facing role. It is not a procurement, sourcing, vendor management, or operations position — you will be developing and managing the accounts that buy from us, not the vendors or supply chain that feed us.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and manage a portfolio of buyer/client accounts, acting as the primary point of contact for buyers purchasing products from Soum.
  • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key accounts, understanding their needs and purchasing patterns.
  • Drive account growth by developing new accounts and identifying upsell and expansion opportunities within existing ones.
  • Own retention and customer satisfaction, proactively addressing account needs before they become issues.
  • Coordinate with internal teams (operations, logistics, finance, and product) to ensure a smooth, reliable experience for buyers from order to delivery.
  • Track account performance and health, reporting regularly on growth, retention, and satisfaction metrics.
  • Identify and onboard new bulk/large-scale buyers to expand Soum's commercial buyer base.
    •

Qualifications:

Required:

  • 5 years of experience in Key Account Management, Account Management, or Client/Customer Success in a commercial, buyer-facing capacity.
  • A track record of developing and managing buyer/client relationships — not vendor, supplier, or procurement relationships.
  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills, with the ability to act as a trusted point of contact for clients.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functionally with internal teams to resolve issues and improve the customer experience.
  • Proven ability to drive account growth, retention, and customer satisfaction against clear targets.
  • Comfort working with data to track account health, growth, and retention.
    •

• Fluent in Arabic and English.

Good to Have:

  • Existing relationships with large-scale, second-hand electronics buyers who purchase in bulk.
  • Experience managing accounts that purchase at scale (bulk/wholesale) rather than individual retail buyers.
  • Familiarity with the resale, refurbished electronics, or B2B wholesale/marketplace industry.
  • Experience using a CRM to manage pipeline, account health, and reporting.
