However, despite those differences, there are a few principal attributes that we share which define an AltoVitian. AltoVitians are tenacious, humble, and thoughtful. Being humble is important because it enables us to keep learning every day, and tenacity is necessary because in a high performing environment as fast-paced as AltoVita, taking it slow is simply not an option!

As we look to scale our Global Commercial engine, today is a particularly exciting time to join our team. This next chapter won’t always be a smooth ride, but it will be filled with innovation, excitement and opportunities. If you are ambitious, commercially hungry and ready for the challenge (and the fun!) of growing with us, we would love to hear from you.

What we do

AltoVita is a multi-award winning accommodation platform that enables enterprises to consolidate accommodation programmes through the power of proprietary technology paired with a human centric approach.

AltoVita’s unique offering sets us apart in the market, providing a network of 10 million+ verified and vetted properties are all duty of care compliant, backed by a four-tier quality control process; located in over 35,000 cities & 165 countries world-wide. With our award-winning enterprise software and human-centric approach, we deliver smart and sustainable solutions to global talent mobility & business travel managers worldwide.

Our Client Development team plays a vital role as trusted advisors and partners to our clients. Embodying our consultative philosophy, this dedicated team proactively shares new market insights, analyzes data, and empowers our clients with the tools and knowledge to make informed decisions, ensuring our clients are always equipped to make the best choices for their corporate housing needs.

AltoVita’s technology provides a cloud-based bridge between the highly fragmented property distribution system and multinational Global 2000 companies. A proprietary two-way API integration with a standardised sourcing process reduces the legacy, inefficient 48-to-72-hour bidding process down to a few minutes, saving valuable time and money.

Corporate clients love the bespoke user interface seamlessly configured to their mobility policies, and employees enjoy a greater sense of choice and support in their relocation journey.

About the role

The Director of Sales, EMEA, will support AltoVita's Sales and Business Development efforts in the region, reporting into the SVP Sales EMEA. This is an external facing role focused on building credible relationships, opening doors with new prospects, and creating qualified opportunities.

This is a mid-level opportunity for someone ambitious, commercially hungry, and highly coachable, with real potential to grow into a more senior sales role at AltoVita as you prove yourself.

The Sales Director, EMEA, will be measured on revenue related KPI’s and will share responsibility and accountability for the success of AltoVita’s sales efforts in the region. Please note, this role will be based in the UK and you must have relevant work history. Please only apply if you have demand side experience, not supply side.

Your Responsibilities will be to:

  • Identify new business opportunities within the EMEA region, including new markets, growth areas, trends, customers, and services.

  • Build a well diversified pipeline of qualified opportunities by seeking out the right contacts within target organisations and generating leads through outreach and cold calling.

  • Learn, master and fluently demonstrate AltoVita’s technology across all verticals and stages of the sales pipeline.

  • Consistently elevate AltoVita’s brand awareness through thought leadership, LinkedIn presence, and hosting high-impact webinars, roundtables and industry events.

  • Work with the Marketing team to support lead acquisition and nurturing.

  • Leverage your network to build genuine, credible relationships with prospective clients, employees, and other stakeholders.

  • Meet with prospects face to face or virtually, and attend relevant conferences and industry events to build AltoVita's presence in the market.

  • Act as a trusted first point of contact, earning credibility and open doors that convert into qualified sales opportunities.

  • Keep abreast of trends and changes in relocation, business travel, hospitality, corporate housing, and serviced apartment industries.

  • Develop, forecast, and report on your sales funnel whilst demonstrating full accountability

  • Optimise travel between the region to maximise sales efforts and minimise expenses.

  • Clearly and consistently communicate pipeline progress to your line managers and internal stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with the Product and Client Development teams to feed back client needs and market learnings.

  • Hand off qualified opportunities to the enablement/closing team at the right stage, ensuring a smooth transition.

  • Learn and upscale to new verticals and geographies that are important for the company

What you will bring:

  • Core: strategic thinking, innovation, sound decision making, strong collaboration & communication, comfort with change, agility, and a client-centric mindset.
  • Leadership: ownership & accountability, resource and performance management, and a track record of developing others (as your book of business and any team grow).
  • Meta: a strong learning orientation, critical thinking & problem solving, and adaptability & resilience.

Who you are:

  • 3+ years in (external) sales in the EMEA region

  • 3+ years experience within the business travel or corporate housing industry

  • Tenacious and driven

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, sometimes less structured and entrepreneurial environment

Ways of Working

AltoVita is a fully remote team. Although we have regular touch-points throughout the week, organise off-sites in several locations, trust is essential for us to work effectively as a team. Our founders empower us to make decisions autonomously, and in turn expect that we also empower our direct reports.

Join our Team

Position Summary

Unified Health is hiring for Customer Service Representatives to independently verify consumer enrollments during our peak enrollment season.

This is a non-sales role. TPV representatives do not sell, recommend, compare, or enroll consumers in any Medicare Advantage, Part D, and they work independently from the licensed agents whose enrollments they verify.

  • Conduct recorded verification calls with consumers, following approved TPV scripts word for word.

  • Confirm the consumer's understanding of the selected plan, effective date, and key plan elements as scripted.
  • Obtain and document the consumer's clear, voluntary consent to enroll.

  • Escalate suspected agent misconduct, consumer complaints, and potential fraud to Compliance the same day.

jobs.excerpt: Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services.
jobs.description:
Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our Mission is to “Transform mental health by making it more accessible, affordable and effective”.


Position Type: Full-Time | Remote | Hourly, Non-Exempt

Compensation: $20 / hour

Schedule: 40 hours per week withfull-time shifts Monday - Thursday between 8:30am - 8pm CST (preferred 11:30am - 8pm CST); Saturday - Sunday between 8:00am - 5:30pm CST


Who We Are

Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our mission is to empower our patients to live healthier, more rewarding lives through accessible, affordable, and effective mental healthcare tailored to their needs. Our Patient Support Center is the front door to that care, often a patient’s first human connection with Geode and the first step in removing barriers between someone seeking help and the provider who can support them.


The Role


The Patient Support Specialist is a high-impact, phone-first role at the heart of patient access and acquisition. You are an ambassador for patients and care teams and the first voice many prospective patients hear and a key partner in helping them move from interest or referral to a scheduled first visit. You’ll turn high-intent inbound calls, referral callbacks, and web leads into appointments while delivering a warm, hospitality-driven experience. A smaller share of your day is spent helping established patients by resolving simple requests or routing them to the right team.

This is a fast-paced, quality-focused environment for people who care deeply about both outcomes and experience. You’ll use strong virtual human connection, sound judgment, and customer-centric problem solving to remove barriers to care, connect each patient to the right provider, and help activate a trusted relationship with their care team. If you bring empathy, urgency, and a growth mindset, and believe every call is an opportunity to help someone take the next step, this role is for you.


What You’ll Do


Convert High-Intent Inbound Calls

  • Answer new patient inbound calls, including referral callbacks and consumer leads with warmth, urgency, and a bias toward booking the first visit.
  • Match each patient to the right provider using screening questions, insurance, provider preferences, and scheduling tools to secure the best-fit appointment.
  • Guide ambivalent or hesitant callers toward a confident “yes” using empathy, reflective listening, communication frameworks and sound judgment while removing barriers without pressure.
  • Set clear expectations for the first visit so patients arrive informed, comfortable, and ready to attend.
  • Collaborate with internal teams when needed to resolve open questions and create a seamless handoff for patients and providers.

Support Established Patients

  • Handle a smaller volume of established-patient contacts, resolving simple requests or routing to the right team quickly and accurately.
  • Capture complete, accurate patient context and insurance information; follow up to close any gaps.

Grow Through Coaching & Quality

  • Work toward individual and team goals for conversion, answer rate/service level, quality, and after-call work, using feedback and performance insights to keep improving.
  • Welcome regular call auditing and coaching as fuel for growth; apply feedback quickly and consistently.
  • Document every interaction accurately in our systems with the right context and a clear next step for each patient.

Own Patient Experience

  • Create a calm, personalized experience that helps patients feel confident taking the next step in care.
  • Protect patient privacy by maintaining strict confidentiality and following HIPAA and all privacy requirements.
  • Flex with changing workflows, volumes, and schedules while supporting the broader team as needs shift.

Who You Are

  • A hospitality-minded people person - you make others feel genuinely cared for and you love creating great experiences.
  • Motivated by goals and comfortable using feedback and performance insights to improve.
  • A persuasive, empathetic communicator who can navigate emotional or complex conversations with calm and confidence.
  • You stay organized and calm while handling multiple systems, changing priorities, and a high volume of calls.
  • Coachable and self-aware - you welcome feedback, know your strengths, and actively develop your areas of opportunity.
  • Passionate about mental healthcare and Geode’s mission to expand access to exceptional care.

What You Bring

  • 1–3+ years in a customer-facing, phone-based, or hospitality role; healthcare, call center, or sales/conversion experience is a strong plus.
  • Comfort working in a goal-oriented, quality-focused environment.
  • Familiarity with insurance plans and benefits, or the ability to learn them quickly (preferred).
  • Strong computer skills and the ability to navigate multiple systems while maintaining a warm, focused conversation with the patient.
  • A quiet, professional remote workspace and reliable connectivity.
  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred.

At Geode Health, we offer:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Flexible schedule

  • In-person and virtual patient visits

  • Comprehensive admin support (front office, accounting, finance, payroll, HR, etc)

  • Professional development opportunities

  • Clinical community, support, and leadership

  • Medical, dental and vision benefits

  • Life insurance

  • Short and long-term disability

  • Paid vacation and holidays

  • Matching 401k plan

  • State of the art technology

Why work for Geode Health?

At Geode Health, we take our commitment to patients and providers seriously. We focus every day on how to help patients across the United States get the best possible mental health care available. To achieve this, we focus on ensuring our providers have unmatched support and resources so that they can focus on providing great care. We are backed by KKR, a leading private equity firm with the experience and mission alignment to truly make an impact. Joining Geode Health will put you on the front-end of a rapidly growing movement to increase access and improve outcomes for mental health patients and providers across the nation.

To learn more, visit us as

About Scento

Scento is Europe's largest perfume decant website. Founded in 2024 and headquartered in Paris on Place Vendôme, with a second office in Berlin, Scento offers more than 1,000 original designer and niche perfumes from a roster of 200 houses as perfume decants: 2 ml, 5 ml and 8 ml vials plus a 30 ml bottle on most perfumes. Niche perfume samples and designer fragrance samples let people discover a scent before they commit to a full bottle. Every perfume is an original bought from authorised European retailers, and every bottle passes a 12-point intake check at Scento's ISO-certified facility before it is decanted.

Scento serves customers in 27 European markets and ships to 26 EU countries. In 2026, Scento's annual revenue is more than €30 million, online and offline sales combined. On , monthly decant sales in September 2026 were 3.2 times those of January 2026. Scento says it sells more than 3 million perfume decants a year, about one every 10 seconds. In November 2025, Scento announced it would invest €25 million over three years in European perfume discovery.

The role

Customers choose Scento to try niche perfume samples and designer fragrance samples before committing to a full bottle, and they often have questions along the way. You are the voice that makes them feel looked after in their own language.

As a Customer Care Specialist you answer by email and chat in your native language (French, German, Italian, Spanish or Polish) and in English. You help with orders, delivery, sizes and perfume recommendations, and you turn tricky cases into customers who come back. Success means quick, warm, accurate replies and feedback that helps the whole team improve.

What you'll do

  • Help Scento's customers by email and chat in your native language and in English.

  • Answer questions on orders, delivery, perfumes and sizes, from 2 ml, 5 ml and 8 ml vials to the 30 ml bottle on most perfumes.

  • Recommend perfumes with real expertise, drawing on a catalogue of more than 1,000 originals.

  • Turn tricky cases into happy customers with calm, creative problem solving.

  • Share customer feedback with the team so products and processes keep improving.

  • Keep the help centre in your language accurate and easy to read.

What you'll bring

  • Native French, German, Italian, Spanish or Polish, plus fluent English.

  • 2+ years in customer service, ideally in e-commerce or beauty.

  • Warm, precise writing and a genuine interest in perfume.

What we offer

  • Salary at the top of the market plus an annual performance bonus.

  • Remote-friendly within the EU, with offices in Paris (Place Vendôme) and Berlin.

  • A generous monthly perfume allowance to explore the whole catalogue.

  • A personal learning budget of €2,500 a year for courses, conferences and books.

  • 30 days of paid holiday a year, plus public holidays.

  • Team gatherings in Paris and Berlin.

Salary and how to apply

Salary: €48,000 – €62,000 gross per year, full-time, permanent contract, plus an annual performance bonus.

Location: Paris or Berlin, or remote from anywhere in the EU.

• Adhere to Mitchell, CCC, or current parts and labor reference guides for parts pricing and labor times and rates

• Negotiate the cost of the repair to the published fleet price or the pre-negotiated Wheels Network rates & times.

Role Details

Job Title: Claims Attorney (Municipal Entities)

Location: Remote / Hybrid (dependent upon on proximity of office location)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Requisition Begin Date: 10/15/2026

Requisition End Date 12/15/2026 (Posting may close earlier if filled or business needs change.)

Help us insure it

Tokio Marine HCC - Public Risk Group, a member of the Tokio Marine group of companies, is a market leader in providing specialized insurance products for municipal entities. We cover counties, cities, townships, villages, police departments, prisons, fire departments and more. We serve the growing insurance and risk management needs of medium and large governmental entities and provide property and casualty insurance coverages in multiple states.

Role Overview

The Tokio Marine HCC - Public Risk Group is seeking a self-motivated Claims Attorney to join our growing Claims Department and handle litigated and non-litigated claims primarily arising under Auto and General Liability, as well as potentially some Law Enforcement, Public Officials, and Employment Practices liability policies in various jurisdictions.

If you are looking to enhance your legal career and/or insurance industry experience in a fast-paced, ever-expanding insurance company, we have an exciting opportunity to join our Casualty Claims team.

Key Responsibilities

This position involves interpretation of coverage and requires collaboration with outside counsel in analyzing and resolving claims within designated limits of authority. This includes investigation, analysis of liability and damages exposure, drafting and issuance of coverage position letters, and development of strategies for resolution of litigated and non-litigated claims. The Claims Attorney is also responsible for determination of probable loss exposure and establishment of reserves, as well as maintenance of claim files and documents in accordance with Company policy and procedure. This individual will report to a senior member of the Casualty and Litigation management team and will work claims with limited supervision from his or her desk.

Performance Objectives

  • Gain understanding of the insurance policies and procedures: During the first 30 days you will be reviewing Auto and General Liability, Law Enforcement, Public Officials, and Employment Practices liability policies as well as reviewing governmental immunities for each state in which we write business. You will understand how the claims department operates within the Tokio Marine HCC structure through direct training and interactions with claims staff, underwriters, and brokers. You will be able to navigate the claims systems and begin handling claims of limited complexity and exposure.
  • Build confidence and be proficient in insured/broker communications: During the first 60 to 90 days, you will develop confidence in contacting insureds, performing independent investigations, and communicating the Company’s coverage position. You will manage litigated and non-litigated claims as well as develop action plans for Reserving and Resolution opportunities. You will be handling all aspects of a growing inventory of claims while working more independently.
  • Obtain Adjusting License: You will be expected to obtain all necessary adjusting licenses within approximately 180 days (or within timeframe directed by management) of your employment.
  • Develop independent working environment: Within 6 months, you will work independently drafting your own coverage letters, completing authority requests when needed, and settling claims as appropriate within authority with limited management oversight.

What You Bring

  • Educational requirements: Juris Doctor (J.D.)
  • Experience: Minimum five (5) years of relevant legal experience, with two-plus (2+) years of relevant claims handling preferred.
  • Active Adjuster’s License (or commitment to obtain within six months).
  • Technical Skills: Intermediate proficiency and experience in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefit package
  • Strong learning culture with ongoing development opportunities
  • Opportunities for growth and career advancement
  • Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, with eligibility beginning on your first day of employment
  • Basic life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) plan with 6% company match
  • 20 days of PTO and two floating holidays (prorated)
  • Approximately 11 paid holidays and volunteer time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Access to our award-winning wellness program, including mental health services, fitness network membership, and a complimentary Headspace subscription
  • Student loan matching program
  • Employee discount program
  • An opportunity to do meaningful work and love what you do

Disclaimer

You do not need to disclose your criminal history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if the Company is concerned about a conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction or challenge the accuracy of the background report. The Company will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable federal, state and local laws, such as the Violent Crime Control and Law Enforcement Act of 1994 (18 USC § 1033(e))(the “VCCLEA”), which restricts financial institutions and insurers such as TMHCC from employing individuals with certain types of criminal convictions. Where the hiring and employment of individuals is not restricted by the foregoing, the Company will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history in compliance with applicable law such as the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the San Diego Fair Chance Ordinance, and the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

About Us

Tokio Marine HCC is a global industry-leading specialty insurance group, backed by the strength and stability of the Tokio Marine Group. Offering over 100 classes of specialty insurance, we empower clients to pursue opportunities confidently through our “Mind Over Risk” philosophy. More than an insurance company, we are an organization built on innovation, unity, and trust.

At our core, we are Always Advancing, driven by innovation and an entrepreneurial spirit that keeps us moving forward. Our people are Experts in Tomorrow, using curiosity and smart working to anticipate what’s next. With a culture rooted in Reaching Out, we foster genuine collaboration and support, ensuring every individual has the opportunity to succeed and make a difference.

Applying our Mind Over Risk philosophy to writing insurance allows our customers to take on opportunity with confidence. That philosophy defines our way of thinking, unites us as a team, and differentiates us from our competitors. We are much more than just an insurance company; we are a good company.

Equal Opportunity Employer

TMHCC is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances.

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. We are seeking aTechnical Project Manager / Solutions Engineerto serve as the bridge between project management, engineering, field implementation, and the client.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

We are seeking aTechnical Project Manager / Solutions Engineerto serve as the bridge between project management, engineering, field implementation, and the client.

This is a hybrid role for someone who can understand a technical scope, help develop and validate the solution, coordinate the project, and participate directly in technical implementation when required.

Projects may include network infrastructure refreshes, firewall and switching deployments, UniFi environments, wireless implementations, VLAN segmentation, VPN deployments, structured cabling coordination, Microsoft 365 migrations, MFA implementations, and cloud/data migrations.

The ideal candidate combines the organizational discipline of a Project Manager with the technical judgment of a Network / Systems Engineer.


Requirements

Technical Planning & Solution Development
  • Review client requirements, existing infrastructure, and approved scopes.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into practical implementation plans.
  • Review network diagrams, equipment requirements, migration plans, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
  • Identify technical risks, missing information, and potential scope issues before implementation.
  • Participate in solution design and technical discovery.
  • Develop or review implementation runbooks and cutover plans.

Project Management
  • Own project schedules, milestones, dependencies, communications, and deliverables.
  • Lead project kickoffs and maintain regular client communication.
  • Coordinate engineers, technicians, installers, vendors, and third-party providers.
  • Manage maintenance windows and implementation schedules.
  • Maintain project status, risk, issue, and change-control documentation.
  • Monitor project labor and resource requirements.
  • Identify scope changes and coordinate approval before additional work is performed.

Hands-On Engineering
  • Configure and deploy network infrastructure when required.
  • Work with firewalls, managed switches, UniFi controllers, wireless access points, VLANs, VPNs, routing, DHCP, DNS, monitoring, and network security controls.
  • Participate in wireless deployments and performance validation.
  • Support Microsoft 365 migrations, tenant configuration, MFA, Conditional Access, Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams projects.
  • Configure or review migration tooling and validate migration results.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues encountered during implementation.
  • Participate directly in production cutovers and post-cutover validation.

Implementation & Validation
  • Coordinate and/or perform pre-staging of equipment and configurations.
  • Confirm technical prerequisites before implementation.
  • Lead or participate in production cutovers.
  • Validate network connectivity, routing, authentication, applications, wireless, VPN, monitoring, backups, and other in-scope services.
  • Verify that completed work satisfies documented acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate remediation of issues discovered during testing.

Client & Stakeholder Management
  • Act as a technical point of contact for clients.
  • Explain technical requirements, risks, limitations, and expected project impacts.
  • Translate technical information into understandable business terms.
  • Coordinate client approvals, access, credentials, maintenance windows, and user communications.
  • Set appropriate expectations regarding downtime, migration limitations, and project dependencies.

Documentation & Handoff
  • Maintain project and technical documentation throughout the project.
  • Update network diagrams, VLAN/IP information, port maps, equipment inventories, migration records, and configuration documentation.
  • Maintain implementation runbooks and project closure records.
  • Provide technical handoff information to support teams.
  • Conduct post-project reviews and document lessons learned.

Required Qualifications
  • Professional experience in IT infrastructure engineering, technical project management, systems administration, network engineering, or a comparable role.
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, DHCP, DNS, and wireless.
  • Experience with infrastructure implementations and production cutovers.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate technical projects from planning through completion.
  • Strong client-facing communication skills.
  • Ability to understand technical documentation and project scopes.
  • Strong organizational, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to balance hands-on technical work with project coordination responsibilities.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience withUbiquiti UniFiswitching, wireless, and network management.
  • Experience with next-generation firewalls, VPNs, WAN failover, and network segmentation.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams, and Microsoft Entra.
  • Experience implementing Conditional Access and MFA.
  • Experience with cloud-to-cloud and file-server migrations.
  • Experience with wireless heatmap surveys and RF optimization.
  • Experience coordinating structured cabling and low-voltage infrastructure.
  • Experience working for an MSP, managed service provider, technology integrator, or IT infrastructure provider.
  • Relevant networking, Microsoft, or project-management certifications.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who can walk into a project and understand bothwhat needs to be built and how to get it delivered.

You should be technically credible enough to work alongside engineers and field technicians, while also being organized enough to manage schedules, clients, scope, risks, documentation, and project closure.

This position is particularly suited to an experienced Network Engineer who has developed project-management responsibilities, or a Technical Project Manager with strong hands-on infrastructure experience.

jobs.description:
Overview

National Debt Relief is seeking a data-savvy Manager of AI Analytics to serve as an individual-contributor analytics expert supporting the measurement, testing, and optimization of agent-replacement AI across voice and chat channels. This role will execute the analytics framework that governs AI interaction performance by designing tests, tracking KPIs, and building the dashboards that give the business real-time visibility into how AI is performing against quality, containment, and client experience goals.

Reporting to the Director of Digital & AI Analytics, this individual will be a hands-on analytical partner to AI Analytics and Engineering teams, translating complex model and interaction data into clear, actionable recommendations that inform the pace and scope of AI scale-up.

Responsibilities

  • Execute the measurement framework for AI Analytics, tracking performance of agent-replacement AI interactions across voice and chat channels.
  • Design and run test analysis for AI model and prompt experiments (e.g., model version A/B tests, containment vs. escalation testing), translating results into go/no-go recommendations.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and scorecards tracking AI-handled interaction KPIs — containment rate, accuracy, quality/CSAT, and escalation rate.
  • Partner with AI Analytics and Engineering teams to ensure AI interaction data (transcripts, model outputs, outcomes) flows cleanly into unified reporting.
  • Analyze AI-handled interaction volume and performance trends to support decisions on scaling AI across channels, balancing performance thresholds and client experience.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to validate and maintain data flows into Snowflake for AI analytics use cases.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including Analytics leadership.
  • Identify data quality issues or gaps in AI interaction tracking and drive resolution with cross-functional partners.
  • Stay current on conversational AI/LLM measurement practices and evolving best practices in AI performance analytics.

Qualifications

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Data Science, or related field required.
  • 6 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or similar roles.
  • Experience in financial services or fintech, especially client onboarding or customer support journeys preferred.
  • Previous exposure to leading or mentoring junior analysts, even without formal management experience preferred.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Strong SQL skills (Snowflake preferred) and comfort with data modeling and manipulation.
  • Experience analyzing conversational AI / LLM-driven interactions (chat or voice bots), including containment, accuracy, and quality metrics.
  • Experience with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation design, ideally for AI models or prompts.
  • Experience with visualization and dashboarding tools like Tableau, Sigma, Looker, or Power BI.
  • Ability to communicate complex data clearly and drive action across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to consolidate, understand, and communicate large data sets independently.
  • Familiarity with server-side tracking, CDPs (e.g., Segment, mParticle), or customer data governance frameworks preferred.

  • Work in a fast-paced, high-volume setting.
  • Use and navigate multiple computer systems with exceptional multi-tasking skills.

  • Take constructive feedback.

National Debt Relief was founded in 2009 with the goal of helping an expanding number of consumers deal with overwhelming debt. As a leading debt settlement organization, we have helped over 450,000 people settle over $10 billion of debt, while empowering them to lead a healthier financial lifestyle and feel free to live their best life. jobs.description:
VP of Technical Delivery

Strong CRM

Location: Remote (US/Canada), with a distributed LATAM delivery team

Reports to: Founder/CEO

Team: ~45 delivery professionals across Salesforce clouds

About Strong CRM

Strong CRM is a bootstrapped, profitable Salesforce systems integrator that has grown from under $300K to roughly $5M in revenue in five years. We specialize in the high-complexity end of the ecosystem — Field Service Lightning, Revenue Cloud, Financial Services Cloud, Health Cloud, MuleSoft, and Spiff — delivered by a talented, certification-heavy nearshore team. We serve roughly 80 active clients with a strong existing-client expansion engine and a reputation for doing the hard work that generalist shops can't.

We're at an inflection point. The founder currently carries both senior architecture and delivery leadership personally, and we're hiring a technical leader to own delivery end to end — so the practice can scale beyond any single person.

The Role

You will own the delivery organization: its quality, its margin, its people, and its technical standards. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a figurehead one. You'll be close enough to the work to make the hard architectural calls on complex engagements, and senior enough to build the systems, standards, and leaders that let delivery run without the founder in the loop. Success means that within 12 months, the founder is no longer the bottleneck or the senior technical escalation point for delivery — you are.

What You'll Own

Delivery leadership & client outcomes

  • Own end-to-end technical executiondelivery across all active and prospect engagements, including — scoping, staffing, sequencing, timelines, and client satisfaction

  • Serve as the senior delivery escalation point for at-risk projects, stepping in to recover timelines, scope, or client relationships when needed

  • Establish and run a delivery governance cadence — project health reviews, risk flagging, and status reporting — so problems surface early rather than at the deadline

  • Partner with clients as a trusted senior technical voice, especially on the largest and most complex accounts

  • Own delivery-driven client expansion — ensuring quality and proactive guidance turn engagements into repeat and expansion work

Margin, utilization & delivery economics

  • Own delivery gross margin and protect the margin profile that makes the business work

  • Manage team utilization, bench, and staffing efficiency across concurrent engagements

  • Improve estimation accuracy and scoping discipline so projects are priced and staffed to land profitably

  • Identify and reduce margin leakage — scope creep, over-servicing, rework, and mis-staffing

  • Provide the founder with clear, regular visibility into delivery metrics, capacity, and forecast

Technical authority & standards

  • Set architecture patterns, standards, and best practices across FSL, Revenue Cloud, FSC, Health Cloud, MuleSoft, and Spiff

  • Serve as the final technical decision-maker and escalation point on hard architectural problems

  • Establish and enforce code and configuration review practices, quality gates, and delivery standards

  • Drive reusable-asset and accelerator development so the team stops rebuilding the same solutions from scratch

  • Stay current on the Salesforce platform roadmap and guide how new capabilities are adopted into delivery

Team leadership & organizational scaling

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a ~45-person nearshore delivery team

  • Build the management layer beneath you — team leads, senior architects, and practice owners — so delivery scales beyond any single person

  • Own hiring, onboarding, and ramp for delivery roles, including workforce planning against pipeline

  • Set and drive the certification strategy across the specialized clouds

  • Own performance management — clear expectations, feedback, development paths, and accountability

  • Build and protect a culture of quality, ownership, and accountability across a distributed, cross-border team

Delivery operations & repeatability

  • Turn hard-won project patterns into documented, repeatable methodologies and delivery playbooks

  • Develop productized and accelerator-based delivery approaches that improve margin and shorten sales cycles

  • Own the delivery tooling and systems that support quality, visibility, and efficiency

  • Partner with sales on scoping, solutioning, and technical pre-sales for complex opportunities

  • Systematically reduce founder- and hero-dependency by building process where there is currently tribal knowledge

What We're Looking For

  • Senior technical consulting leadership in the Salesforce ecosystem — someone clients trust in the room, who can hold executive-level conversations, shape solutions, and be the credible senior voice on complex, high-stakes engagements

  • A track record of leading and scaling a sizable delivery organization — you've run delivery at meaningful scale and know how to bring structure, standards, and leadership to a growing team

  • The ability to provide technical leadership across our specialized clouds without being the hands-on builder — setting direction, making the hard architectural calls, and elevating the team's technical bar

  • A systems-builder who designs how an entire delivery org operates — methodologies, standards, quality, and repeatability — rather than solving problems one project at a time

  • Proven success leading distributed and/or nearshore teams, ideally LATAM — building quality, culture, and accountability across a remote, cross-border organization

  • The presence and judgment to operate as a true peer to the founder, and the credibility to own delivery and client relationships end to end

Nice to Have

  • Salesforce certifications across our specialized clouds

  • Experience climbing the Salesforce partner tier and working with Salesforce AEs and co-sell motions

  • Roofing, field-service, or other vertical experience

  • Experience in a bootstrapped or founder-led environment

  • Spanish or Portuguese

Why This Role

You'll take a profitable, respected, technically excellent practice and make it scalable — with real ownership over how delivery is built, and a founder who genuinely wants to hand you the keys rather than look over your shoulder. This is a rare chance to shape the technical and delivery backbone of a growing company at exactly the moment it's ready to scale.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary range: $250,000–$300,000 per year. Actual base offered will depend on experience, depth of Salesforce delivery leadership, and demonstrated ability to lead at scale.

In addition to base salary, this role includes:

  • Performance-based incentive compensation tied to delivery margin, utilization, client outcomes, and organizational milestones (target and structure discussed during the process)

  • Health benefits (medical, dental, and vision)

  • Retirement plan with 4% company matchcontribution

  • Paid time off and company holidays

  • Additional benefits and perquisites discussed during the interview process

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

We are seeking a hands-onNetwork / Systems Engineerto design, configure, implement, troubleshoot, and validate network and Microsoft 365 infrastructure projects for our clients.

This role is responsible for turning approved technical designs and project scopes into reliable production environments. Projects may include network infrastructure refreshes, firewall and switch deployments, UniFi implementations, wireless deployments, VLAN segmentation, VPN configuration, Microsoft 365 migrations, multifactor authentication, cloud migrations, and infrastructure cutovers.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working both independently and directly with clients and can take ownership of technical implementation from pre-staging through final validation and documentation.


Requirements

Network Engineering
  • Design and implement LAN/WAN infrastructure according to approved project requirements.
  • Configure and deploy next-generation firewalls, managed switches, wireless access points, controllers, VPN solutions, and related network equipment.
  • Configure VLANs, Layer 3 interfaces, DHCP relay, routing, firewall policies, WAN failover, monitoring, and network segmentation.
  • Configure corporate, guest, voice, wireless-management, security, server, and other required network segments.
  • Configure and manage UniFi Network Controller environments and UniFi switching and wireless infrastructure.
  • Configure LACP, VLAN trunks, port profiles, PoE, spanning-tree, loop protection, DHCP trust, and related switching functions.
  • Implement and validate SSL VPN and remote-access solutions.
  • Configure SNMP monitoring and integrate infrastructure into remote-management platforms.
  • Perform wireless deployments, RF configuration, SSID configuration, client isolation, roaming validation, and wireless performance testing.

Microsoft 365 / Cloud Engineering
  • Support Microsoft 365 tenant configuration and migration projects.
  • Configure migration tooling, source/target connections, service accounts, application consent, and identity mappings.
  • Support Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams, and file-server migration activities.
  • Configure and validate Microsoft 365 domains, DNS records, mail flow, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
  • Implement Microsoft 365 Conditional Access and multifactor authentication configurations.
  • Assist with Microsoft Authenticator enrollment and user validation.
  • Perform migration reconciliation, exception analysis, and post-migration validation.

Implementation & Cutover
  • Pre-stage equipment, firmware, configurations, and migration environments before production changes.
  • Perform network and infrastructure cutovers during approved maintenance windows.
  • Gracefully decommission and replace legacy infrastructure.
  • Validate connectivity, routing, authentication, applications, wireless, voice, backups, monitoring, and other in-scope services after implementation.
  • Troubleshoot issues encountered during implementation and determine whether they fall within the approved scope.
  • Support rollback procedures when required.

Documentation
  • Maintain accurate network diagrams, IP inventories, VLAN documentation, switch port maps, wireless information, configuration records, and equipment inventories.
  • Document migration results, exceptions, validation results, and final configurations.
  • Archive relevant legacy configurations and document replaced equipment.
  • Prepare technical handoff information for the support team.

Required Qualifications
  • Demonstrated professional experience in network or systems engineering.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, DHCP, DNS, and network troubleshooting.
  • Experience configuring managed network switches and firewalls.
  • Experience with wireless networking and access-point deployments.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues independently.
  • Experience performing production cutovers and maintenance-window work.
  • Strong documentation and technical communication skills.
  • Ability to work directly with clients and communicate technical issues clearly.
  • Ability to follow defined project scopes, implementation plans, and change-control procedures.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience withUbiquiti UniFinetworking equipment and UniFi Network Controller.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Microsoft Entra.
  • Experience with Conditional Access and MFA.
  • Experience with network monitoring and SNMP.
  • Experience with cloud-to-cloud and file-server migrations.
  • Experience with VPN technologies and WAN failover.
  • Experience with wireless heatmap surveys and RF optimization.
  • Experience supporting low-voltage/network infrastructure deployments.
  • Relevant networking or Microsoft certifications.

  • Own the analytical view of the pre-sale funnel from lead through closed-won.
  • Build and maintain funnel conversion reporting (Lead → MQL → SAL → SQL → Closed-Won).

  • Develop and maintain pipeline quality scoring based on fit, engagement, deal age, and stage velocity.
  • Analyze pipeline velocity and identify stall points.
  • Measure inbound and outbound lead quality by source, channel, and campaign.
  • Analyze SDR conversion rates and identify top-performer patterns.
  • Analyze AE performance, pipeline coverage, velocity, and closed-won rates.
  • Perform closed-lost analysis by stage, reason, segment, and competitor.
  • Build and maintain the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) framework.
  • Support ICP scoring models and refine lead scoring criteria.
  • Analyze segment performance, win rates, ACV, sales cycle, CAC, and time-to-value.
  • Build cohort analysis across products, segments, channels, and acquisition periods.
  • Support TAM and addressable market analysis using enrichment data.
  • Track ICP deviations and identify off-ICP win/loss trends.
  • Own the win/loss analysis program, including methodology, reporting, and competitive intelligence.
  • Produce recurring win/loss reports and actionable insights for Sales and Product leadership.
  • Support GTM planning with funnel benchmarks, quota attainment, capacity modeling, and productivity analysis.
  • Leverage AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to accelerate analytics, reporting, and build reusable prompt libraries.
  • Build and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards for funnel, pipeline quality, quota attainment, and self-service analytics.

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:


  • 2+ years in Sales Analytics, Revenue Operations, Business Intelligence, or GTM Analytics with ownership of recurring reporting and analytical deliverables.
  • Strong Salesforce reporting and dashboard experience with knowledge of the SFDC data model and data quality management.
  • Advanced Excel skills (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, formulas, data modeling).
  • Experience building funnel, conversion, and pipeline analytics, including stage conversion and drop-off analysis.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business questions into actionable insights.
  • Comfortable working with imperfect data and driving continuous improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting insights to business leaders.
  • Experience using AI/LLM tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) to improve analytics and reporting workflows.

Preferred


  • Experience with ICP analysis, pipeline quality scoring, or win/loss analysis.
  • Knowledge of B2B SaaS metrics including MQL, SQL, ACV, CAC, pipeline coverage, and sales cycle analytics.
  • Healthcare or HealthTech experience.
  • Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or Metabase.
  • SQL proficiency for self-service analysis.
  • Experience with CRM enrichment or sales intelligence tools (Gong, 6sense, Bombora, ZoomInfo, etc.).
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering and AI-assisted analytics, including AI agents or workflow automation.

Where:
The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States - if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

  • 2+ years of experience leading, coaching, and developing employees in an operational, technical support, or service delivery environment.

We are hiring a Senior Director, MarTech Product Management to own two business outcomes: maximize student and partner outcomes across the student journey, and a faster, lower-cost marketing operation that can scale across a complex multi-brand, multi-tenant ecosystem.

This is a product role in the startup sense. You will own the problem, not a queue of requests. You will decide what gets built and why across our website/DXP, SEO/AEO, content and creative operations, customer data platform, tagging and measurement, marketing automation and CRM integrations, and you will be accountable for the results. You will lead a team of product managers and work closely with Marketing, Data and Engineering leaders, and you will be expected to bring the point of view, not wait for one. This role will also be responsible for inculcating a product mindset within the team to ensure the full team is aligned in this same mindset and product thinking.

The right person is a leader who takes initiative and maintains accountability for outcomes with deep and broad digital marketing expertise across paid media, SEO, AEO, web and lifecycle marketing. They are tenacious, comfortable with ambiguity, and impatient with the status quo. They solve hard problems from first principles, push the organization on what is possible, and can take an idea from whiteboard to measurable result.

How You Will Bring Our Mission to Life

What You Will Do

Outcome 1: Maximize Student and Partner Outcomes Across the Student Journey

  • Own the funnel from first touch to enrolled student, with clear targets for inquiry, application and enrollment conversion across partner programs.
  • Configure and build system capabilities across the DXP/CMS, CDP, tagging and measurement, Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Salesforce that lift conversion, including personalization, page and form experience, lead capture and routing, audience segmentation and lifecycle journeys.
  • Use funnel data, test results and student insight to find the biggest conversion gaps, and decide what to fix first based on expected business impact.
  • Work with the CRO team to build a steady testing practice with the CRO, SEO/AEO, Digital Media and Lifecycle Marketing teams. Test often, scale what works and stop what does not.
  • Make sure our programs show up well in AI-driven search and answer engines as well as traditional search, and that the platform supports both.

Outcome 2: Use AI and Technology to Rework How Marketing Gets Done

  • Break down core marketing workflows, including content and creative production, campaign build and launch, website updates, SEO/AEO operations and reporting, and redesign them around AI and automation rather than layering new tools onto old processes.
  • Set measurable goals for speed to market, cost and capacity, and report progress against them.
  • Design the platform and operating model to scale across a multi-brand, multi-tenant ecosystem: shared components, templates, governance and data standards that let us launch and change faster without growing cost and headcount at the same rate.
  • Lead the DXP/CMS migration across 80+ university partner websites as a chance to change how work gets done, not a like-for-like move. Coordinate systems integrators and internal engineering from discovery through implementation.
  • Own the evaluation, selection and adoption of new MarTech and AI tools, including CDP, SFMC, identity resolution and data enrichment, with a clear ROI case for each.

Product Leadership & Influence

  • Set the product vision, strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for the MarTech portfolio, tied directly to the conversion and efficiency outcomes above.
  • Bring a point of view. Challenge requests that will not move the numbers, propose better options, and push stakeholders toward what is possible rather than what is familiar.
  • Lead and coach a team of product managers who are measured on outcomes, not output. Set a high bar for discovery, speed and quality.
  • Run lean ways of working: fast discovery, small bets, short cycles and clear decisions. Remove process that slows the team down.
  • Build trust with Marketing, Data and Engineering leaders and influence decisions with data, clear reasoning and strong executive communication.
  • Keep up with developments in digital marketing, AI and MarTech, and bring outside ideas into the roadmap.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enrollment rates across the funnel improve in a sustained, measurable way, and the gains can be traced to capabilities the team shipped.
  • Core marketing workflows run faster and at lower cost because they were rebuilt around AI and automation, not because people are working harder.
  • New partner brands and programs can be launched and run quickly on the platform without a matching increase in cost or headcount.
  • Marketing and Engineering leaders see the MarTech product team as the group that brings ideas and delivers results, not the group that takes tickets.

  • Delivery: Flagship initiatives, including the DXP/CMS migration, CDP implementation, content operations redesign and marketing automation/CRM integrations, meet milestone, budget and quality targets.

jobs.excerpt: Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.
jobs.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.


At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.


Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


Conversational AI – Player-Coach
As a UX Design Manager focused on Conversational AI, you will be a player-coach, combining hands-on design leadership with responsibility for leading and developing a small team of designers. Your team will shape how end customers interact directly with AI across voice and digital channels, from structured dialogue through to generative and increasingly agentic experiences. As a player-coach, you will remain close to the craft: shaping experience direction, contributing to research and design, and leading selected complex or ambiguous problems, while coaching and developing designers to do their best work. This is not a traditional management role where you step away from the craft. You will know when to lead directly, when to work alongside a designer, and when to step back and enable others to lead. 

Team:

  • You will be part of Genesys Design, a roughly 100-person team of designers, researchers, educators, and operations specialists.
  • You will lead a small team of designers focused on crafting powerful virtual agents and agentic products across conversation, automation, and AI-assisted workflows.
  • You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Data Science, AI, and Design to shape experience direction and deliver high-quality work. 

Key Responsibilities:

Hands-on Design Leadership:

  • Lead selected complex, ambiguous, or strategic end-customer Conversational AI problems from discovery through experience definition and validation.
  • Contribute hands-on to research, exploration, prototyping, and conversational design where your expertise creates the greatest impact.
  • Shape experience direction across related work and help designers connect individual decisions to broader customer, business, and system goals.
  • Provide critique and guidance while enabling designers to retain meaningful ownership of their work. 

People Leadership and Development:

  • Manage, coach, and develop a small team of designers, supporting their performance, growth, and career development.
  • Set clear expectations and provide regular, actionable feedback.
  • Understand individual strengths, development needs, and capacity to effectively allocate work and growth opportunities.
  • Create an environment where designers can navigate ambiguity, challenge assumptions, experiment, take ownership, and produce their best work.
  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, performance management, talent development, and workforce planning as required. 

Research-Led Discovery:

  • Ensure the team's work is grounded in a strong understanding of end-customer needs, behaviours, and real-world contexts.
  • Personally lead or participate in research where the problem is particularly ambiguous, strategic, or important to the direction of the team.
  • Coach designers to translate research and evidence into experience and product direction, identifying patterns and opportunities across initiatives. 

Conversational, Voice and Digital Experience Leadership:

  • Guide the design of how AI interacts with end customers across understanding, multi-turn dialogue, context, action, recovery, escalation, human handoff, trust, and user control.
  • Help the team make deliberate choices between structured, generative, and agentic interactions based on customer need, context, risk, and system capability.
  • Lead experience direction across voice and digital conversations, ensuring the team considers the complete customer interaction rather than individual features or dialogue alone.
  • Bring sufficient Voice UX depth to provide credible direction and critique across areas such as turn-taking, latency, interruption, pacing, tone, recovery, and conversational naturalness, while developing the team's capability in these areas.
  • Partner with Engineering and AI specialists to understand how emerging technical capabilities affect the customer experience.
  • Establish ways to prototype, research, and evaluate real conversations so quality is assessed through the experience customers actually have. 

Direction, Planning and Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Design to establish priorities and connect initiatives to broader customer, product, and business goals.
  • Manage design capacity and allocation while ensuring sufficient space for discovery, research, experimentation, and longer-term experience thinking.
  • Bring clarity to ambiguous priorities and ownership, identifying dependencies, risks, and opportunities across the team's work.
  • Represent both the team's work and the customer perspective in product planning and decision-making.
  • Raise experience quality through critique, coaching, and practices that help the team work more effectively. 

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience in UX design, conversation design, service design, user research, content design, customer experience, or a related field.
  • Experience formally managing or leading designers, including coaching, feedback, development, and work allocation.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a player-coach, combining hands-on design with people leadership and development.
  • Deep experience solving complex and ambiguous UX problems and shaping experience direction across connected work.
  • Experience using research to shape product and design direction.
  • Experience defining end-customer conversational or AI-driven experiences across voice, digital, or both, including multi-turn interactions, clarification, recovery, context, and escalation.
  • Strong Conversational and Voice UX expertise, with the ability to provide credible direction, critique, and coaching.
  • Understanding of AI and voice technologies such as speech recognition, text-to-speech, NLU, LLMs, streaming, and agentic systems.
  • Strong communication, storytelling, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong UX craft, research-informed decision-making, complex problem-solving, and design leadership. 

What Success Looks Like:

  • You balance hands-on design leadership with creating the ownership, direction, and coaching your team needs to do its best work.
  • Your team consistently creates high-quality voice and digital Conversational AI experiences grounded in customer evidence and strong design judgement.
  • Research and UX insight influence what the team builds, not simply how predefined solutions are designed.
  • You create greater coherence across the team's work while growing designers' capability, confidence, autonomy, and impact.

Our Benefits:

  • At Genesys, we’re committed to supporting your well-being, growth, and work–life balance. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:
  • Flexible work options – Choose what works for you with hybrid schedules, work-from-home flexibility, and the option to collaborate onsite in our state-of-the-art Galway office.
  • Career development & growth – Access continuous learning opportunities, mentoring, and clear paths for advancement.
  • Competitive pension scheme – Invest in your future with an excellent employer-supported pension plan.
  • Annual bonus program – Be rewarded for your impact and contributions.
  • Comprehensive health coverage – Including private health insurance, access to company dental plan, and wellness supports.
  • Financial protection – Enjoy Income Protection and Life Assurance, along with access to dedicated financial planning resources to help you make confident, informed decisions about your future.
  • Family-friendly policies – Generous paid maternity and paternity

Working at Genesys

  • AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year.
  • A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work.
  • Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support.
  • Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families.
  • Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work®certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys.

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.


What Happens After You Apply

After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:

  • Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team.
  • A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview.

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.


Stay Connected

Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available.

Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.

Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Genesys Cloud™ is the Agentic Orchestration Platform that securely connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise with built-in governance and control. jobs.description:
Senior Server Administrator – IT Infrastructure

Role Overview

The Senior Server Administrator is responsible for the design, administration, maintenance, security, and continuous improvement of the organisation’s server and IT infrastructure environment. The role will ensure that infrastructure services remain secure, resilient, highly available, and aligned with business requirements.

The successful candidate will provide senior-level technical expertise across physical and virtual server environments, operating systems, storage, backup, monitoring, patching, and infrastructure security. They will also play a key role in incident resolution, infrastructure projects, service improvements, and technical planning.

Key Responsibilities

Server & Infrastructure Administration

  • Administer and maintain Windows and/or Linux server environments across physical and virtual platforms.
  • Manage server hardware, operating systems, virtualisation platforms, storage, and associated infrastructure services.
  • Monitor system performance, capacity, availability, and health, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.
  • Perform server builds, configuration, upgrades, migrations, and decommissioning in accordance with established standards.
  • Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, configuration records, and technical procedures.
  • Ensure infrastructure platforms are appropriately configured for availability, performance, and resilience.

Infrastructure Operations & Support

  • Provide senior-level technical support for infrastructure incidents, service requests, and problems.
  • Troubleshoot complex server, operating system, networking, storage, and infrastructure-related issues.
  • Participate in an on-call or out-of-hours support rota where required.
  • Lead or support the resolution of major incidents and provide root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
  • Work closely with service desk, network, security, application, and other IT teams to resolve cross-functional issues.

Security & Compliance

  • Maintain server security in line with organisational policies and industry best practices.
  • Manage operating system patching, vulnerability remediation, antivirus/endpoint protection, and security configuration.
  • Support security audits, compliance requirements, and infrastructure risk assessments.
  • Implement and maintain appropriate access controls, privileged access, and server hardening standards.
  • Work with cybersecurity teams to investigate and remediate infrastructure security incidents.

Backup, Recovery & Business Continuity

  • Manage and monitor server backup and recovery solutions.
  • Regularly test backup restoration and disaster recovery procedures.
  • Support the development and maintenance of infrastructure disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
  • Ensure critical infrastructure services meet agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives.

Projects & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead or contribute to infrastructure projects, including server upgrades, migrations, cloud adoption, virtualisation, and technology refresh programmes.
  • Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to infrastructure services.
  • Identify opportunities to automate routine administration and improve operational efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain technical standards, processes, and best-practice procedures.
  • Support capacity planning and future infrastructure strategy.

Stakeholder & Supplier Management

  • Work collaboratively with internal IT teams, business stakeholders, and third-party suppliers.
  • Provide technical guidance and communicate complex infrastructure issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Support supplier management, technical reviews, and service improvement activities where required.
  • Provide mentoring and technical guidance to junior infrastructure team members.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Significant experience in a senior server/infrastructure administration role.
  • Strong experience administering Windows Server and/or Linux environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and core infrastructure services.
  • Experience with virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Microsoft Hyper-V.
  • Strong understanding of server hardware, storage, networking, and infrastructure architecture.
  • Experience with enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of server security, patch management, vulnerability remediation, and hardening.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure incidents and performing root-cause analysis.
  • Good understanding of ITIL principles and IT service management processes.
  • Experience working with monitoring and infrastructure management tools.
  • Strong documentation and technical communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical issues.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or other cloud infrastructure platforms.
  • Experience with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other scripting/automation technologies.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft 365 and hybrid infrastructure environments.
  • Experience with enterprise storage technologies.
  • Experience with high-availability and disaster recovery architectures.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, VMware, Linux, ITIL, or cloud certifications.

Key Competencies

  • Technical expertise: Demonstrates strong knowledge of server and infrastructure technologies.
  • Problem solving: Able to diagnose complex technical problems and develop effective solutions.
  • Ownership: Takes responsibility for infrastructure services and follows issues through to resolution.
  • Communication: Communicates clearly with technical teams, management, suppliers, and business stakeholders.
  • Continuous improvement: Identifies opportunities to improve reliability, security, performance, and efficiency.
  • Teamwork: Works effectively across IT teams and supports knowledge sharing.
  • Resilience: Able to manage priorities and remain effective during incidents and high-pressure situations.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Infrastructure availability and reliability.
  • Timely resolution of infrastructure incidents and problems.
  • Successful completion of infrastructure projects and upgrades.
  • Server patching and vulnerability remediation compliance.
  • Backup success rates and successful recovery testing.
  • Infrastructure security and compliance performance.
  • Reduction in recurring incidents and infrastructure-related risks.
  • Quality and accuracy of infrastructure documentation.
  • Delivery of automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

Role Summary

The Senior Server Administrator will be a key member of the IT Infrastructure team, responsible for ensuring the stability, security, resilience, and performance of critical server and infrastructure services. The role requires a proactive and technically capable individual who can manage day-to-day operations while also contributing to strategic infrastructure improvements and business continuity.

We operationalize the platforms that are core to our development environment within our growing AWS ecosystem. We also lead the organization's approach to agentic and AI-assisted software development, helping engineering teams safely and effectively adopt AI coding agents and tools. Our team consists of engineers with a unique blend of skills and experiences that foster a collaborative working environment where each individual member contributes to the success of the team. We learn and teach. We are creative and value the merit of ideas.

As a Senior Engineer focused on Agentic Engineering Governance for Open Source software, you are an idea-generator, a catalyst, and a collaborator who sets the standard for how College Board engineers use AI coding agents and agentic development tools safely, responsibly, and effectively. You understand cloud software delivery, tools, and processes that empower efficient and resilient delivery, and you bring that same rigor to the guardrails, policies, and standards that govern how developers use AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and similar agentic tools). You are technologically curious and seek opportunities to research emerging technologies and trends, standards, and products. Your eagerness and vision enable you to create and learn complex solutions.

Your focus will be on the fast-moving area of agentic governance for open-source software, where you build the program for license compliance, dependency risk, and review of the code we publish externally. You thrive in an environment with a strong mix of creativity and productivity, splitting your time between hands-on building and setting the standards others follow. You work closely with Security, Legal, and the developers who rely on us. Your excellent communication and mentoring skills allow you to effectively articulate solutions and policies to the team, enabling all to make healthy, well-governed contributions. The result is that the teams building for 7 million students each year can adopt AI with confidence.

In this role, you will:

Design & Implementation (60%)

The Territory Manager is a field-based position supporting our MitraClip division, and is responsible for ensuring that the assigned territory meets or exceeds sales objectives. The Territory Manager will work with their Regional Director to identify and evaluate market opportunities and sales potential and to establish and achieve annual sales objectives in assigned territory. They will coordinate activities with clinical consultants and negotiate contracts with external customers. This role keeps the company informed of market dynamics and competitive activity.

  • Educates external customers on the merits and proper clinical usage of company products by giving presentations and demonstrations using a wide variety of formats and platforms (e.g., slides, transparencies, manuals) to secure purchasing commitments.
  • Maintains clinical and technical expertise by attending company product training sessions.
  • Assesses trends in managed care, competitors' strategies, and new product development by monitoring internal (e.g. sales growth, product mix, and pricing trends) and external indicators (e.g. competitors’ activities, technologies, websites, journals, and newsletters).

The Sr Sales Solution Consultant – Healthcare is a client-facing presales professional who helps healthcare payer organizations modernize and optimize data exchange across administrative and clinical workflows. Healthcare Interoperability and Domain Expertise

  • Serve as a subject matter resource for payer interoperability use cases spanning claims, encounters, enrollment, eligibility, prior authorization, remittance, provider data, and member data exchange.
  • Apply working knowledge of HIPAA EDI/X12 transactions, including 270/271, 276/277, 278, 834, 835, 837, 999 and TA1 acknowledgements, as relevant to client workflows.
  • Apply working knowledge of FHIR and payer-provider exchange patterns.
  • Explain how EDI and FHIR coexist in payer environments, including translation, orchestration, validation, routing, exception handling, acknowledgements, and operational monitoring.
  • Stay current on CMS interoperability and prior authorization requirements and related industry implementation guidance.

Discovery, Solutioning, and Architecture

  • Lead or support technical discovery sessions to understand the client’s current-state systems, trading-partner landscape, transaction volumes, data quality, workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes.
  • Document current- and future-state data flows, integration points, interfaces, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and non-functional requirements.
  • Develop solution approaches that may include EDI gateways, FHIR server, mapping and validation services, workflow orchestration, identity and access controls, monitoring, and analytics.
  • Whiteboard solution architectures and communicate tradeoffs clearly to business, operational, and technical stakeholders.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, and Delivery teams to validate feasibility and avoid unsupported commitments.

Presales and Client Engagement

  • Partner with account executives through qualified sales pursuits, from discovery and solution strategy through technical validation and handoff.

  • Support proofs of concept or pilots when they are appropriate to validate solution fit and reduce client decision risk.
  • Respond credibly to questions, objections, competitive concerns, and requests for clarification while documenting follow-up actions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Practice Development

  • Capture market and client feedback for Product and Technology teams and identify recurring interoperability requirements or capability gaps.

  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
