jobs.excerpt: Our Why At Dotmatics At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive.
jobs.description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to take primary responsibility for maintaining and supporting our existing Virscidian product portfolio.

Our current products will remain important to customers for the next several years. During that time, they will require ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, bug fixes, customer support, and selected new features. This role is intended to provide clear technical ownership of that existing product stack while allowing other engineering resources to remain focused on our future product development.

This is a hands-on software engineering role for someone who is comfortable working with the Microsoft-based technology stack and enjoys solving practical product and customer problems. The primary focus is keeping our existing products stable, supportable, and responsive to customer and business needs. When appropriate, the engineer may also contribute to new product development, including our SaaS platform, scientific algorithms, performance improvements, and other engineering initiatives.

The ideal candidate has strong C#/.NET experience, understands desktop and server-side applications, and is comfortable working across application code, databases, APIs, deployment, and customer environments.

In this role you will get to

  • Take primary engineering ownership for the maintenance and support of existing Virscidian products.
  • Investigate and resolve software defects, production issues, and customer-reported problems.
  • Work with Support, Business Development, Product Management, and engineering teams to understand issues, priorities, and customer impact.
  • Implement new features and product enhancements on a case-by-case basis as customer and business needs evolve.
  • Maintain and enhance existing C#/.NET applications, including desktop UI (WPF, WinForms), services, Web APIs, and supporting components.
  • Work with SQL Server databases, data access layers, stored procedures, and application data models.
  • Support Azure hosted resources and existing DevOps, build, deployment, and release processes.
  • Troubleshoot issues across software, database, configuration, deployment, and customer environments.
  • Help improve the visibility and communication of product issues so priorities are clear to engineering and business stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with engineers working on future products when knowledge of the existing products, workflows, or domain is needed.
  • Contribute to new product development when appropriate, including SaaS platform work, scientific algorithms, performance and scalability improvements, and related engineering efforts.

What we are looking for

We are looking for an experienced software engineer who is comfortable taking ownership of mature products and keeping them reliable for customers. This role is well suited to someone who values practical engineering, understands that established products still require active development, and is comfortable working independently across a broad technical stack.

The person should be able to investigate issues with limited initial information, communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and drive problems through to resolution.

The key skills we are looking for

  • C# / .NET: Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining applications using C# and the .NET platform.
  • Desktop Application Development: Experience maintaining Windows desktop applications and user interfaces.
  • SQL Server: Strong experience with relational databases, SQL Server, data access, troubleshooting, and performance considerations.
  • Web APIs: Experience developing and supporting REST APIs and application integrations.
  • Azure: Experience working with applications and services deployed in Microsoft Azure.
  • DevOps / Build and Release: Experience with source control, automated builds, deployment, release management, and troubleshooting deployed applications.
  • Product Maintenance: Experience supporting mature production software, including bug fixes, maintenance releases, and incremental feature development.
  • Troubleshooting: Strong analytical skills and the ability to diagnose problems across application, database, infrastructure, and customer environments.
  • Ownership: Comfortable taking responsibility for a product area, managing priorities, and following issues through to completion.
  • Communication: Ability to work directly with Support, Business Development, Product Management, developers, and other stakeholders to clearly understand and communicate technical issues.
  • Autonomy: Comfortable working independently and making practical engineering decisions within an established product architecture.
  • Collaboration: Able to work constructively with multiple engineering teams and share knowledge across existing and future product development.
  • New Product Development: Ability to contribute beyond maintenance when needed, including SaaS architecture and development, scientific and analytical algorithms, performance optimization, and scalability work.

You may also have

  • Experience with scientific or laboratory software.
  • Experience with chromatography, mass spectrometry, CDS, LIMS, ELN, or other laboratory informatics systems.
  • Experience maintaining software used in regulated or enterprise customer environments.
  • Experience with legacy or long-lived Microsoft technology stacks.
  • Experience supporting customer-specific configurations and integrations.
  • An electrical engineering, software engineering, computer science, or related technical background.

Ultimately, we are looking for someone who enjoys owning and improving established software products, solving real customer problems, and providing the engineering continuity needed to keep our current product portfolio stable and effective for the next several years, while also being able to contribute to new product development when it makes sense.

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

If you are looking for a career at a dynamic company with a people-first mindset and a deep culture of growth and autonomy, ACV is the right place for you! Competitive compensation packages and learning and development opportunities, ACV has what you need to advance to the next level in your career. We will continue to raise the bar every day by investing in our people and technology to help our customers succeed. We hire people who share our passion, bring innovative ideas to the table, and enjoy a collaborative atmosphere.

Who we are:

ACV is a technology company that has revolutionized how dealers buy and sell cars online. We are transforming the automotive industry. ACV Auctions Inc. (ACV), has applied innovation and user-designed, data driven applications and solutions. We are building the most trusted and efficient digital marketplace with data solutions for sourcing, selling and managing used vehicles with transparency and comprehensive insights that were once unimaginable. We are disruptors of the industry and we want you to join us on our journey.

At ACV we focus on the Health, Physical, Financial, Social and Emotional Wellness of our Teammates and, to support this, we offer:

  • Multiple medical plans including a high deductible, low cost health plan
  • Company-sponsored (paid) Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Life Insurance
  • Comprehensive optional benefits such as Dental, Vision, Supplemental Life/AD&D, Legal/ID Protection, and Accident and Critical Illness Insurance
  • Generous paid time off options, including uncapped vacation days, the greater of 3 paid sick days or in accordance with the applicable state or local paid sick leave law, 6 paid company holidays, 2 floating holidays, parental leave, bereavement leave, jury duty leave, voting leave, and other forms of paid leave as required by applicable law or regulation
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program with additional opportunities to earn stock in the Company
  • Retirement planning through the Company’s 401(k)

Who we are looking for:

ACV Auctions is looking for a Software Engineer to join our MAX Engineering team and work on our SaaS Product, MAX Digital. The position will focus on backend development & maintenance of Go Lang features & services hosted in AWS and utilizing Postgres and NOSQL. The ideal candidate has a strong background and proven track record of architecting and designing enterprise applications in Go Lang and Node.JS, a penchant for high quality code, and a team minded approach to development.

What you will do:

  • Develop Services using modern language stacks like Go Lang , Postgres and NoSQL databases like mongo, SQL Server is nice to have.
  • Design and build complex systems that can scale rapidly with little maintenance, with a strong focus on reliability, performance, and operational excellence.
  • Design, build, and maintain Kafka-based event processing services, including consuming, deserializing, validating, persisting, and reacting to events to drive downstream workflows.
  • Design and implement effective service/product interfaces, including third-party API integrations and extensible handler patterns for new integrations.
  • Develop and maintain application data models, including writing and tuning complex SQL queries, optimizing indexes and performance, and designing schemas that reliably support application workflows
  • Own larger, complex initiatives end-to-end—from discovery and requirements through delivery and production support—driving alignment across engineering and business stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with software and production engineers to design scalable services, plan feature roll-out, and ensure high reliability and performance of our products.
  • Design and develop systems across all major departments including but not limited to; data, enterprise applications, and IT.
  • Lead technical design and architecture decisions across multiple systems/services, and help establish standards, patterns, and best practices.
  • Modify and develop custom software patterns as needed to solve highly complex software problems, and clearly document tradeoffs and long-term maintenance implications.
  • Be accountable for the overall performance of products and/or services within a defined area of focus, including diagnosing production issues and driving improvements.
  • Conduct code reviews, develop high-quality documentation, and build robust test suites for your products (unit/integration testing), ensuring maintainable and well-covered code.
  • Provide technical leadership through mentoring, coaching, and strong design/code review feedback, helping raise overall engineering quality.
  • Develop roadmaps and prioritize technical debt to effectively plan features and work, balancing delivery with long-term platform health.
  • Drive operational maturity (observability, incident response, on-call practices, reliability goals) and lead post-incident analysis with preventative action plans.
  • Handle multiple competing priorities in an agile, fast-paced environment while maintaining strong engineering discipline and delivery quality.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

What you will need:

  • Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
  • BS degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline or equivalent practical experience preferred
  • Minimum 8 years of experience building SaaS web applications using Go Lang and Node.JS and/or C# nice to have (12+ years desirable).
  • Strong experience maintaining and extending an existing codebase, adapting to pre-existing patterns and tracing the code’s path of execution across services.
  • Strong experience integrating 3rd-party APIs, implementing authentication & authorization and developing asynchronous data flows.
  • Strong experience publishing and consuming Kafka events, including designing event contracts, building reliable event-driven workflows, and handling ordering, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.
  • Strong experience developing unit and integration-tests, and setting expectations for test strategy and coverage.
  • Strong experience integrating with cloud service (AWS), specifically: SQS, SNS, S3, ECS, EKS, Lambda, ElasticSearch, Docker / Containers.
  • Strong experience working with Docker and Kubernetes, including containerization, orchestration (k8s) and serverless deployment scenarios.
  • Strong experience with build & deployment automation (CI/CD) and release workflows.
  • Strong SQL programming and data-layer development experience (schema design, query performance, indexing, and data reliability patterns).
  • Minimum 8 years of experience working with continuous integration and build tools.
  • Expert in version control systems and branching/release strategies.
  • Expert in software engineering tooling and mentors and drives adoption for new tools and tooling standards.
  • Expert in release, builds, testing and the entirety of the SDLC.
  • Expert at debugging distributed systems using distributed tracing and other common tools; able to lead root-cause analysis and preventative improvements.
  • Top notch communication skills, including clearly communicating tradeoffs and aligning stakeholders.
  • Experience architecting and designing systems from the ground up, including making pragmatic decisions for scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Experience working with a geographically dispersed team across multiple timezones, including leading technical alignment and delivery across teams.

Our Values Trust & Transparency | People First | Positive Experiences | Calm Persistence | Never Settling

Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. Our team develops the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations. The Usage squad owns the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations and customer usage calculations. Our domain encompasses maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculation, cost management and billing applications, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the customer user portal.

Our work sits at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations.   • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers while shaping pragmatic solutions for complex systems challenges
  • Contribute to roadmap planning, technical design, OnCall improvements, and long-term simplification of stack operations

You should be comfortable debugging across service boundaries and making careful changes in systems that affect customer stacks

We value engineers who can take ambiguous lifecycle requirements and transform them into explicit, modular solutions. You should be adept at breaking down complex systems work into safe, iterative increments while clearly communicating technical tradeoffs to both internal stakeholders and adjacent product teams.

jobs.description:
About the role

If you are a skilled Product Analyst who has passion to work in a fast-paced environment, have an eye for details and ready to experiment new things, we encourage you to apply and be part of our dynamic and innovative team and organization.

What you will do

  • Partner directly with Product Managers and game designers to define, track, and evolve core product KPIs – activation, retention, engagement, and monetization – across the game’s portfolio;
  • Design, run, and analyze A/B tests and product experiments, collaborating with Product on hypothesis design, metric definition, and interpretation of results;
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses of player behavior and product usage to uncover trends, friction points, and opportunities that inform the product roadmap;
  • Apply statistical techniques – hypothesis testing, regression, segmentation/clustering – to support forecasting and behavioral modelling;
  • Build and maintain automated dashboards and self-serve reporting for product KPIs, feature adoption, and player experience metrics;
  • Perform recurring analysis of product and feature performance across markets, operators, and product verticals;
  • Translate quantitative findings into clear, actionable recommendations for Product, Game Design, and Executive stakeholders;
  • Support ad-hoc analytical requests tied to product prioritization, feature launches, and roadmap decisions;
  • Identify strong and weak points in product performance and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related quantitative field;
  • 5+ years of experience in a product analyst, data analyst, or similar analytical role, ideally supporting a product or engineering organization. Experience in iGaming or online/mobile gaming is a strong advantage;
  • Strong SQL skills with experience querying large, complex datasets – must have;
  • Proficiency in at least one BI visualization tool (Tableau or Power BI) – must have;
  • Practical experience designing and analysing A/B tests or product experiments, including hypothesis testing and interpreting results – must have;
  • Working knowledge of statistical methods (regression, segmentation, hypothesis testing) applied to product and behavioural data;
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and a structured approach to problem solving;
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into recommendations that Product Managers and executives can act on;
  • Self-starter who takes ownership and works well independently, while also collaborating effectively as part of a cross-functional team;
  • Business fluency in written and spoken English.

What sets you apart

  • Experience with Python (Pandas, NumPy) or R for data analysis and automation;
  • Familiarity with product/event-tracking analytics tools (e.g., Amplitude, Mixpanel, Segment);
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and the modern data stack (Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt);
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables and data modelling;
  • Experience working in agile, cross-functional product teams.

About us

ARRISE is a global leader in software development and services for the iGaming industry, bringing together more than 2,500 professionals operating across more than 12 locations worldwide.

From concept through to delivery, we combine technical expertise, creativity and industry knowledge to develop products, platforms and services that shape player experiences and support some of the industry's leading brands.

We are best known for the work we deliver for Pragmatic Play, creating and supporting technology, products and specialists services enjoyed by millions of players worldwide.

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

At Reddit, machine learning sits at the heart of how millions of people discover, connect, and engage with the world’s largest collection of human conversations. From “How do I fix a leaky faucet?” to “What should I watch next?”, the Answers Relevance teamleverages AI to connect people with the real-world wisdom of Reddit communities. We’re hiring Senior and Staff Machine Learning Engineers to make Answers smarter, more relevant, and more helpful. Our SOTA AI systems helps surface the right conversations, but the heart of Answers is still people helping people ~ Redditors sharing what they know with each other!

What You’ll Work OnYou’ll lead ML projects from idea to production, partnering with Product, Data Science, and Engineering across recommendations, search, messaging, and AI systems.

You don’t need experience in every area listed below. A background in a few may make you a great fit!

  • Recommendations, search, content understanding, or large-scale data and ML infrastructure
  • SOTA large scale RecSys
  • Foundational retriever models
  • RAG systems, retrieval methods, LLM evaluation, or production LLM features
  • Agentic AI, such as tool calls, MCPs, multi-agent systems, or orchestration
  • Self-hosted open-weight models such as Qwen or Llama; prompt engineering, fine-tuning, post-training, or prompt optimization

  • Scaling LLM systems, including latency, caching, and cost; safety measures for prompt injection and unsafe inputs
  • Defining product success metrics, feedback loops, and evaluation approaches, including human review

What You’ll Do

  • Build and improve large-scale ML systems, including retrieval and ranking, embeddings, and LLM-powered features
  • Set technical direction and deliver measurable user and business impact
  • Work with partner teams to shape product and technical roadmaps
  • Evaluate new AI/ML approaches and support responsible LLM development
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to long-term ML planning

Required Qualifications

  • 4–12 years of experience building, deploying, and operating ML systems in production
  • Broad knowledge of ML fundamentals and experience applying them in production; expert-level modeling depth isn’t required
  • Experience developing and productionizing models with TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers
  • Experience writing production-quality code, including testing, evaluation, and monitoring; Python experience required, Golang experience a plus
